# Production
az appservice plan create --name unicribz-plan-prod --resource-group unicribz-rg --sku B1 --is-linux
az webapp create --name unicribz-api --resource-group unicribz-rg --plan unicribz-plan-prod --runtime "DOTNETCORE:8.0"
az webapp create --name unicribz-web --resource-group unicribz-rg --plan unicribz-plan-prod --runtime "DOTNETCORE:8.0"

# Create staging slots for production (for blue-green)
az webapp deployment slot create --name unicribz-api --resource-group unicribz-rg --slot green
az webapp deployment slot create --name unicribz-web --resource-group unicribz-rg --slot green
4. Create Database (PostgreSQL)
bash
az postgres flexible-server create \
  --resource-group unicribz-rg \
  --name unicribz-db \
  --location southafricanorth \
  --admin-user unicribzadmin \
  --admin-password "StrongPassword123!" \
  --sku-name Standard_B1ms \
  --tier Burstable \
  --storage-size 32
5. Create Redis Cache
bash
az redis create \
  --resource-group unicribz-rg \
  --name unicribz-cache \
  --location southafricanorth \
  --sku Basic \
  --vm-size c0
6. Get Publish Profiles (for GitHub Secrets)
bash
# For each App Service, download publish profile
az webapp deployment list-publishing-profiles \
  --name unicribz-api-staging \
  --resource-group unicribz-rg \
  --xml
Copy the XML output → GitHub → Repo → Settings → Secrets and variables → Actions → New repository secret:

Secret Name	Value

AZURE_PROD_WEB_PUBLISH_PROFILE	XML from unicribz-web

Copy the JSON output → GitHub secret AZURE_CREDENTIALS.

Step 1: Strategy Pattern — Notifications (START HERE, 4 files)

Files to implement (in order):

src/UniCribz.Api/Notifications/INotificationStrategy.cs

csharp
public interface INotificationStrategy
{
    Task SendAsync(string recipient, string message);
}
EmailNotificationStrategy.cs — implement using SendGrid

Inject IConfiguration to read SendGrid:ApiKey

Inject ILogger<EmailNotificationStrategy>

SendAsync creates a SendGridMessage, sends via SendGridClient

SMSNotificationStrategy.cs — implement using Twilio

Read Twilio:AccountSid, Twilio:AuthToken, Twilio:FromNumber from config

Use Twilio.Rest.Api.V2010.Account.MessageResource.CreateAsync(...)

InAppNotificationStrategy.cs — save to DB

Inject UniCribzDbContext

Create a Notification entity, save to database

(Wait for Siyabonga to finish the Notification entity)

INotificationManager.cs and NotificationManager.cs

csharp
public class NotificationManager : INotificationManager
{
    private readonly IEnumerable<INotificationStrategy> _strategies;
    
    public NotificationManager(IEnumerable<INotificationStrategy> strategies)
    {
        _strategies = strategies;
    }
    
    public async Task NotifyAsync(string recipient, string message)
    {
        foreach (var strategy in _strategies)
        {
            await strategy.SendAsync(recipient, message);
        }
    }
}
Register in ServiceCollectionExtensions.cs:

csharp
services.AddScoped<INotificationStrategy, EmailNotificationStrategy>();
services.AddScoped<INotificationStrategy, SMSNotificationStrategy>();
services.AddScoped<INotificationStrategy, InAppNotificationStrategy>();
services.AddScoped<INotificationManager, NotificationManager>();

Implementation plan (using RestSharp):

csharp
public async Task<(double Lat, double Lng)?> GeocodeAsync(string address)
{
    var client = new RestClient("https://maps.googleapis.com/maps/api/geocode/json");
    var request = new RestRequest();
    request.AddQueryParameter("address", address);
    request.AddQueryParameter("key", _config["GoogleMaps:ApiKey"]);
    
    var response = await client.GetAsync<GeocodeResponse>(request);
    // Parse and return lat/lng
}

csharp
public class UserConfiguration : IEntityTypeConfiguration<User>
{
    public void Configure(EntityTypeBuilder<User> builder)
    {
        builder.HasKey(u => u.Id);
        builder.Property(u => u.Email).IsRequired().HasMaxLength(255);
        builder.HasIndex(u => u.Email).IsUnique();
        builder.HasOne(u => u.University)
               .WithMany()
               .HasForeignKey(u => u.UniversityId);
    }
}

using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.Metadata.Builders;
using UniCribz.Data.Entities;

namespace UniCribz.Data.Configurations;

public class UserConfiguration : IEntityTypeConfiguration<User>
{
    public void Configure(EntityTypeBuilder<User> builder)
    {
        builder.ToTable("Users");

        builder.HasKey(u => u.Id);

        builder.Property(u => u.FullName)
               .IsRequired()
               .HasMaxLength(150);

        builder.Property(u => u.Email)
               .IsRequired()
               .HasMaxLength(255);

        builder.HasIndex(u => u.Email).IsUnique();

        builder.Property(u => u.PasswordHash)
               .IsRequired()
               .HasMaxLength(255);

        builder.Property(u => u.PhoneNumber)
               .HasMaxLength(20);

        builder.Property(u => u.StudentNumber)
               .HasMaxLength(50);

        builder.Property(u => u.Role)
               .HasConversion<string>()
               .HasMaxLength(20);

        builder.Property(u => u.CreatedAt)
               .IsRequired();

        builder.HasIndex(u => u.Role);
    }
}

📄 src/UniCribz.Shared/Helpers/PasswordHasher.cs
csharp
namespace UniCribz.Shared.Helpers;

/// <summary>
/// Wrapper around BCrypt for password hashing and verification.
/// Passwords are never stored in plain text.
/// </summary>
public static class PasswordHasher
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Hashes a plain-text password using BCrypt with a work factor of 12.
    /// </summary>
    public static string Hash(string password)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(password))
            throw new ArgumentException("Password cannot be empty.", nameof(password));

        return BCrypt.Net.BCrypt.HashPassword(password, workFactor: 12);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Verifies a plain-text password against a stored BCrypt hash.
    /// </summary>
    public static bool Verify(string password, string hash)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(password) || string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(hash))
            return false;

        return BCrypt.Net.BCrypt.Verify(password, hash);
    }
}
📄 src/UniCribz.Shared/Helpers/JwtTokenGenerator.cs
csharp
using System.IdentityModel.Tokens.Jwt;
using System.Security.Claims;
using System.Text;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration;
using Microsoft.IdentityModel.Tokens;
using UniCribz.Data.Entities;

namespace UniCribz.Shared.Helpers;

/// <summary>
/// Generates signed JWT access tokens for authenticated users.
/// </summary>
public static class JwtTokenGenerator
{
    public static (string Token, DateTime ExpiresAt) Generate(User user, IConfiguration config)
    {
        var key = config["Jwt:Key"]
                  ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("Jwt:Key is not configured.");
        var issuer = config["Jwt:Issuer"] ?? "UniCribz";
        var audience = config["Jwt:Audience"] ?? "UniCribzClients";
        var expiryMinutes = int.TryParse(config["Jwt:ExpiryMinutes"], out var m) ? m : 60;

        var expiresAt = DateTime.UtcNow.AddMinutes(expiryMinutes);

        var claims = new[]
        {
            new Claim(JwtRegisteredClaimNames.Sub, user.Id.ToString()),
            new Claim(JwtRegisteredClaimNames.Email, user.Email),
            new Claim(JwtRegisteredClaimNames.Name, user.FullName),
            new Claim(ClaimTypes.Role, user.Role.ToString()),
            new Claim(JwtRegisteredClaimNames.Jti, Guid.NewGuid().ToString()),
            new Claim("role", user.Role.ToString())
        };

        var signingKey = new SymmetricSecurityKey(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(key));
        var credentials = new SigningCredentials(signingKey, SecurityAlgorithms.HmacSha256);

        var token = new JwtSecurityToken(
            issuer: issuer,
            audience: audience,
            claims: claims,
            expires: expiresAt,
            signingCredentials: credentials);

        return (new JwtSecurityTokenHandler().WriteToken(token), expiresAt);
    }
}

using UniCribz.Data.Enums;
using UniCribz.Shared.Helpers;

namespace UniCribz.Api.Services;

public class UserService : IUserService
{
    private readonly UniCribzDbContext _db;
    private readonly IConfiguration _config;
    private readonly ILogger<UserService> _logger;

    public UserService(UniCribzDbContext db, IConfiguration config, ILogger<UserService> logger)
    {
        _db = db;
        _config = config;
        _logger = logger;
    }

    public async Task<AuthResponse> RegisterAsync(RegisterRequest request)
    {
        var email = request.Email.Trim().ToLowerInvariant();

        // Check duplicate email
        var exists = await _db.Users.AnyAsync(u => u.Email == email);
        if (exists)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("An account with this email already exists.");

        // Validate password match
        if (request.Password != request.ConfirmPassword)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("Passwords do not match.");

        var user = new User
        {
            FullName = request.FullName.Trim(),
            Email = email,
            PhoneNumber = request.PhoneNumber?.Trim(),
            StudentNumber = request.StudentNumber?.Trim(),
            PasswordHash = PasswordHasher.Hash(request.Password),
            Role = UserRole.Visitor,
            CreatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow
        };

        _db.Users.Add(user);
        await _db.SaveChangesAsync();

        _logger.LogInformation("New user registered: {Email} (Role: {Role})", user.Email, user.Role);

        return BuildAuthResponse(user);
    }

    public async Task<AuthResponse> LoginAsync(LoginRequest request)
    {
        var email = request.Email.Trim().ToLowerInvariant();

        var user = await _db.Users.FirstOrDefaultAsync(u => u.Email == email)
                   ?? throw new UnauthorizedAccessException("Invalid email or password.");

        if (!PasswordHasher.Verify(request.Password, user.PasswordHash))
            throw new UnauthorizedAccessException("Invalid email or password.");

        user.LastLoginAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
        await _db.SaveChangesAsync();

        _logger.LogInformation("User logged in: {Email}", user.Email);

        return BuildAuthResponse(user);
    }

    public async Task<AuthResponse?> GetCurrentUserAsync(Guid userId)
    {
        var user = await _db.Users.FindAsync(userId);
        return user is null ? null : BuildAuthResponse(user);
    }

    private AuthResponse BuildAuthResponse(User user)
    {
        var (token, expiresAt) = JwtTokenGenerator.Generate(user, _config);

        return new AuthResponse
        {
            Token = token,
            ExpiresAt = expiresAt,
            UserId = user.Id,
            FullName = user.FullName,
            Email = user.Email,
            Role = user.Role.ToString()
        };
    }
}
Step 6: Validators — 2 Files

csharp
using FluentValidation;
using UniCribz.Api.DTOs.Requests;

namespace UniCribz.Api.Validators;

public class RegisterRequestValidator : AbstractValidator<RegisterRequest>
{
    public RegisterRequestValidator()
    {
        RuleFor(x => x.FullName)
            .NotEmpty().WithMessage("Full name is required.")
            .MinimumLength(2).MaximumLength(150);

        RuleFor(x => x.Email)
            .NotEmpty().WithMessage("Email is required.")
            .EmailAddress().WithMessage("A valid email address is required.")
            .MaximumLength(255);

        RuleFor(x => x.Password)
            .NotEmpty().WithMessage("Password is required.")
            .MinimumLength(8).WithMessage("Password must be at least 8 characters.")
            .Matches("[A-Z]").WithMessage("Password must contain an uppercase letter.")
            .Matches("[a-z]").WithMessage("Password must contain a lowercase letter.")
            .Matches("[0-9]").WithMessage("Password must contain a digit.");

        RuleFor(x => x.ConfirmPassword)
            .Equal(x => x.Password).WithMessage("Passwords do not match.");

        RuleFor(x => x.PhoneNumber)
            .MaximumLength(20)
            .When(x => !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(x.PhoneNumber));

        RuleFor(x => x.StudentNumber)
            .MaximumLength(50)
            .When(x => !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(x.StudentNumber));
    }
}

using FluentValidation;
using UniCribz.Api.DTOs.Requests;

namespace UniCribz.Api.Validators;

public class LoginRequestValidator : AbstractValidator<LoginRequest>
{
    public LoginRequestValidator()
    {
        RuleFor(x => x.Email)
            .NotEmpty().WithMessage("Email is required.")
            .EmailAddress().WithMessage("A valid email address is required.");

        RuleFor(x => x.Password)
            .NotEmpty().WithMessage("Password is required.");
    }
}

Replace the placeholder:

csharp
using System.Security.Claims;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using UniCribz.Api.DTOs.Requests;
using UniCribz.Api.Services.Interfaces;

namespace UniCribz.Api.Controllers;

[ApiController]
[Route("api/[controller]")]
public class AuthController : ControllerBase
{
    private readonly IUserService _userService;
    private readonly ILogger<AuthController> _logger;

    public AuthController(IUserService userService, ILogger<AuthController> logger)
    {
        _userService = userService;
        _logger = logger;
    }

    /// <summary>Register a new user (Visitor role by default).</summary>
    [HttpPost("register")]
    [AllowAnonymous]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status201Created)]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    public async Task<IActionResult> Register([FromBody] RegisterRequest request)
    {
        try
        {
            var result = await _userService.RegisterAsync(request);
            return StatusCode(StatusCodes.Status201Created, result);
        }
        catch (InvalidOperationException ex)
        {
            return BadRequest(new { error = ex.Message });
        }
    }

    /// <summary>Login with email + password, returns a JWT.</summary>
    [HttpPost("login")]
    [AllowAnonymous]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status401Unauthorized)]
    public async Task<IActionResult> Login([FromBody] LoginRequest request)
    {
        try
        {
            var result = await _userService.LoginAsync(request);
            return Ok(result);
        }
        catch (UnauthorizedAccessException ex)
        {
            return Unauthorized(new { error = ex.Message });
        }
    }

    /// <summary>Returns the current authenticated user's profile.</summary>
    [HttpGet("me")]
    [Authorize]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status401Unauthorized)]
    public async Task<IActionResult> Me()
    {
        var userIdClaim = User.FindFirstValue(ClaimTypes.NameIdentifier)
                          ?? User.FindFirstValue("sub");

        if (!Guid.TryParse(userIdClaim, out var userId))
            return Unauthorized();

        var user = await _userService.GetCurrentUserAsync(userId);
        return user is null ? NotFound() : Ok(user);
    }
}

csharp
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using UniCribz.Data.Entities;

namespace UniCribz.Data.Context;

public class UniCribzDbContext : DbContext
{
    public UniCribzDbContext(DbContextOptions<UniCribzDbContext> options)
        : base(options) { }

    public DbSet<User> Users => Set<User>();
    public DbSet<University> Universities => Set<University>();
    public DbSet<Property> Properties => Set<Property>();
    public DbSet<PropertyImage> PropertyImages => Set<PropertyImage>();
    public DbSet<Room> Rooms => Set<Room>();
    public DbSet<Application> Applications => Set<Application>();
    public DbSet<Viewing> Viewings => Set<Viewing>();

    protected override void OnModelCreating(ModelBuilder modelBuilder)
    {
        base.OnModelCreating(modelBuilder);
        modelBuilder.ApplyConfigurationsFromAssembly(typeof(UniCribzDbContext).Assembly);
    }
}
📄 src/UniCribz.Data/Configurations/PropertyConfiguration.cs
csharp
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.Metadata.Builders;
using UniCribz.Data.Entities;

namespace UniCribz.Data.Configurations;

public class PropertyConfiguration : IEntityTypeConfiguration<Property>
{
    public void Configure(EntityTypeBuilder<Property> builder)
    {
        builder.ToTable("Properties");
        builder.HasKey(p => p.Id);
        builder.Property(p => p.Name).IsRequired().HasMaxLength(200);
        builder.Property(p => p.Address).IsRequired().HasMaxLength(500);
        builder.Property(p => p.City).IsRequired().HasMaxLength(100);
        builder.Property(p => p.MonthlyPriceFrom).HasPrecision(18, 2);
        builder.Property(p => p.MonthlyPriceTo).HasPrecision(18, 2);
        builder.HasIndex(p => p.City);
        builder.HasIndex(p => p.UniversityId);

        builder.HasOne(p => p.University)
               .WithMany()
               .HasForeignKey(p => p.UniversityId)
               .OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.SetNull);

        builder.HasMany(p => p.Rooms)
               .WithOne(r => r.Property!)
               .HasForeignKey(r => r.PropertyId)
               .OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Cascade);
    }
}

📄 src/UniCribz.Api/Services/PropertyService.cs
csharp
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using UniCribz.Api.DTOs.Requests;
using UniCribz.Api.DTOs.Responses;
using UniCribz.Api.Services.Interfaces;
using UniCribz.Data.Context;
using UniCribz.Data.Entities;
using UniCribz.Data.Enums;

namespace UniCribz.Api.Services;

public class PropertyService : IPropertyService
{
    private readonly UniCribzDbContext _db;
    private readonly ILogger<PropertyService> _logger;

    public PropertyService(UniCribzDbContext db, ILogger<PropertyService> logger)
    {
        _db = db;
        _logger = logger;
    }

    public async Task<IEnumerable<PropertyResponse>> SearchAsync(
        string? city, Guid? universityId, string? genderType,
        decimal? minPrice, decimal? maxPrice)
    {
        var query = _db.Properties
            .Include(p => p.University)
            .Include(p => p.Images)
            .Include(p => p.Rooms)
            .AsQueryable();

        if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(city))
            query = query.Where(p => p.City.ToLower() == city.ToLower());

        if (universityId.HasValue)
            query = query.Where(p => p.UniversityId == universityId);

        if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(genderType))
            query = query.Where(p => p.GenderType == genderType);

        if (minPrice.HasValue)
            query = query.Where(p => p.MonthlyPriceTo >= minPrice.Value);

        if (maxPrice.HasValue)
            query = query.Where(p => p.MonthlyPriceFrom <= maxPrice.Value);

        var properties = await query.OrderBy(p => p.Name).ToListAsync();
        return properties.Select(MapToResponse);
    }

    public async Task<PropertyResponse?> GetByIdAsync(Guid id)
    {
        var property = await _db.Properties
            .Include(p => p.University)
            .Include(p => p.Images)
            .Include(p => p.Rooms)
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync(p => p.Id == id);

        return property is null ? null : MapToResponse(property);
    }

    public async Task<PropertyResponse> CreateAsync(CreatePropertyRequest request)
    {
        var property = new Property
        {
            Name = request.Name.Trim(),
            Description = request.Description.Trim(),
            Address = request.Address.Trim(),
            City = request.City.Trim(),
            Latitude = request.Latitude,
            Longitude = request.Longitude,
            GenderType = request.GenderType,
            MonthlyPriceFrom = request.MonthlyPriceFrom,
            MonthlyPriceTo = request.MonthlyPriceTo,
            UniversityId = request.UniversityId,
            CreatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow
        };

        _db.Properties.Add(property);
        await _db.SaveChangesAsync();

        _logger.LogInformation("Property created: {Name} ({Id})", property.Name, property.Id);

        return await GetByIdAsync(property.Id) ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("Failed to reload property.");
    }

    public async Task<PropertyResponse> UpdateAsync(Guid id, CreatePropertyRequest request)
    {
        var property = await _db.Properties.FindAsync(id)
            ?? throw new KeyNotFoundException($"Property {id} not found.");

        property.Name = request.Name.Trim();
        property.Description = request.Description.Trim();
        property.Address = request.Address.Trim();
        property.City = request.City.Trim();
        property.Latitude = request.Latitude;
        property.Longitude = request.Longitude;
        property.GenderType = request.GenderType;
        property.MonthlyPriceFrom = request.MonthlyPriceFrom;
        property.MonthlyPriceTo = request.MonthlyPriceTo;
        property.UniversityId = request.UniversityId;
        property.UpdatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;

        await _db.SaveChangesAsync();
        return await GetByIdAsync(id) ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("Failed to reload property.");
    }

    public async Task DeleteAsync(Guid id)
    {
        var property = await _db.Properties.FindAsync(id)
            ?? throw new KeyNotFoundException($"Property {id} not found.");

        _db.Properties.Remove(property);
        await _db.SaveChangesAsync();

        _logger.LogInformation("Property deleted: {Id}", id);
    }

    public async Task<IEnumerable<RoomResponse>> GetRoomsAsync(Guid propertyId)
    {
        var exists = await _db.Properties.AnyAsync(p => p.Id == propertyId);
        if (!exists) throw new KeyNotFoundException($"Property {propertyId} not found.");

        var rooms = await _db.Rooms
            .Where(r => r.PropertyId == propertyId)
            .OrderBy(r => r.RoomNumber)
            .ToListAsync();

        return rooms.Select(MapToRoomResponse);
    }

    public async Task<RoomResponse> AddRoomAsync(Guid propertyId, CreateRoomRequest request)
    {
        var property = await _db.Properties.FindAsync(propertyId)
            ?? throw new KeyNotFoundException($"Property {propertyId} not found.");

        var room = new Room
        {
            PropertyId = propertyId,
            RoomNumber = request.RoomNumber.Trim(),
            Type = request.Type,
            Capacity = request.Capacity,
            MonthlyPrice = request.MonthlyPrice,
            Status = RoomStatus.Available,
            CreatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow
        };

        _db.Rooms.Add(room);
        property.TotalRooms += 1;
        await _db.SaveChangesAsync();

        return MapToRoomResponse(room);
    }

    private static PropertyResponse MapToResponse(Property p) => new()
    {
        Id = p.Id,
        Name = p.Name,
        Description = p.Description,
        Address = p.Address,
        City = p.City,
        Latitude = p.Latitude,
        Longitude = p.Longitude,
        GenderType = p.GenderType,
        MonthlyPriceFrom = p.MonthlyPriceFrom,
        MonthlyPriceTo = p.MonthlyPriceTo,
        TotalRooms = p.TotalRooms,
        UniversityName = p.University?.Name,
        AvailableRooms = p.Rooms.Count(r => r.Status == RoomStatus.Available),
        ImageUrls = p.Images.OrderBy(i => i.SortOrder).Select(i => i.ImageUrl).ToList(),
        CreatedAt = p.CreatedAt
    };

    private static RoomResponse MapToRoomResponse(Room r) => new()
    {
        Id = r.Id,
        PropertyId = r.PropertyId,
        RoomNumber = r.RoomNumber,
        Type = r.Type,
        Capacity = r.Capacity,
        MonthlyPrice = r.MonthlyPrice,
        Status = r.Status.ToString()
    };
}

using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using UniCribz.Api.DTOs.Requests;
using UniCribz.Api.Services.Interfaces;
using UniCribz.Shared.Constants;

namespace UniCribz.Api.Controllers;

[ApiController]
[Route("api/[controller]")]
public class PropertyController : ControllerBase
{
    private readonly IPropertyService _propertyService;

    public PropertyController(IPropertyService propertyService)
    {
        _propertyService = propertyService;
    }

    /// <summary>Search properties with optional filters (public).</summary>
    [HttpGet]
    [AllowAnonymous]
    public async Task<IActionResult> Search(
        [FromQuery] string? city,
        [FromQuery] Guid? universityId,
        [FromQuery] string? genderType,
        [FromQuery] decimal? minPrice,
        [FromQuery] decimal? maxPrice)
    {
        var results = await _propertyService.SearchAsync(city, universityId, genderType, minPrice, maxPrice);
        return Ok(results);
    }

    /// <summary>Get a single property by ID (public).</summary>
    [HttpGet("{id:guid}")]
    [AllowAnonymous]
    public async Task<IActionResult> GetById(Guid id)
    {
        var result = await _propertyService.GetByIdAsync(id);
        return result is null ? NotFound() : Ok(result);
    }

    /// <summary>Create a new property (Admin only).</summary>
    [HttpPost]
    [Authorize(Roles = Roles.Admin)]
    public async Task<IActionResult> Create([FromBody] CreatePropertyRequest request)
    {
        var result = await _propertyService.CreateAsync(request);
        return CreatedAtAction(nameof(GetById), new { id = result.Id }, result);
    }

    /// <summary>Update an existing property (Admin only).</summary>
    [HttpPut("{id:guid}")]
    [Authorize(Roles = Roles.Admin)]
    public async Task<IActionResult> Update(Guid id, [FromBody] CreatePropertyRequest request)
    {
        try
        {
            var result = await _propertyService.UpdateAsync(id, request);
            return Ok(result);
        }
        catch (KeyNotFoundException ex)
        {
            return NotFound(new { error = ex.Message });
        }
    }

    /// <summary>Delete a property (Admin only).</summary>
    [HttpDelete("{id:guid}")]
    [Authorize(Roles = Roles.Admin)]
    public async Task<IActionResult> Delete(Guid id)
    {
        try
        {
            await _propertyService.DeleteAsync(id);
            return NoContent();
        }
        catch (KeyNotFoundException ex)
        {
            return NotFound(new { error = ex.Message });
        }
    }

    /// <summary>Get all rooms for a property (public).</summary>
    [HttpGet("{id:guid}/rooms")]
    [AllowAnonymous]
    public async Task<IActionResult> GetRooms(Guid id)
    {
        try
        {
            var rooms = await _propertyService.GetRoomsAsync(id);
            return Ok(rooms);
        }
        catch (KeyNotFoundException ex)
        {
            return NotFound(new { error = ex.Message });
        }
    }

    /// <summary>Add a room to a property (Admin only).</summary>
    [HttpPost("{id:guid}/rooms")]
    [Authorize(Roles = Roles.Admin)]
    public async Task<IActionResult> AddRoom(Guid id, [FromBody] CreateRoomRequest request)
    {
        try
        {
            var room = await _propertyService.AddRoomAsync(id, request);
            return CreatedAtAction(nameof(GetRooms), new { id }, room);
        }
        catch (KeyNotFoundException ex)
        {
            return NotFound(new { error = ex.Message });
        }
    }
}

📄 src/UniCribz.Api/Services/ApplicationService.cs
csharp
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using UniCribz.Api.DTOs.Requests;
using UniCribz.Api.DTOs.Responses;
using UniCribz.Api.Services.Interfaces;
using UniCribz.Data.Context;
using UniCribz.Data.Entities;
using UniCribz.Data.Enums;

namespace UniCribz.Api.Services;

public class ApplicationService : IApplicationService
{
    private readonly UniCribzDbContext _db;
    private readonly ILogger<ApplicationService> _logger;

    public ApplicationService(UniCribzDbContext db, ILogger<ApplicationService> logger)
    {
        _db = db;
        _logger = logger;
    }

    public async Task<ApplicationResponse> CreateAsync(CreateApplicationRequest request, Guid userId)
    {
        var property = await _db.Properties.FindAsync(request.PropertyId)
            ?? throw new KeyNotFoundException("Property not found.");

        if (request.RoomId.HasValue)
        {
            var room = await _db.Rooms.FindAsync(request.RoomId.Value)
                ?? throw new KeyNotFoundException("Room not found.");
            if (room.PropertyId != property.Id)
                throw new InvalidOperationException("Room does not belong to the selected property.");
        }

        var application = new Application
        {
            UserId = userId,
            PropertyId = request.PropertyId,
            RoomId = request.RoomId,
            PreferredMoveInDate = request.PreferredMoveInDate,
            Notes = request.Notes,
            Status = ApplicationStatus.Submitted,
            SubmittedAt = DateTime.UtcNow
        };

        _db.Applications.Add(application);
        await _db.SaveChangesAsync();

        _logger.LogInformation("Application {Id} submitted by user {UserId}", application.Id, userId);

        return await LoadResponse(application.Id);
    }

    public async Task<IEnumerable<ApplicationResponse>> GetAllAsync()
    {
        var apps = await _db.Applications
            .Include(a => a.User)
            .Include(a => a.Property)
            .Include(a => a.Room)
            .OrderByDescending(a => a.SubmittedAt)
            .ToListAsync();

        return apps.Select(Map);
    }

    public async Task<ApplicationResponse?> GetByIdAsync(Guid id, Guid requesterId, bool isAdmin)
    {
        var app = await _db.Applications
            .Include(a => a.User)
            .Include(a => a.Property)
            .Include(a => a.Room)
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync(a => a.Id == id);

        if (app is null) return null;
        if (!isAdmin && app.UserId != requesterId) return null;

        return Map(app);
    }

    public async Task<ApplicationResponse> UpdateStatusAsync(Guid id, ApplicationStatus status, Guid adminId)
    {
        var app = await _db.Applications.FindAsync(id)
            ?? throw new KeyNotFoundException("Application not found.");

        app.Status = status;
        app.ReviewedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
        app.ReviewedByUserId = adminId;

        if (status == ApplicationStatus.Approved && app.RoomId.HasValue)
        {
            var room = await _db.Rooms.FindAsync(app.RoomId.Value);
            if (room != null)
                room.Status = RoomStatus.Reserved;
        }

        await _db.SaveChangesAsync();
        return await LoadResponse(id);
    }

    private async Task<ApplicationResponse> LoadResponse(Guid id)
    {
        var app = await _db.Applications
            .Include(a => a.User)
            .Include(a => a.Property)
            .Include(a => a.Room)
            .FirstAsync(a => a.Id == id);
        return Map(app);
    }

    private static ApplicationResponse Map(Application a) => new()
    {
        Id = a.Id,
        UserId = a.UserId,
        UserFullName = a.User?.FullName ?? string.Empty,
        UserEmail = a.User?.Email ?? string.Empty,
        PropertyId = a.PropertyId,
        PropertyName = a.Property?.Name ?? string.Empty,
        RoomId = a.RoomId,
        RoomNumber = a.Room?.RoomNumber,
        PreferredMoveInDate = a.PreferredMoveInDate,
        Status = a.Status.ToString(),
        Notes = a.Notes,
        SubmittedAt = a.SubmittedAt,
        ReviewedAt = a.ReviewedAt
    };
}
📄 src/UniCribz.Api/Controllers/ApplicationController.cs
csharp
using System.Security.Claims;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using UniCribz.Api.DTOs.Requests;
using UniCribz.Api.Services.Interfaces;
using UniCribz.Data.Enums;
using UniCribz.Shared.Constants;

namespace UniCribz.Api.Controllers;

[ApiController]
[Route("api/[controller]")]
[Authorize]
public class ApplicationController : ControllerBase
{
    private readonly IApplicationService _service;

    public ApplicationController(IApplicationService service)
    {
        _service = service;
    }

    private Guid CurrentUserId =>
        Guid.Parse(User.FindFirstValue(ClaimTypes.NameIdentifier) ?? User.FindFirstValue("sub")!);

    private bool IsAdmin => User.IsInRole(Roles.Admin);

    /// <summary>Submit a new application (authenticated user).</summary>
    [HttpPost]
    public async Task<IActionResult> Create([FromBody] CreateApplicationRequest request)
    {
        try
        {
            var result = await _service.CreateAsync(request, CurrentUserId);
            return CreatedAtAction(nameof(GetById), new { id = result.Id }, result);
        }
        catch (KeyNotFoundException ex)
        {
            return NotFound(new { error = ex.Message });
        }
        catch (InvalidOperationException ex)
        {
            return BadRequest(new { error = ex.Message });
        }
    }

    /// <summary>List all applications (Admin only).</summary>
    [HttpGet]
    [Authorize(Roles = Roles.Admin)]
    public async Task<IActionResult> GetAll()
    {
        return Ok(await _service.GetAllAsync());
    }

    /// <summary>Get one application (owner or admin).</summary>
    [HttpGet("{id:guid}")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> GetById(Guid id)
    {
        var result = await _service.GetByIdAsync(id, CurrentUserId, IsAdmin);
        return result is null ? NotFound() : Ok(result);
    }

    /// <summary>Approve/reject an application (Admin only).</summary>
    [HttpPatch("{id:guid}/status")]
    [Authorize(Roles = Roles.Admin)]
    public async Task<IActionResult> UpdateStatus(Guid id, [FromBody] UpdateApplicationStatusRequest req)
    {
        try
        {
            var result = await _service.UpdateStatusAsync(id, req.Status, CurrentUserId);
            return Ok(result);
        }
        catch (KeyNotFoundException ex)
        {
            return NotFound(new { error = ex.Message });
        }
    }
}

{
    public ApplicationStatus Status { get; set; }

using UniCribz.Api.DTOs.Requests;

public interface IViewingService

    Task<IEnumerable<ViewingResponse>> GetAllAsync();
    Task<ViewingResponse> UpdateStatusAsync(Guid id, ViewingStatus status);

src/UniCribz.Api/Services/ViewingService.cs

csharp
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using UniCribz.Api.DTOs.Requests;
using UniCribz.Api.DTOs.Responses;
using UniCribz.Api.Services.Interfaces;
using UniCribz.Data.Context;
using UniCribz.Data.Entities;
using UniCribz.Data.Enums;

namespace UniCribz.Api.Services;

public class ViewingService : IViewingService
{
    private readonly UniCribzDbContext _db;
    private readonly ILogger<ViewingService> _logger;

    public ViewingService(UniCribzDbContext db, ILogger<ViewingService> logger)
    {
        _db = db;
        _logger = logger;
    }

    public async Task<ViewingResponse> BookAsync(BookViewingRequest request, Guid userId)
    {
        var property = await _db.Properties.FindAsync(request.PropertyId)
            ?? throw new KeyNotFoundException("Property not found.");

        if (request.ScheduledDateTime < DateTime.UtcNow)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("Scheduled date must be in the future.");

        var viewing = new Viewing
        {
            UserId = userId,
            PropertyId = request.PropertyId,
            ScheduledDateTime = request.ScheduledDateTime,
            Notes = request.Notes,
            Status = ViewingStatus.Requested,
            CreatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow
        };

        _db.Viewings.Add(viewing);
        await _db.SaveChangesAsync();

        _logger.LogInformation("Viewing {Id} booked by user {UserId}", viewing.Id, userId);

        return await LoadResponse(viewing.Id);
    }

    public async Task<IEnumerable<ViewingResponse>> GetAllAsync()
    {
        var list = await _db.Viewings
            .Include(v => v.User)
            .Include(v => v.Property)
            .OrderByDescending(v => v.ScheduledDateTime)
            .ToListAsync();
        return list.Select(Map);
    }

    public async Task<ViewingResponse> UpdateStatusAsync(Guid id, ViewingStatus status)
    {
        var viewing = await _db.Viewings.FindAsync(id)
            ?? throw new KeyNotFoundException("Viewing not found.");
        viewing.Status = status;
        await _db.SaveChangesAsync();
        return await LoadResponse(id);
    }

    private async Task<ViewingResponse> LoadResponse(Guid id)
    {
        var v = await _db.Viewings
            .Include(x => x.User)
            .Include(x => x.Property)
            .FirstAsync(x => x.Id == id);
        return Map(v);
    }

    private static ViewingResponse Map(Viewing v) => new()
    {
        Id = v.Id,
        UserId = v.UserId,
        UserFullName = v.User?.FullName ?? string.Empty,
        PropertyId = v.PropertyId,
        PropertyName = v.Property?.Name ?? string.Empty,
        ScheduledDateTime = v.ScheduledDateTime,
        Status = v.Status.ToString(),
        Notes = v.Notes,
        CreatedAt = v.CreatedAt
    };
}
src/UniCribz.Api/Controllers/ViewingController.cs

csharp
using System.Security.Claims;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using UniCribz.Api.DTOs.Requests;
using UniCribz.Api.Services.Interfaces;
using UniCribz.Data.Enums;
using UniCribz.Shared.Constants;

namespace UniCribz.Api.Controllers;

[ApiController]
[Route("api/[controller]")]
[Authorize]
public class ViewingController : ControllerBase
{
    private readonly IViewingService _service;

    public ViewingController(IViewingService service)
    {
        _service = service;
    }

    private Guid CurrentUserId =>
        Guid.Parse(User.FindFirstValue(ClaimTypes.NameIdentifier) ?? User.FindFirstValue("sub")!);

    /// <summary>Book a new viewing.</summary>
    [HttpPost]
    public async Task<IActionResult> Book([FromBody] BookViewingRequest request)
    {
        try
        {
            var result = await _service.BookAsync(request, CurrentUserId);
            return CreatedAtAction(nameof(GetAll), new { id = result.Id }, result);
        }
        catch (KeyNotFoundException ex) { return NotFound(new { error = ex.Message }); }
        catch (InvalidOperationException ex) { return BadRequest(new { error = ex.Message }); }
    }

    /// <summary>List all viewings (Admin only).</summary>
    [HttpGet]
    [Authorize(Roles = Roles.Admin)]
    public async Task<IActionResult> GetAll() => Ok(await _service.GetAllAsync());

    /// <summary>Approve/reject/reschedule a viewing (Admin only).</summary>
    [HttpPatch("{id:guid}/status")]
    [Authorize(Roles = Roles.Admin)]
    public async Task<IActionResult> UpdateStatus(Guid id, [FromBody] UpdateViewingStatusRequest req)
    {
        try
        {
            return Ok(await _service.UpdateStatusAsync(id, req.Status));
        }
        catch (KeyNotFoundException ex) { return NotFound(new { error = ex.Message }); }
    }
}

public class UpdateViewingStatusRequest
{
    public ViewingStatus Status { get; set; }
}

📄 src/UniCribz.Api/Middleware/ErrorHandlingMiddleware.cs
csharp
using System.Net;
using System.Text.Json;

namespace UniCribz.Api.Middleware;

public class ErrorHandlingMiddleware
{
    private readonly RequestDelegate _next;
    private readonly ILogger<ErrorHandlingMiddleware> _logger;

    public ErrorHandlingMiddleware(RequestDelegate next, ILogger<ErrorHandlingMiddleware> logger)
    {
        _next = next;
        _logger = logger;
    }

    public async Task InvokeAsync(HttpContext context)
    {
        try
        {
            await _next(context);
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            _logger.LogError(ex, "Unhandled exception for {Method} {Path}", context.Request.Method, context.Request.Path);
            await WriteErrorAsync(context, ex);
        }
    }

    private static async Task WriteErrorAsync(HttpContext context, Exception ex)
    {
        var (status, message) = ex switch
        {
            KeyNotFoundException => (HttpStatusCode.NotFound, ex.Message),
            UnauthorizedAccessException => (HttpStatusCode.Unauthorized, ex.Message),
            InvalidOperationException => (HttpStatusCode.BadRequest, ex.Message),
            ArgumentException => (HttpStatusCode.BadRequest, ex.Message),
            _ => (HttpStatusCode.InternalServerError, "An unexpected error occurred.")
        };

        context.Response.StatusCode = (int)status;
        context.Response.ContentType = "application/json";

        var payload = JsonSerializer.Serialize(new
        {
            error = message,
            statusCode = (int)status,
            timestamp = DateTime.UtcNow
        });

        await context.Response.WriteAsync(payload);
    }
}
📄 src/UniCribz.Api/Middleware/RequestLoggingMiddleware.cs
csharp
using System.Diagnostics;

namespace UniCribz.Api.Middleware;

public class RequestLoggingMiddleware
{
    private readonly RequestDelegate _next;
    private readonly ILogger<RequestLoggingMiddleware> _logger;

    public RequestLoggingMiddleware(RequestDelegate next, ILogger<RequestLoggingMiddleware> logger)
    {
        _next = next;
        _logger = logger;
    }

    public async Task InvokeAsync(HttpContext context)
    {
        var sw = Stopwatch.StartNew();
        try
        {
            await _next(context);
        }
        finally
        {
            sw.Stop();
            _logger.LogInformation(
                "{Method} {Path} → {StatusCode} in {Elapsed}ms",
                context.Request.Method,
                context.Request.Path,
                context.Response.StatusCode,
                sw.ElapsedMilliseconds);
        }
    }
}

📄 src/UniCribz.Api/Validators/CreateApplicationRequestValidator.cs

using FluentValidation;
using UniCribz.Api.DTOs.Requests;

namespace UniCribz.Api.Validators;

public class CreateApplicationRequestValidator : AbstractValidator<CreateApplicationRequest>
{
    public CreateApplicationRequestValidator()
    {
        RuleFor(x => x.PropertyId)
            .NotEmpty().WithMessage("Property is required.");

        RuleFor(x => x.PreferredMoveInDate)
            .GreaterThan(DateTime.UtcNow).WithMessage("Move-in date must be in the future.");

        RuleFor(x => x.Notes)
            .MaximumLength(1000)
            .When(x => !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(x.Notes));
    }
}

📄 Replace src/UniCribz.Api/Extensions/ServiceCollectionExtensions.cs
csharp
using FluentValidation;
using UniCribz.Api.DTOs.Requests;
using UniCribz.Api.Services;
using UniCribz.Api.Services.Interfaces;
using UniCribz.Api.Validators;
using UniCribz.Data.Repositories;

namespace UniCribz.Api.Extensions;

public static class ServiceCollectionExtensions
{
    public static IServiceCollection AddApplicationServices(this IServiceCollection services)
    {
        // Repositories (generic — works with any entity)
        services.AddScoped(typeof(IRepository<>), typeof(Repository<>));

        // Business services
        services.AddScoped<IUserService, UserService>();
        services.AddScoped<IPropertyService, PropertyService>();
        services.AddScoped<IApplicationService, ApplicationService>();
        services.AddScoped<IViewingService, ViewingService>();

        // Validators (FluentValidation)
        services.AddScoped<IValidator<RegisterRequest>, RegisterRequestValidator>();
        services.AddScoped<IValidator<LoginRequest>, LoginRequestValidator>();
        services.AddScoped<IValidator<CreateApplicationRequest>, CreateApplicationRequestValidator>();

        return services;
    }
}

namespace UniCribz.Data.Repositories;

public interface IRepository<T> where T : class
{
    Task<T?> GetByIdAsync(Guid id);
    Task<IEnumerable<T>> GetAllAsync();
    Task<T> AddAsync(T entity);
    Task UpdateAsync(T entity);
    Task DeleteAsync(Guid id);
}
📄 src/UniCribz.Data/Repositories/Repository.cs
csharp
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using UniCribz.Data.Context;

namespace UniCribz.Data.Repositories;

public class Repository<T> : IRepository<T> where T : class
{
    private readonly UniCribzDbContext _db;
    private readonly DbSet<T> _set;

    public Repository(UniCribzDbContext db)
    {
        _db = db;
        _set = db.Set<T>();
    }

    public async Task<T?> GetByIdAsync(Guid id) => await _set.FindAsync(id);

    public async Task<IEnumerable<T>> GetAllAsync() => await _set.ToListAsync();

    public async Task<T> AddAsync(T entity)
    {
        await _set.AddAsync(entity);
        await _db.SaveChangesAsync();
        return entity;
    }

    public async Task UpdateAsync(T entity)
    {
        _set.Update(entity);
        await _db.SaveChangesAsync();
    }

    public async Task DeleteAsync(Guid id)
    {
        var entity = await GetByIdAsync(id);
        if (entity is null) return;
        _set.Remove(entity);
        await _db.SaveChangesAsync();
    }
}

I.6 Seed an admin + test data
Since you need an Admin to create properties, create the seeder. Add to src/UniCribz.Data/Seed/DataSeeder.cs:

csharp
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using UniCribz.Data.Context;
using UniCribz.Data.Entities;
using UniCribz.Data.Enums;
using UniCribz.Shared.Helpers;

namespace UniCribz.Data.Seed;

public static class DataSeeder
{
    public static async Task SeedAsync(UniCribzDbContext db)
    {
        // Admin
        if (!await db.Users.AnyAsync(u => u.Role == UserRole.Admin))
        {
            db.Users.Add(new User
            {
                FullName = "UniCribz Admin",
                Email = "admin@unicribz.co.za",
                PasswordHash = PasswordHasher.Hash("Admin@1234"),
                Role = UserRole.Admin,
                CreatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow
            });
        }

        // Universities
        if (!await db.Universities.AnyAsync())
        {
            db.Universities.AddRange(
                new University { Name = "University of Johannesburg", Acronym = "UJ", City = "Johannesburg", Latitude = -26.1929, Longitude = 28.0566 },
                new University { Name = "University of the Witwatersrand", Acronym = "Wits", City = "Johannesburg", Latitude = -26.1929, Longitude = 28.0305 },
                new University { Name = "Tshwane University of Technology", Acronym = "TUT", City = "Pretoria", Latitude = -25.7326, Longitude = 28.1624 }
            );
        }

        await db.SaveChangesAsync();
    }
}

using UniCribz.Data.Enums;

namespace UniCribz.Data.Entities;

/// <summary>
/// Base entity representing anyone who interacts with Unicribz.
/// Visitor, Tenant, and Admin share these identity fields.
/// </summary>
public class User
{
    public Guid Id { get; set; } = Guid.NewGuid();

    public string FullName { get; set; } = string.Empty;

    public string Email { get; set; } = string.Empty;

    public string PasswordHash { get; set; } = string.Empty;

    public string? PhoneNumber { get; set; }

    public UserRole Role { get; set; } = UserRole.Visitor;

    public Guid? UniversityId { get; set; }
    public University? University { get; set; }

    public string? StudentNumber { get; set; }

    /// <summary>Emergency contact name (e.g., parent/guardian).</summary>
    public string? EmergencyContactName { get; set; }

    /// <summary>Emergency contact phone number.</summary>
    public string? EmergencyContactPhone { get; set; }

    public bool IsActive { get; set; } = true;

    public DateTime CreatedAt { get; set; } = DateTime.UtcNow;
    public DateTime? UpdatedAt { get; set; }
    public DateTime? LastLoginAt { get; set; }

    // Navigation
    public Tenant? Tenant { get; set; }
    public Admin? Admin { get; set; }

    public ICollection<Application> Applications { get; set; } = new List<Application>();
    public ICollection<Viewing> Viewings { get; set; } = new List<Viewing>();
    public ICollection<Notification> Notifications { get; set; } = new List<Notification>();
}

namespace UniCribz.Data.Entities;

/// <summary>
/// A Unicribz house or building at a physical location.
/// Top-level unit that rooms, amenities, and inventory belong to.
/// </summary>
public class Property
{
    public Guid Id { get; set; } = Guid.NewGuid();

    public string Name { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    public string Description { get; set; } = string.Empty;

    public string Address { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    public string City { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    public string Province { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    public string? PostalCode { get; set; }

    public double Latitude { get; set; }
    public double Longitude { get; set; }

    /// <summary>"Mixed", "Male", "Female".</summary>
    public string GenderType { get; set; } = "Mixed";

    public decimal MonthlyPriceFrom { get; set; }
    public decimal MonthlyPriceTo { get; set; }

    public int TotalRooms { get; set; }

    /// <summary>Free-text house rules (e.g., "No smoking", "Quiet after 22:00").</summary>
    public string? HouseRules { get; set; }

    public Guid? UniversityId { get; set; }
    public University? University { get; set; }

    public bool IsActive { get; set; } = true;

    public DateTime CreatedAt { get; set; } = DateTime.UtcNow;
    public DateTime? UpdatedAt { get; set; }

    // Navigation
    public ICollection<PropertyImage> Images { get; set; } = new List<PropertyImage>();
    public ICollection<Room> Rooms { get; set; } = new List<Room>();
    public ICollection<InventoryItem> InventoryItems { get; set; } = new List<InventoryItem>();
    public ICollection<Announcement> Announcements { get; set; } = new List<Announcement>();

    /// <summary>Amenities offered at this property (M:N).</summary>
    public ICollection<Amenity> Amenities { get; set; } = new List<Amenity>();
}

namespace UniCribz.Data.Entities;

/// <summary>
/// Gallery image for a property. Replaces storing an image array on Property.
/// </summary>
public class PropertyImage
{
    public Guid Id { get; set; } = Guid.NewGuid();

    public Guid PropertyId { get; set; }
    public Property? Property { get; set; }

    public string ImageUrl { get; set; } = string.Empty;

    /// <summary>Alt text for accessibility.</summary>
    public string? Caption { get; set; }

    /// <summary>Only one image per property should be marked as primary.</summary>
    public bool IsPrimary { get; set; }

    public int SortOrder { get; set; }

    public DateTime UploadedAt { get; set; } = DateTime.UtcNow;
}

namespace UniCribz.Data.Entities;

/// <summary>
/// An individual bookable unit within a property.
/// </summary>
public class Room
{
    public Guid Id { get; set; } = Guid.NewGuid();

    public Guid PropertyId { get; set; }
    public Property? Property { get; set; }

    public string RoomNumber { get; set; } = string.Empty;

    /// <summary>"Single", "Double", "Shared", "Ensuite".</summary>
    public string Type { get; set; } = "Single";

    public int Capacity { get; set; } = 1;

    public decimal MonthlyPrice { get; set; }

    public RoomStatus Status { get; set; } = RoomStatus.Available;

    public string? Description { get; set; }

    /// <summary>Floor number (negative for basements).</summary>
    public int? Floor { get; set; }

    public DateTime CreatedAt { get; set; } = DateTime.UtcNow;
    public DateTime? UpdatedAt { get; set; }

    // Navigation
    public ICollection<Application> Applications { get; set; } = new List<Application>();
    public ICollection<Lease> Leases { get; set; } = new List<Lease>();
    public ICollection<InventoryItem> InventoryItems { get; set; } = new List<InventoryItem>();
    public ICollection<MaintenanceRequest> MaintenanceRequests { get; set; } = new List<MaintenanceRequest>();
}

    public decimal MonthlyRent { get; set; }
    public decimal? DepositAmount { get; set; }

    public LeaseStatus Status { get; set; } = LeaseStatus.PendingSignature;

    /// <summary>URL to the generated lease template PDF.</summary>

    /// <summary>URL to the signed lease PDF.</summary>
    public string? SignedLeaseUrl { get; set; }

    public DateTime? SignedAt { get; set; }
    public DateTime? TerminatedAt { get; set; }

    public string? TerminationReason { get; set; }

    public DateTime CreatedAt { get; set; } = DateTime.UtcNow;

    public ICollection<Payment> Payments { get; set; } = new List<Payment>();

using UniCribz.Data.Enums;

namespace UniCribz.Data.Entities;

/// <summary>
/// A rental charge and its settlement record — what is owed, by when,
/// and proof that it was paid.
/// </summary>
public class Payment
{
    public Guid Id { get; set; } = Guid.NewGuid();

    public Guid LeaseId { get; set; }
    public Lease? Lease { get; set; }

    /// <summary>Period this payment covers (e.g., month billed).</summary>
    public DateTime BillingPeriodStart { get; set; }
    public DateTime BillingPeriodEnd { get; set; }

    public decimal AmountDue { get; set; }
    public decimal AmountPaid { get; set; }

    public DateTime DueDate { get; set; }
    public DateTime? PaidAt { get; set; }

    public PaymentStatus Status { get; set; } = PaymentStatus.Pending;

    /// <summary>URL to uploaded proof of payment (in Blob Storage).</summary>
    public string? ProofOfPaymentUrl { get; set; }

    /// <summary>URL to generated receipt PDF.</summary>
    public string? ReceiptUrl { get; set; }

    /// <summary>Payment method (e.g., "EFT", "Card", "Cash").</summary>
    public string? PaymentMethod { get; set; }

    /// <summary>External gateway reference (Stripe/PayFast session ID).</summary>
    public string? GatewayReference { get; set; }

    public Guid? VerifiedByUserId { get; set; }
    public DateTime? VerifiedAt { get; set; }

    public string? Notes { get; set; }

    public DateTime CreatedAt { get; set; } = DateTime.UtcNow;
    public DateTime? UpdatedAt { get; set; }

📂 Step 3: Update DbContext with All DbSets
📄 Replace src/UniCribz.Data/Context/UniCribzDbContext.cs
csharp
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using UniCribz.Data.Entities;

namespace UniCribz.Data.Context;

public class UniCribzDbContext : DbContext
{
    public UniCribzDbContext(DbContextOptions<UniCribzDbContext> options)
        : base(options) { }

    // Identity
    public DbSet<User> Users => Set<User>();
    public DbSet<Visitor> Visitors => Set<Visitor>();
    public DbSet<Tenant> Tenants => Set<Tenant>();
    public DbSet<Admin> Admins => Set<Admin>();
    public DbSet<University> Universities => Set<University>();

    // Property
    public DbSet<Property> Properties => Set<Property>();
    public DbSet<PropertyImage> PropertyImages => Set<PropertyImage>();
    public DbSet<Amenity> Amenities => Set<Amenity>();
    public DbSet<Room> Rooms => Set<Room>();
    public DbSet<InventoryItem> InventoryItems => Set<InventoryItem>();

    // Applications & Viewings
    public DbSet<Application> Applications => Set<Application>();
    public DbSet<ApplicationDocument> ApplicationDocuments => Set<ApplicationDocument>();
    public DbSet<Viewing> Viewings => Set<Viewing>();

    // Lease & Payments
    public DbSet<Lease> Leases => Set<Lease>();
    public DbSet<Payment> Payments => Set<Payment>();

    // Maintenance & Complaints
    public DbSet<MaintenanceRequest> MaintenanceRequests => Set<MaintenanceRequest>();
    public DbSet<MaintenancePhoto> MaintenancePhotos => Set<MaintenancePhoto>();
    public DbSet<Complaint> Complaints => Set<Complaint>();

    // Communications
    public DbSet<Announcement> Announcements => Set<Announcement>();
    public DbSet<Notification> Notifications => Set<Notification>();
    public DbSet<Document> Documents => Set<Document>();

    protected override void OnModelCreating(ModelBuilder modelBuilder)
    {
        base.OnModelCreating(modelBuilder);
        modelBuilder.ApplyConfigurationsFromAssembly(typeof(UniCribzDbContext).Assembly);
    }
}
📂 Step 4: Configuration Classes
You don't need one for every entity — EF Core conventions handle most cases. But you do need these 8 configurations for the important relationships. Create each in src/UniCribz.Data/Configurations/.

📄 UserConfiguration.cs
csharp
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.Metadata.Builders;
using UniCribz.Data.Entities;

namespace UniCribz.Data.Configurations;

public class UserConfiguration : IEntityTypeConfiguration<User>
{
    public void Configure(EntityTypeBuilder<User> builder)
    {
        builder.ToTable("Users");
        builder.HasKey(u => u.Id);

        builder.Property(u => u.FullName).IsRequired().HasMaxLength(150);
        builder.Property(u => u.Email).IsRequired().HasMaxLength(255);
        builder.HasIndex(u => u.Email).IsUnique();
        builder.Property(u => u.PasswordHash).IsRequired().HasMaxLength(255);
        builder.Property(u => u.PhoneNumber).HasMaxLength(20);
        builder.Property(u => u.StudentNumber).HasMaxLength(50);
        builder.Property(u => u.EmergencyContactName).HasMaxLength(150);
        builder.Property(u => u.EmergencyContactPhone).HasMaxLength(20);
        builder.Property(u => u.Role).HasConversion<string>().HasMaxLength(20);

        builder.HasOne(u => u.University)
               .WithMany()
               .HasForeignKey(u => u.UniversityId)
               .OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.SetNull);

        builder.HasIndex(u => u.Role);
    }
}
📄 PropertyConfiguration.cs
csharp
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.Metadata.Builders;
using UniCribz.Data.Entities;

namespace UniCribz.Data.Configurations;

public class PropertyConfiguration : IEntityTypeConfiguration<Property>
{
    public void Configure(EntityTypeBuilder<Property> builder)
    {
        builder.ToTable("Properties");
        builder.HasKey(p => p.Id);

        builder.Property(p => p.Name).IsRequired().HasMaxLength(200);
        builder.Property(p => p.Description).HasMaxLength(2000);
        builder.Property(p => p.Address).IsRequired().HasMaxLength(500);
        builder.Property(p => p.City).IsRequired().HasMaxLength(100);
        builder.Property(p => p.Province).HasMaxLength(100);
        builder.Property(p => p.PostalCode).HasMaxLength(20);
        builder.Property(p => p.GenderType).IsRequired().HasMaxLength(20);
        builder.Property(p => p.HouseRules).HasMaxLength(2000);
        builder.Property(p => p.MonthlyPriceFrom).HasPrecision(18, 2);
        builder.Property(p => p.MonthlyPriceTo).HasPrecision(18, 2);

        builder.HasIndex(p => p.City);
        builder.HasIndex(p => p.UniversityId);

        builder.HasOne(p => p.University)
               .WithMany(u => u.NearbyProperties)
               .HasForeignKey(p => p.UniversityId)
               .OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.SetNull);

        builder.HasMany(p => p.Rooms)
               .WithOne(r => r.Property!)
               .HasForeignKey(r => r.PropertyId)
               .OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Cascade);

        builder.HasMany(p => p.Images)
               .WithOne(i => i.Property!)
               .HasForeignKey(i => i.PropertyId)
               .OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Cascade);

        builder.HasMany(p => p.Amenities)
               .WithMany(a => a.Properties)
               .UsingEntity(j => j.ToTable("PropertyAmenities"));
    }
}
📄 RoomConfiguration.cs
csharp
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.Metadata.Builders;
using UniCribz.Data.Entities;

namespace UniCribz.Data.Configurations;

public class RoomConfiguration : IEntityTypeConfiguration<Room>
{
    public void Configure(EntityTypeBuilder<Room> builder)
    {
        builder.ToTable("Rooms");
        builder.HasKey(r => r.Id);

        builder.Property(r => r.RoomNumber).IsRequired().HasMaxLength(20);
        builder.Property(r => r.Type).IsRequired().HasMaxLength(20);
        builder.Property(r => r.Description).HasMaxLength(500);
        builder.Property(r => r.MonthlyPrice).HasPrecision(18, 2);
        builder.Property(r => r.Status).HasConversion<string>().HasMaxLength(30);

        builder.HasIndex(r => new { r.PropertyId, r.RoomNumber }).IsUnique();
        builder.HasIndex(r => r.Status);
    }
}
📄 ApplicationConfiguration.cs
csharp
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.Metadata.Builders;
using UniCribz.Data.Entities;

namespace UniCribz.Data.Configurations;

public class ApplicationConfiguration : IEntityTypeConfiguration<Application>
{
    public void Configure(EntityTypeBuilder<Application> builder)
    {
        builder.ToTable("Applications");
        builder.HasKey(a => a.Id);

        builder.Property(a => a.PreferredRoomType).HasMaxLength(50);
        builder.Property(a => a.Notes).HasMaxLength(1000);
        builder.Property(a => a.AdminNotes).HasMaxLength(1000);
        builder.Property(a => a.Status).HasConversion<string>().HasMaxLength(30);

        builder.HasIndex(a => a.UserId);
        builder.HasIndex(a => a.Status);

        builder.HasOne(a => a.User)
               .WithMany(u => u.Applications)
               .HasForeignKey(a => a.UserId)
               .OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Restrict);

        builder.HasOne(a => a.Property)
               .WithMany()
               .HasForeignKey(a => a.PropertyId)
               .OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Restrict);

        builder.HasOne(a => a.Room)
               .WithMany(r => r.Applications)
               .HasForeignKey(a => a.RoomId)
               .OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.SetNull);

        builder.HasMany(a => a.Documents)
               .WithOne(d => d.Application!)

using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.Metadata.Builders;
using UniCribz.Data.Entities;

namespace UniCribz.Data.Configurations;

public class AmenityConfiguration : IEntityTypeConfiguration<Amenity>
{
    public void Configure(EntityTypeBuilder<Amenity> builder)
    {
        builder.ToTable("Amenities");
        builder.HasKey(a => a.Id);

        builder.Property(a => a.Name).IsRequired().HasMaxLength(100);
        builder.Property(a => a.Icon).HasMaxLength(50);
        builder.Property(a => a.Category).HasMaxLength(50);

        builder.HasIndex(a => a.Name).IsUnique();

        // Many-to-many with Property via explicit join table
        builder.HasMany(a => a.Properties)
               .WithMany(p => p.Amenities)
               .UsingEntity<Dictionary<string, object>>(
                   "PropertyAmenities",
                   j => j.HasOne<Property>().WithMany().HasForeignKey("PropertyId").OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Cascade),
                   j => j.HasOne<Amenity>().WithMany().HasForeignKey("AmenityId").OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Cascade),
                   j =>
                   {
                       j.ToTable("PropertyAmenities");
                       j.HasKey("PropertyId", "AmenityId");
                   });
    }
}

📄 User.cs (base class — now abstract for TPH inheritance)
csharp
using UniCribz.Data.Enums;

namespace UniCribz.Data.Entities;

/// <summary>
/// Base entity for everyone who interacts with Unicribz.
/// Uses EF Core TPH inheritance — Visitor, Tenant, Admin all live in the Users table
/// with a Discriminator column distinguishing the concrete type.
/// </summary>
public abstract class User
{
    public Guid Id { get; set; } = Guid.NewGuid();

    public string FullName { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    public string Email { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    public string? PhoneNumber { get; set; }
    public string PasswordHash { get; set; } = string.Empty;

    public UserRole Role { get; set; } = UserRole.Visitor;
    public bool EmailVerified { get; set; }

    public Guid? UniversityId { get; set; }
    public University? University { get; set; }

    public string? StudentNumber { get; set; }

    public DateTime CreatedAt { get; set; } = DateTime.UtcNow;
    public DateTime? UpdatedAt { get; set; }
    public DateTime? LastLoginAt { get; set; }

    // Navigations
    public ICollection<Application> Applications { get; set; } = new List<Application>();
    public ICollection<Viewing> Viewings { get; set; } = new List<Viewing>();
    public ICollection<Notification> Notifications { get; set; } = new List<Notification>();
}

csharp
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.Metadata.Builders;
using UniCribz.Data.Entities;

namespace UniCribz.Data.Configurations;

public class UserConfiguration : IEntityTypeConfiguration<User>
{
    public void Configure(EntityTypeBuilder<User> builder)
    {
        builder.ToTable("Users");
        builder.HasKey(u => u.Id);

        builder.Property(u => u.FullName).IsRequired().HasMaxLength(150);
        builder.Property(u => u.Email).IsRequired().HasMaxLength(255);
        builder.HasIndex(u => u.Email).IsUnique();
        builder.Property(u => u.PasswordHash).IsRequired().HasMaxLength(255);
        builder.Property(u => u.PhoneNumber).HasMaxLength(20);
        builder.Property(u => u.StudentNumber).HasMaxLength(50);
        builder.Property(u => u.Role).HasConversion<string>().HasMaxLength(20);

        builder.HasOne(u => u.University)
               .WithMany()
               .HasForeignKey(u => u.UniversityId)
               .OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.SetNull);

        builder.HasIndex(u => u.Role);

        // TPH discriminator — Visitor / Tenant / Admin
        builder.HasDiscriminator<string>("UserType")
               .HasValue<Visitor>("Visitor")
               .HasValue<Tenant>("Tenant")
               .HasValue<Admin>("Admin");
    }
}

using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;

namespace UniCribz.Data.Context;

public class UniCribzDbContext : DbContext
{
    public UniCribzDbContext(DbContextOptions<UniCribzDbContext> options)
        : base(options) { }

    // Identity
    public DbSet<User> Users => Set<User>();
    public DbSet<Visitor> Visitors => Set<Visitor>();

    public DbSet<Room> Rooms => Set<Room>();
    public DbSet<InventoryItem> InventoryItems => Set<InventoryItem>();

    // Applications & Viewings
    public DbSet<Application> Applications => Set<Application>();
    public DbSet<ApplicationDocument> ApplicationDocuments => Set<ApplicationDocument>();
    public DbSet<Viewing> Viewings => Set<Viewing>();

    public DbSet<Payment> Payments => Set<Payment>();

    // Maintenance & Complaints

    public DbSet<Complaint> Complaints => Set<Complaint>();

    public DbSet<Notification> Notifications => Set<Notification>();
    public DbSet<Document> Documents => Set<Document>();

    {
        base.OnModelCreating(modelBuilder);
        modelBuilder.ApplyConfigurationsFromAssembly(typeof(UniCribzDbContext).Assembly);
    }

fix these: using System.IdentityModel.Tokens.Jwt;
using System.Security.Claims;
using System.Text;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration;
using Microsoft.IdentityModel.Tokens;
using UniCribz.Data.Entities;

namespace UniCribz.Shared.Helpers;

// Generates signed JWT access tokens for authenticated users.
public static class JwtTokenGenerator
{
    public static (string Token, DateTime ExpiresAt) Generate(User user, IConfiguration config)
    {
        var key = config["Jwt:Key"]
                  ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("Jwt:Key is not configured.");
        var issuer = config["Jwt:Issuer"] ?? "UniCribz";
        var audience = config["Jwt:Audience"] ?? "UniCribzClients";
        var expiryMinutes = int.TryParse(config["Jwt:ExpiryMinutes"], out var m) ? m : 60;

        var expiresAt = DateTime.UtcNow.AddMinutes(expiryMinutes);

        var claims = new[]
        {
            new Claim(JwtRegisteredClaimNames.Sub, user.Id.ToString()),
            new Claim(JwtRegisteredClaimNames.Email, user.Email),
            new Claim(JwtRegisteredClaimNames.Name, user.FullName),
            new Claim(ClaimTypes.Role, user.Role.ToString()),
            new Claim(JwtRegisteredClaimNames.Jti, Guid.NewGuid().ToString()),
            new Claim("role", user.Role.ToString())
        };

        var signingKey = new SymmetricSecurityKey(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(key));
        var credentials = new SigningCredentials(signingKey, SecurityAlgorithms.HmacSha256);

        var token = new JwtSecurityToken(
            issuer: issuer,
            audience: audience,
            claims: claims,
            expires: expiresAt,
            signingCredentials: credentials);

        return (new JwtSecurityTokenHandler().WriteToken(token), expiresAt);
    }
}

📄 Fix 1 — src/UniCribz.Api/Services/UserService.cs
Only change: new User → new Visitor (since public registration creates a Visitor by default).

csharp
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using UniCribz.Api.DTOs.Requests;
using UniCribz.Api.DTOs.Responses;
using UniCribz.Api.Services.Interfaces;
using UniCribz.Data.Context;
using UniCribz.Data.Entities;
using UniCribz.Data.Enums;
using UniCribz.Shared.Helpers;

namespace UniCribz.Api.Services;

public class UserService : IUserService
{
    private readonly UniCribzDbContext _db;
    private readonly IConfiguration _config;
    private readonly ILogger<UserService> _logger;

    public UserService(UniCribzDbContext db, IConfiguration config, ILogger<UserService> logger)
    {
        _db = db;
        _config = config;
        _logger = logger;
    }

    public async Task<AuthResponse> RegisterAsync(RegisterRequest request)
    {
        var email = request.Email.Trim().ToLowerInvariant();

        var exists = await _db.Users.AnyAsync(u => u.Email == email);
        if (exists)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("An account with this email already exists.");

        if (request.Password != request.ConfirmPassword)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("Passwords do not match.");

        // ✅ FIXED: User is abstract — instantiate a Visitor (default role for public registration)
        var user = new Visitor
        {
            FullName = request.FullName.Trim(),
            Email = email,
            PhoneNumber = request.PhoneNumber?.Trim(),
            StudentNumber = request.StudentNumber?.Trim(),
            PasswordHash = PasswordHasher.Hash(request.Password),
            Role = UserRole.Visitor,
            EmailVerified = false,
            CreatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow
        };

        _db.Users.Add(user);
        await _db.SaveChangesAsync();

        _logger.LogInformation("New user registered: {Email} (Role: {Role})", user.Email, user.Role);

        return BuildAuthResponse(user);
    }

    public async Task<AuthResponse> LoginAsync(LoginRequest request)
    {
        var email = request.Email.Trim().ToLowerInvariant();

        var user = await _db.Users.FirstOrDefaultAsync(u => u.Email == email)
                   ?? throw new UnauthorizedAccessException("Invalid email or password.");

        if (!PasswordHasher.Verify(request.Password, user.PasswordHash))
            throw new UnauthorizedAccessException("Invalid email or password.");

        user.LastLoginAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
        await _db.SaveChangesAsync();

        _logger.LogInformation("User logged in: {Email}", user.Email);

        return BuildAuthResponse(user);
    }

    public async Task<AuthResponse?> GetCurrentUserAsync(Guid userId)
    {
        var user = await _db.Users.FindAsync(userId);
        return user is null ? null : BuildAuthResponse(user);
    }

    private AuthResponse BuildAuthResponse(User user)
    {
        var (token, expiresAt) = JwtTokenGenerator.Generate(user, _config);

        return new AuthResponse
        {
            Token = token,
            ExpiresAt = expiresAt,
            UserId = user.Id,
            FullName = user.FullName,
            Email = user.Email,
            Role = user.Role.ToString()
        };
    }
}
📄 Fix 2 — src/UniCribz.Shared/Helpers/JwtTokenGenerator.cs
Changes:

Remove the duplicate "role" short claim

Remove the duplicate JwtRegisteredClaimNames.Sub (redundant with ClaimTypes.NameIdentifier)

Use ClaimTypes.NameIdentifier directly so User.FindFirstValue(ClaimTypes.NameIdentifier) works reliably

csharp
using System.IdentityModel.Tokens.Jwt;
using System.Security.Claims;
using System.Text;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration;
using Microsoft.IdentityModel.Tokens;
using UniCribz.Data.Entities;

namespace UniCribz.Shared.Helpers;

/// <summary>
/// Generates signed JWT access tokens for authenticated users.
/// </summary>
public static class JwtTokenGenerator
{
    public static (string Token, DateTime ExpiresAt) Generate(User user, IConfiguration config)
    {
        var key = config["Jwt:Key"]
                  ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("Jwt:Key is not configured.");
        var issuer = config["Jwt:Issuer"] ?? "UniCribz";
        var audience = config["Jwt:Audience"] ?? "UniCribzClients";
        var expiryMinutes = int.TryParse(config["Jwt:ExpiryMinutes"], out var m) ? m : 60;

        var expiresAt = DateTime.UtcNow.AddMinutes(expiryMinutes);

        var claims = new[]
        {
            new Claim(JwtRegisteredClaimNames.Sub, user.Id.ToString()),
            new Claim(ClaimTypes.NameIdentifier, user.Id.ToString()),   // <-- important for FindFirstValue
            new Claim(JwtRegisteredClaimNames.Email, user.Email),
            new Claim(ClaimTypes.Email, user.Email),
            new Claim(JwtRegisteredClaimNames.Name, user.FullName),
            new Claim(ClaimTypes.Role, user.Role.ToString()),           // used by [Authorize(Roles=...)] and User.IsInRole
            new Claim(JwtRegisteredClaimNames.Jti, Guid.NewGuid().ToString())
        };

        var signingKey = new SymmetricSecurityKey(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(key));
        var credentials = new SigningCredentials(signingKey, SecurityAlgorithms.HmacSha256);

        var token = new JwtSecurityToken(
            issuer: issuer,
            audience: audience,
            claims: claims,
            expires: expiresAt,
            signingCredentials: credentials);

        return (new JwtSecurityTokenHandler().WriteToken(token), expiresAt);
    }
}
