}
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using UniCribz.Data.Context;
using UniCribz.Data.Entities;

namespace UniCribz.Data.Repositories;

public class PropertyRepository : Repository<Property>, IPropertyRepository
{
    public PropertyRepository(UniCribzDbContext db) : base(db) { }

    public async Task<Property?> GetWithDetailsAsync(Guid id)
        => await Set
            .Include(p => p.Rooms)
            .Include(p => p.Images)
            .Include(p => p.Amenities)
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync(p => p.Id == id);

    public async Task<IEnumerable<Property>> SearchAsync(
        string? city = null,
        string? suburb = null,
        string? propertyType = null,
        decimal? maxRent = null,
        Guid? nearUniversityId = null)
    {
        var query = Set
            .AsNoTracking()
            .Include(p => p.Rooms)
            .Include(p => p.Amenities)
            .Where(p => p.IsActive);

        if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(city))
            query = query.Where(p => p.City.ToLower() == city.ToLower());

        if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(suburb))
            query = query.Where(p => p.Suburb.ToLower() == suburb.ToLower());

        if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(propertyType))
            query = query.Where(p => p.PropertyType == propertyType);

        if (maxRent.HasValue)
            query = query.Where(p => p.Rooms.Any(r => r.MonthlyRent <= maxRent.Value));

        
        if (nearUniversityId.HasValue)
        {
            var uni = await Db.Universities.AsNoTracking()
                                           .FirstOrDefaultAsync(u => u.Id == nearUniversityId.Value);
            if (uni is not null)
                query = query.Where(p => p.City == uni.City);
        }

        return await query.ToListAsync();
    }
}
using System.Linq.Expressions;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using UniCribz.Data.Context;

namespace UniCribz.Data.Repositories;

/// <summary>
/// EF Core implementation of <see cref="IRepository{T}"/>.
/// Never calls SaveChanges automatically — services decide when to commit.
/// </summary>
public class Repository<T> : IRepository<T> where T : class
{
    protected readonly UniCribzDbContext Db;
    protected readonly DbSet<T> Set;

    public Repository(UniCribzDbContext db)
    {
        Db = db;
        Set = db.Set<T>();
    }

    public virtual async Task<T?> GetByIdAsync(Guid id)
        => await Set.FindAsync(id);

    public virtual async Task<IEnumerable<T>> GetAllAsync()
        => await Set.AsNoTracking().ToListAsync();

    public virtual async Task<IEnumerable<T>> FindAsync(Expression<Func<T, bool>> predicate)
        => await Set.AsNoTracking().Where(predicate).ToListAsync();

    public virtual async Task<T> AddAsync(T entity)
    {
        await Set.AddAsync(entity);
        return entity;
    }

    public virtual async Task AddRangeAsync(IEnumerable<T> entities)
        => await Set.AddRangeAsync(entities);

    public virtual void Update(T entity)
        => Set.Update(entity);

    public virtual void Remove(T entity)
        => Set.Remove(entity);

    public virtual async Task DeleteAsync(Guid id)
    {
        var entity = await Set.FindAsync(id);
        if (entity is not null)
            Set.Remove(entity);
    }

    public virtual async Task<int> CountAsync()
        => await Set.CountAsync();

    public virtual async Task<int> CountAsync(Expression<Func<T, bool>> predicate)
        => await Set.CountAsync(predicate);

    public virtual async Task<bool> ExistsAsync(Guid id)
        => await Set.FindAsync(id) is not null;

    public virtual async Task<int> SaveChangesAsync()
        => await Db.SaveChangesAsync();
}
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using UniCribz.Data.Context;
using UniCribz.Data.Entities;
using UniCribz.Data.Enums;

namespace UniCribz.Data.Repositories;

public class UserRepository : Repository<User>, IUserRepository
{
    public UserRepository(UniCribzDbContext db) : base(db) { }

    public async Task<User?> GetByEmailAsync(string email)
        => await Set.FirstOrDefaultAsync(u => u.Email == email);

    public async Task<IEnumerable<User>> GetByRoleAsync(UserRole role)
        => await Set.AsNoTracking()
                    .Where(u => u.Role == role)
                    .ToListAsync();

    public async Task<IEnumerable<Tenant>> GetTenantsByPropertyAsync(Guid propertyId)
     => await Db.Tenants
                .AsNoTracking()
                .Where(t => Db.Leases.Any(l =>
                        l.TenantId == t.Id && l.Room.PropertyId == propertyId))
                .ToListAsync();

    public async Task<bool> EmailExistsAsync(string email)
        => await Set.AnyAsync(u => u.Email == email);
}

namespace UniCribz.Data.Seed;


/// Idempotent demo data for local development. Safe to call on every startup —
/// short-circuits if any user already exists.

public static class DataSeeder
{
 
    private const string AdminEmail = "admin@unicribz.co.za";
    private const string TenantEmail = "tenant@unicribz.co.za";
    private const string VisitorEmail = "visitor@unicribz.co.za";
    private const string DemoPassword = "Admin@123";

    public static async Task SeedAsync(UniCribzDbContext db)
    {
        if (await db.Users.AnyAsync())
            return;   // already seeded

        var hash = BCrypt.Net.BCrypt.HashPassword(DemoPassword);

        // ---------- Universities ----------
        var uj = new University { Name = "University of Johannesburg", Abbreviation = "UJ", City = "Johannesburg", Province = "Gauteng", Latitude = -26.1836, Longitude = 27.9970, Website = "https://www.uj.ac.za" };
        var wits = new University { Name = "University of the Witwatersrand", Abbreviation = "Wits", City = "Johannesburg", Province = "Gauteng", Latitude = -26.1929, Longitude = 28.0305, Website = "https://www.wits.ac.za" };
        var tut = new University { Name = "Tshwane University of Technology", Abbreviation = "TUT", City = "Pretoria", Province = "Gauteng", Latitude = -25.7329, Longitude = 28.1617, Website = "https://www.tut.ac.za" };
        db.Universities.AddRange(uj, wits, tut);

        // ---------- Admin ----------
        var admin = new Admin
        {
            FullName = "System Administrator",
            Email = AdminEmail,
            PhoneNumber = "0100000000",
            PasswordHash = hash,
            Role = UserRole.Admin,
            EmailVerified = true,
            EmployeeNumber = "EMP0001",
            Department = "Operations"
        };
        db.Users.Add(admin);

        // ---------- Tenant (for dashboard testing) ----------
        var tenant = new Tenant
        {
            FullName = "Thandi Mokoena",
            Email = TenantEmail,
            PhoneNumber = "0821111111",
            PasswordHash = hash,
            Role = UserRole.Tenant,
            EmailVerified = true,
            University = uj,
            StudentNumber = "ST10440807",
            EmergencyContactName = "Sipho Mokoena",
            EmergencyContactPhone = "0829999999"
        };
        db.Users.Add(tenant);

        // ---------- Visitor (for application flow testing) ----------
        var visitor = new Visitor
        {

Actually, looking again, EF Core doesn't require the base to be abstract — the base becomes a valid entity type. But when you save a base User, the discriminator value will be NULL or the base type name depending on config.

9. src/UniCribz.Api/Services/UserService.cs
Only change: new User → new Visitor, and PhoneNumber defaults to "".

csharp
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using UniCribz.Api.DTOs.Requests;
using UniCribz.Api.DTOs.Responses;
using UniCribz.Api.Services.Interfaces;
using UniCribz.Data.Context;
using UniCribz.Data.Entities;
using UniCribz.Data.Enums;
using UniCribz.Shared.Helpers;

namespace UniCribz.Api.Services;

public class UserService : IUserService
{
    private readonly UniCribzDbContext _db;
    private readonly IConfiguration _config;
    private readonly ILogger<UserService> _logger;

    public UserService(UniCribzDbContext db, IConfiguration config, ILogger<UserService> logger)
    {
        _db = db;
        _config = config;
        _logger = logger;
    }

    public async Task<AuthResponse> RegisterAsync(RegisterRequest request)
    {
        var email = request.Email.Trim().ToLowerInvariant();

        var exists = await _db.Users.AnyAsync(u => u.Email == email);
        if (exists)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("An account with this email already exists.");

        if (request.Password != request.ConfirmPassword)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("Passwords do not match.");

        // Register as Visitor (public signup default) — StudentNumber is on Visitor, not User
        var user = new Visitor
        {
            FullName = request.FullName.Trim(),
            Email = email,
            PhoneNumber = request.PhoneNumber?.Trim() ?? string.Empty,
            StudentNumber = request.StudentNumber?.Trim() ?? string.Empty,
            PasswordHash = PasswordHasher.Hash(request.Password),
            Role = UserRole.Visitor,
            EmailVerified = false,
            IsActive = true,
            CreatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow
        };

        _db.Users.Add(user);
        await _db.SaveChangesAsync();

        _logger.LogInformation("New user registered: {Email}", user.Email);
        return BuildAuthResponse(user);
    }

    public async Task<AuthResponse> LoginAsync(LoginRequest request)
    {
        var email = request.Email.Trim().ToLowerInvariant();

        var user = await _db.Users.FirstOrDefaultAsync(u => u.Email == email)
                   ?? throw new UnauthorizedAccessException("Invalid email or password.");

        if (!PasswordHasher.Verify(request.Password, user.PasswordHash))
            throw new UnauthorizedAccessException("Invalid email or password.");

        user.LastLoginAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
        await _db.SaveChangesAsync();

        _logger.LogInformation("User logged in: {Email}", user.Email);
        return BuildAuthResponse(user);
    }

    public async Task<AuthResponse?> GetCurrentUserAsync(Guid userId)
    {
        var user = await _db.Users.FindAsync(userId);
        return user is null ? null : BuildAuthResponse(user);
    }

    private AuthResponse BuildAuthResponse(User user)
    {
        var (token, expiresAt) = JwtTokenGenerator.Generate(
            user.Id,
            user.Email,
            user.FullName,
            user.Role.ToString(),
            _config);

        return new AuthResponse
        {
            Token = token,
            ExpiresAt = expiresAt,
            UserId = user.Id,
            FullName = user.FullName,
            Email = user.Email,
            Role = user.Role.ToString()
        };
    }
}
10. src/UniCribz.Api/Services/PropertyService.cs
csharp
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using UniCribz.Api.DTOs.Requests;
using UniCribz.Api.DTOs.Responses;
using UniCribz.Api.Services.Interfaces;
using UniCribz.Data.Context;
using UniCribz.Data.Entities;
using UniCribz.Data.Enums;

namespace UniCribz.Api.Services;

public class PropertyService : IPropertyService
{
    private readonly UniCribzDbContext _db;
    private readonly ILogger<PropertyService> _logger;

    public PropertyService(UniCribzDbContext db, ILogger<PropertyService> logger)
    {
        _db = db;
        _logger = logger;
    }

    public async Task<IEnumerable<PropertyResponse>> SearchAsync(
        string? city, Guid? universityId, string? genderType,
        decimal? minPrice, decimal? maxPrice)
    {
        var query = _db.Properties
            .Include(p => p.Images)
            .Include(p => p.Rooms)
            .Where(p => p.IsActive)
            .AsQueryable();

        if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(city))
            query = query.Where(p => p.City.ToLower() == city.ToLower());

        // universityId/genderType/price filters are not supported by the current
        // Property entity — add these fields later if needed.

        if (maxPrice.HasValue)
            query = query.Where(p => p.Rooms.Any(r => r.MonthlyRent <= maxPrice.Value));

        var properties = await query.OrderBy(p => p.Name).ToListAsync();
        return properties.Select(MapToResponse);
    }

    public async Task<PropertyResponse?> GetByIdAsync(Guid id)
    {
        var property = await _db.Properties
            .Include(p => p.Images)
            .Include(p => p.Rooms)
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync(p => p.Id == id);

        return property is null ? null : MapToResponse(property);
    }

    public async Task<PropertyResponse> CreateAsync(CreatePropertyRequest request)
    {
        var property = new Property
        {
            Name = request.Name.Trim(),
            Description = request.Description.Trim(),
            AddressLine1 = request.AddressLine1.Trim(),
            Suburb = request.Suburb.Trim(),
            City = request.City.Trim(),
            Province = request.Province.Trim(),
            PostalCode = request.PostalCode?.Trim() ?? string.Empty,
            Latitude = request.Latitude,
            Longitude = request.Longitude,
            PropertyType = request.PropertyType,
            AdminId = request.AdminId,
            IsActive = true,
            CreatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow
        };

        _db.Properties.Add(property);
        await _db.SaveChangesAsync();

        _logger.LogInformation("Property created: {Name} ({Id})", property.Name, property.Id);
        return await GetByIdAsync(property.Id)
               ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("Failed to reload property.");
    }

    public async Task<PropertyResponse> UpdateAsync(Guid id, CreatePropertyRequest request)
    {
        var property = await _db.Properties.FindAsync(id)
            ?? throw new KeyNotFoundException($"Property {id} not found.");

        property.Name = request.Name.Trim();
        property.Description = request.Description.Trim();
        property.AddressLine1 = request.AddressLine1.Trim();
        property.Suburb = request.Suburb.Trim();
        property.City = request.City.Trim();
        property.Province = request.Province.Trim();
        property.PostalCode = request.PostalCode?.Trim() ?? string.Empty;
        property.Latitude = request.Latitude;
        property.Longitude = request.Longitude;
        property.PropertyType = request.PropertyType;
        property.AdminId = request.AdminId;
        property.UpdatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;

        await _db.SaveChangesAsync();
        return await GetByIdAsync(id)
               ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("Failed to reload property.");
    }

    public async Task DeleteAsync(Guid id)
    {
        var property = await _db.Properties.FindAsync(id)
            ?? throw new KeyNotFoundException($"Property {id} not found.");

        _db.Properties.Remove(property);
        await _db.SaveChangesAsync();
        _logger.LogInformation("Property deleted: {Id}", id);
    }

    public async Task<IEnumerable<RoomResponse>> GetRoomsAsync(Guid propertyId)
    {
        var exists = await _db.Properties.AnyAsync(p => p.Id == propertyId);
        if (!exists) throw new KeyNotFoundException($"Property {propertyId} not found.");

        var rooms = await _db.Rooms
            .Where(r => r.PropertyId == propertyId)
            .OrderBy(r => r.RoomNumber)
            .ToListAsync();

        return rooms.Select(MapToRoomResponse);
    }

    public async Task<RoomResponse> AddRoomAsync(Guid propertyId, CreateRoomRequest request)
    {
        var property = await _db.Properties.FindAsync(propertyId)
            ?? throw new KeyNotFoundException($"Property {propertyId} not found.");

        var room = new Room
        {
            PropertyId = propertyId,
            RoomNumber = request.RoomNumber.Trim(),
            Floor = request.Floor,
            Type = request.Type,
            Capacity = request.Capacity,
            MonthlyRent = request.MonthlyRent,
            Status = RoomStatus.Available,
            CreatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow
        };

        _db.Rooms.Add(room);
        property.TotalRooms += 1;
        await _db.SaveChangesAsync();

        return MapToRoomResponse(room);
    }

    private static PropertyResponse MapToResponse(Property p) => new()
    {
        Id = p.Id,
        Name = p.Name,
        Description = p.Description,
        Address = $"{p.AddressLine1}, {p.Suburb}, {p.City}",
        City = p.City,
        Latitude = p.Latitude ?? 0,
        Longitude = p.Longitude ?? 0,
        TotalRooms = p.TotalRooms,
        AvailableRooms = p.Rooms.Count(r => r.Status == RoomStatus.Available),
        ImageUrls = p.Images.OrderBy(i => i.DisplayOrder).Select(i => i.ImageUrl).ToList(),
        CreatedAt = p.CreatedAt
    };

    private static RoomResponse MapToRoomResponse(Room r) => new()
    {
        Id = r.Id,
        PropertyId = r.PropertyId,
        RoomNumber = r.RoomNumber,
        Type = r.Type,
        Capacity = r.Capacity,
        MonthlyRent = r.MonthlyRent,
        Status = r.Status.ToString()
    };
}

using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using UniCribz.Api.DTOs.Requests;
using UniCribz.Api.DTOs.Responses;
using UniCribz.Api.Services.Interfaces;
using UniCribz.Data.Context;
using UniCribz.Data.Entities;
using UniCribz.Data.Enums;

namespace UniCribz.Api.Services;

public class ApplicationService : IApplicationService
{
    private readonly UniCribzDbContext _db;
    private readonly ILogger<ApplicationService> _logger;

    public ApplicationService(UniCribzDbContext db, ILogger<ApplicationService> logger)
    {
        _db = db;
        _logger = logger;
    }

    public async Task<ApplicationResponse> CreateAsync(CreateApplicationRequest request, Guid userId)
    {
        var property = await _db.Properties.FindAsync(request.PropertyId)
            ?? throw new KeyNotFoundException("Property not found.");

        var visitor = await _db.Visitors.FirstOrDefaultAsync(v => v.Id == userId)
            ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("Only registered visitors can submit applications.");

        if (request.RoomId.HasValue)
        {
            var room = await _db.Rooms.FindAsync(request.RoomId.Value)
                ?? throw new KeyNotFoundException("Room not found.");
            if (room.PropertyId != property.Id)
                throw new InvalidOperationException("Room does not belong to the selected property.");
        }

        var application = new Application
        {
            VisitorId = userId,
            PropertyId = request.PropertyId,
            RoomId = request.RoomId,
            Motivation = request.Motivation,
            Status = ApplicationStatus.Submitted,
            SubmittedAt = DateTime.UtcNow
        };

        _db.Applications.Add(application);
        await _db.SaveChangesAsync();

        _logger.LogInformation("Application {Id} submitted by visitor {VisitorId}", application.Id, userId);
        return await LoadResponse(application.Id);
    }

    public async Task<IEnumerable<ApplicationResponse>> GetAllAsync()
    {
        var apps = await _db.Applications
            .Include(a => a.Visitor)
            .Include(a => a.Property)
            .Include(a => a.Room)
            .OrderByDescending(a => a.SubmittedAt)
            .ToListAsync();

        return apps.Select(Map);
    }

    public async Task<ApplicationResponse?> GetByIdAsync(Guid id, Guid requesterId, bool isAdmin)
    {
        var app = await _db.Applications
            .Include(a => a.Visitor)
            .Include(a => a.Property)
            .Include(a => a.Room)
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync(a => a.Id == id);

        if (app is null) return null;
        if (!isAdmin && app.VisitorId != requesterId) return null;

        return Map(app);
    }

    public async Task<ApplicationResponse> UpdateStatusAsync(Guid id, ApplicationStatus status, Guid adminId)
    {
        var app = await _db.Applications.FindAsync(id)
            ?? throw new KeyNotFoundException("Application not found.");

        app.Status = status;
        app.ReviewedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
        app.ReviewedByAdminId = adminId;
        app.UpdatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;

        if (status == ApplicationStatus.Approved && app.RoomId.HasValue)
        {
            var room = await _db.Rooms.FindAsync(app.RoomId.Value);
            if (room != null)
                room.Status = RoomStatus.Reserved;
        }

        await _db.SaveChangesAsync();
        return await LoadResponse(id);
    }

    private async Task<ApplicationResponse> LoadResponse(Guid id)
    {
        var app = await _db.Applications
            .Include(a => a.Visitor)
            .Include(a => a.Property)
            .Include(a => a.Room)
            .FirstAsync(a => a.Id == id);
        return Map(app);
    }

    private static ApplicationResponse Map(Application a) => new()
    {
        Id = a.Id,
        VisitorId = a.VisitorId,
        VisitorFullName = a.Visitor?.FullName ?? string.Empty,
        VisitorEmail = a.Visitor?.Email ?? string.Empty,
        PropertyId = a.PropertyId,
        PropertyName = a.Property?.Name ?? string.Empty,
        RoomId = a.RoomId,
        RoomNumber = a.Room?.RoomNumber,
        Motivation = a.Motivation,
        Status = a.Status.ToString(),
        AdminNotes = a.AdminNotes,
        RejectionReason = a.RejectionReason,
        SubmittedAt = a.SubmittedAt,
        ReviewedAt = a.ReviewedAt
    };
}

csharp
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using UniCribz.Api.DTOs.Requests;
using UniCribz.Api.DTOs.Responses;

namespace UniCribz.Api.Services;

public class ViewingService : IViewingService
{
    private readonly UniCribzDbContext _db;
    private readonly ILogger<ViewingService> _logger;

    public ViewingService(UniCribzDbContext db, ILogger<ViewingService> logger)
    {
        _db = db;
        _logger = logger;
    }

    public async Task<ViewingResponse> BookAsync(BookViewingRequest request, Guid userId)
    {
        var property = await _db.Properties.FindAsync(request.PropertyId)
            ?? throw new KeyNotFoundException("Property not found.");

        if (request.ScheduledDate < DateTime.UtcNow)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("Scheduled date must be in the future.");

        var visitor = await _db.Visitors.FirstOrDefaultAsync(v => v.Id == userId)
            ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("Only registered visitors can book viewings.");

        var viewing = new Viewing
        {
            VisitorId = userId,
            PropertyId = request.PropertyId,
            RoomId = request.RoomId,
            ScheduledDate = request.ScheduledDate,
            Notes = request.Notes,
            Status = ViewingStatus.Requested,
            CreatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow
        };

        _db.Viewings.Add(viewing);
        await _db.SaveChangesAsync();

        _logger.LogInformation("Viewing {Id} booked by visitor {VisitorId}", viewing.Id, userId);
        return await LoadResponse(viewing.Id);
    }

    public async Task<IEnumerable<ViewingResponse>> GetAllAsync()
    {
        var list = await _db.Viewings
            .Include(v => v.Visitor)
            .Include(v => v.Property)
            .OrderByDescending(v => v.ScheduledDate)
            .ToListAsync();
        return list.Select(Map);
    }

    public async Task<ViewingResponse> UpdateStatusAsync(Guid id, ViewingStatus status)
    {
        var viewing = await _db.Viewings.FindAsync(id)
            ?? throw new KeyNotFoundException("Viewing not found.");
        viewing.Status = status;
        viewing.UpdatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
        await _db.SaveChangesAsync();
        return await LoadResponse(id);
    }

    private async Task<ViewingResponse> LoadResponse(Guid id)
    {
        var v = await _db.Viewings
            .Include(x => x.Visitor)
            .Include(x => x.Property)
            .FirstAsync(x => x.Id == id);
        return Map(v);
    }

    private static ViewingResponse Map(Viewing v) => new()
    {
        Id = v.Id,
        VisitorId = v.VisitorId,
        VisitorFullName = v.Visitor?.FullName ?? string.Empty,
        PropertyId = v.PropertyId,
        PropertyName = v.Property?.Name ?? string.Empty,
        ScheduledDate = v.ScheduledDate,
        Status = v.Status.ToString(),
        Notes = v.Notes,
        CreatedAt = v.CreatedAt
    };
}

using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using UniCribz.Api.DTOs.Requests;
using UniCribz.Api.DTOs.Responses;
using UniCribz.Api.Services.Interfaces;
using UniCribz.Data.Context;
using UniCribz.Data.Entities;
using UniCribz.Data.Enums;

namespace UniCribz.Api.Services;

public class ApplicationService : IApplicationService
{
    private readonly UniCribzDbContext _db;
    private readonly ILogger<ApplicationService> _logger;

    public ApplicationService(UniCribzDbContext db, ILogger<ApplicationService> logger)
    {
        _db = db;
        _logger = logger;
    }

    public async Task<ApplicationResponse> CreateAsync(CreateApplicationRequest request, Guid userId)
    {
        var property = await _db.Properties.FindAsync(request.PropertyId)
            ?? throw new KeyNotFoundException("Property not found.");

        var visitor = await _db.Visitors.FirstOrDefaultAsync(v => v.Id == userId)
            ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("Only registered visitors can submit applications.");

        if (request.RoomId.HasValue)
        {
            var room = await _db.Rooms.FindAsync(request.RoomId.Value)
                ?? throw new KeyNotFoundException("Room not found.");
            if (room.PropertyId != property.Id)
                throw new InvalidOperationException("Room does not belong to the selected property.");
        }

        var application = new Application
        {
            VisitorId = userId,
            PropertyId = request.PropertyId,
            RoomId = request.RoomId,
            PreferredMoveInDate = request.PreferredMoveInDate,
            Notes = request.Notes,
            Status = ApplicationStatus.Submitted,
            SubmittedAt = DateTime.UtcNow
        };

        _db.Applications.Add(application);
        await _db.SaveChangesAsync();

        _logger.LogInformation("Application {Id} submitted by visitor {VisitorId}", application.Id, userId);
        return await LoadResponse(application.Id);
    }

    public async Task<IEnumerable<ApplicationResponse>> GetAllAsync()
    {
        var apps = await _db.Applications
            .Include(a => a.Visitor)
            .Include(a => a.Property)
            .Include(a => a.Room)
            .OrderByDescending(a => a.SubmittedAt)
            .ToListAsync();

        return apps.Select(Map);
    }

    public async Task<ApplicationResponse?> GetByIdAsync(Guid id, Guid requesterId, bool isAdmin)
    {
        var app = await _db.Applications
            .Include(a => a.Visitor)
            .Include(a => a.Property)
            .Include(a => a.Room)
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync(a => a.Id == id);

        if (app is null) return null;
        if (!isAdmin && app.VisitorId != requesterId) return null;

        return Map(app);
    }

    public async Task<ApplicationResponse> UpdateStatusAsync(Guid id, ApplicationStatus status, Guid adminId)
    {
        var app = await _db.Applications.FindAsync(id)
            ?? throw new KeyNotFoundException("Application not found.");

        app.Status = status;
        app.ReviewedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
        app.ReviewedByAdminId = adminId;
        app.UpdatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;

        if (status == ApplicationStatus.Approved && app.RoomId.HasValue)
        {
            var room = await _db.Rooms.FindAsync(app.RoomId.Value);
            if (room != null)
                room.Status = RoomStatus.Reserved;
        }

        await _db.SaveChangesAsync();
        return await LoadResponse(id);
    }

    private async Task<ApplicationResponse> LoadResponse(Guid id)
    {
        var app = await _db.Applications
            .Include(a => a.Visitor)
            .Include(a => a.Property)
            .Include(a => a.Room)
            .FirstAsync(a => a.Id == id);
        return Map(app);
    }

    private static ApplicationResponse Map(Application a) => new()
    {
        Id = a.Id,
        VisitorId = a.VisitorId,
        VisitorFullName = a.Visitor?.FullName ?? string.Empty,

PropertyService.cs — full rewrite:

csharp
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using UniCribz.Api.DTOs.Requests;
using UniCribz.Api.DTOs.Responses;
using UniCribz.Api.Services.Interfaces;
using UniCribz.Data.Context;
using UniCribz.Data.Entities;
using UniCribz.Data.Enums;

namespace UniCribz.Api.Services;

public class PropertyService : IPropertyService
{
    private readonly UniCribzDbContext _db;
    private readonly ILogger<PropertyService> _logger;

    public PropertyService(UniCribzDbContext db, ILogger<PropertyService> logger)
    {
        _db = db;
        _logger = logger;
    }

    public async Task<IEnumerable<PropertyResponse>> SearchAsync(
        string? city, Guid? universityId, string? genderType,
        decimal? minPrice, decimal? maxPrice)
    {
        var query = _db.Properties
            .Include(p => p.Images)
            .Include(p => p.Rooms)
            .Where(p => p.IsActive)
            .AsQueryable();

        if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(city))
            query = query.Where(p => p.City.ToLower() == city.ToLower());

        // universityId / genderType / minPrice filters are not supported by the
        // current Property entity — add fields later if needed.

        if (maxPrice.HasValue)
            query = query.Where(p => p.Rooms.Any(r => r.MonthlyRent <= maxPrice.Value));

        var properties = await query.OrderBy(p => p.Name).ToListAsync();
        return properties.Select(MapToResponse);
    }

    public async Task<PropertyResponse?> GetByIdAsync(Guid id)
    {
        var property = await _db.Properties
            .Include(p => p.Images)
            .Include(p => p.Rooms)
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync(p => p.Id == id);

        return property is null ? null : MapToResponse(property);
    }

    public async Task<PropertyResponse> CreateAsync(CreatePropertyRequest request)
    {
        var property = new Property
        {
            Name = request.Name.Trim(),
            Description = request.Description.Trim(),
            AddressLine1 = request.AddressLine1.Trim(),
            Suburb = request.Suburb.Trim(),
            City = request.City.Trim(),
            Province = request.Province.Trim(),
            PostalCode = request.PostalCode?.Trim() ?? string.Empty,
            Latitude = request.Latitude,
            Longitude = request.Longitude,
            PropertyType = request.PropertyType,
            AdminId = request.AdminId,
            IsActive = true,
            CreatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow
        };

        _db.Properties.Add(property);
        await _db.SaveChangesAsync();

        _logger.LogInformation("Property created: {Name} ({Id})", property.Name, property.Id);
        return await GetByIdAsync(property.Id)
               ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("Failed to reload property.");
    }

    public async Task<PropertyResponse> UpdateAsync(Guid id, CreatePropertyRequest request)
    {
        var property = await _db.Properties.FindAsync(id)
            ?? throw new KeyNotFoundException($"Property {id} not found.");

        property.Name = request.Name.Trim();
        property.Description = request.Description.Trim();
        property.AddressLine1 = request.AddressLine1.Trim();
        property.Suburb = request.Suburb.Trim();
        property.City = request.City.Trim();
        property.Province = request.Province.Trim();
        property.PostalCode = request.PostalCode?.Trim() ?? string.Empty;
        property.Latitude = request.Latitude;
        property.Longitude = request.Longitude;
        property.PropertyType = request.PropertyType;
        property.AdminId = request.AdminId;
        property.UpdatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;

        await _db.SaveChangesAsync();
        return await GetByIdAsync(id)
               ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("Failed to reload property.");
    }

    public async Task DeleteAsync(Guid id)
    {
        var property = await _db.Properties.FindAsync(id)
            ?? throw new KeyNotFoundException($"Property {id} not found.");

        _db.Properties.Remove(property);
        await _db.SaveChangesAsync();
        _logger.LogInformation("Property deleted: {Id}", id);
    }

    public async Task<IEnumerable<RoomResponse>> GetRoomsAsync(Guid propertyId)
    {
        var exists = await _db.Properties.AnyAsync(p => p.Id == propertyId);
        if (!exists) throw new KeyNotFoundException($"Property {propertyId} not found.");

        var rooms = await _db.Rooms
            .Where(r => r.PropertyId == propertyId)
            .OrderBy(r => r.RoomNumber)
            .ToListAsync();

        return rooms.Select(MapToRoomResponse);
    }

    public async Task<RoomResponse> AddRoomAsync(Guid propertyId, CreateRoomRequest request)
    {
        var property = await _db.Properties.FindAsync(propertyId)
            ?? throw new KeyNotFoundException($"Property {propertyId} not found.");

        var room = new Room
        {
            PropertyId = propertyId,
            RoomNumber = request.RoomNumber.Trim(),
            Floor = request.Floor,
            Type = request.Type,
            Capacity = request.Capacity,
            MonthlyRent = request.MonthlyRent,
            Status = RoomStatus.Available,
            CreatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow
        };

        _db.Rooms.Add(room);
        property.TotalRooms += 1;
        await _db.SaveChangesAsync();

        return MapToRoomResponse(room);
    }

    private static PropertyResponse MapToResponse(Property p) => new()
    {
        Id = p.Id,
        Name = p.Name,
        Description = p.Description,
        Address = $"{p.AddressLine1}, {p.Suburb}, {p.City}",
        City = p.City,
        Latitude = p.Latitude ?? 0,
        Longitude = p.Longitude ?? 0,
        TotalRooms = p.TotalRooms,
        AvailableRooms = p.Rooms.Count(r => r.Status == RoomStatus.Available),
        ImageUrls = p.Images.OrderBy(i => i.DisplayOrder).Select(i => i.ImageUrl).ToList(),
        CreatedAt = p.CreatedAt
    };

    private static RoomResponse MapToRoomResponse(Room r) => new()
    {
        Id = r.Id,
        PropertyId = r.PropertyId,
        RoomNumber = r.RoomNumber,
        Type = r.Type,
        Capacity = r.Capacity,
        MonthlyRent = r.MonthlyRent,
        Status = r.Status.ToString()
    };
}
UserService.cs:

csharp
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using UniCribz.Api.DTOs.Requests;
using UniCribz.Api.DTOs.Responses;
using UniCribz.Api.Services.Interfaces;
using UniCribz.Data.Context;
using UniCribz.Data.Entities;
using UniCribz.Data.Enums;
using UniCribz.Shared.Helpers;

namespace UniCribz.Api.Services;

public class UserService : IUserService
{
    private readonly UniCribzDbContext _db;
    private readonly IConfiguration _config;
    private readonly ILogger<UserService> _logger;

    public UserService(UniCribzDbContext db, IConfiguration config, ILogger<UserService> logger)
    {
        _db = db;
        _config = config;
        _logger = logger;
    }

    public async Task<AuthResponse> RegisterAsync(RegisterRequest request)
    {
        var email = request.Email.Trim().ToLowerInvariant();

        var exists = await _db.Users.AnyAsync(u => u.Email == email);
        if (exists)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("An account with this email already exists.");

        if (request.Password != request.ConfirmPassword)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("Passwords do not match.");

        // Must instantiate Visitor — User is the TPH base and has no discriminator.
        var user = new Visitor
        {
            FullName = request.FullName.Trim(),
            Email = email,
            PhoneNumber = request.PhoneNumber?.Trim() ?? string.Empty,
            StudentNumber = request.StudentNumber?.Trim() ?? string.Empty,
            PasswordHash = PasswordHasher.Hash(request.Password),
            Role = UserRole.Visitor,
            EmailVerified = false,
            IsActive = true,
            CreatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow
        };

        _db.Users.Add(user);
        await _db.SaveChangesAsync();

        _logger.LogInformation("New user registered: {Email}", user.Email);
        return BuildAuthResponse(user);
    }

    public async Task<AuthResponse> LoginAsync(LoginRequest request)
    {
        var email = request.Email.Trim().ToLowerInvariant();

        var user = await _db.Users.FirstOrDefaultAsync(u => u.Email == email)
                   ?? throw new UnauthorizedAccessException("Invalid email or password.");

        if (!PasswordHasher.Verify(request.Password, user.PasswordHash))
            throw new UnauthorizedAccessException("Invalid email or password.");

        user.LastLoginAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
        await _db.SaveChangesAsync();

        _logger.LogInformation("User logged in: {Email}", user.Email);
        return BuildAuthResponse(user);
    }

    public async Task<AuthResponse?> GetCurrentUserAsync(Guid userId)
    {
        var user = await _db.Users.FindAsync(userId);
        return user is null ? null : BuildAuthResponse(user);
    }

    private AuthResponse BuildAuthResponse(User user)
    {
        var (token, expiresAt) = JwtTokenGenerator.Generate(
            user.Id,
            user.Email,
            user.FullName,
            user.Role.ToString(),
            _config);

        return new AuthResponse
        {
            Token = token,
            ExpiresAt = expiresAt,
            UserId = user.Id,
            FullName = user.FullName,
            Email = user.Email,
            Role = user.Role.ToString()
        };
    }
}

csharp
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using UniCribz.Api.DTOs.Requests;
using UniCribz.Api.DTOs.Responses;
using UniCribz.Api.Services.Interfaces;
using UniCribz.Data.Context;
using UniCribz.Data.Entities;
using UniCribz.Data.Enums;

namespace UniCribz.Api.Services;

public class ViewingService : IViewingService
{
    private readonly UniCribzDbContext _db;
    private readonly ILogger<ViewingService> _logger;

    public ViewingService(UniCribzDbContext db, ILogger<ViewingService> logger)
    {
        _db = db;
        _logger = logger;
    }

    public async Task<ViewingResponse> BookAsync(BookViewingRequest request, Guid userId)
    {
        var property = await _db.Properties.FindAsync(request.PropertyId)
            ?? throw new KeyNotFoundException("Property not found.");

        if (request.ScheduledDateTime < DateTime.UtcNow)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("Scheduled date must be in the future.");

        var visitor = await _db.Visitors.FirstOrDefaultAsync(v => v.Id == userId)
            ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("Only registered visitors can book viewings.");

        var viewing = new Viewing
        {
            VisitorId = userId,
            PropertyId = request.PropertyId,
            ScheduledDate = request.ScheduledDateTime,  // DTO name → entity name
            Notes = request.Notes,
            Status = ViewingStatus.Requested,
            CreatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow
        };

        _db.Viewings.Add(viewing);
        await _db.SaveChangesAsync();

        _logger.LogInformation("Viewing {Id} booked by visitor {VisitorId}", viewing.Id, userId);
        return await LoadResponse(viewing.Id);
    }

    public async Task<IEnumerable<ViewingResponse>> GetAllAsync()
    {
        var list = await _db.Viewings
            .Include(v => v.Visitor)
            .Include(v => v.Property)
            .OrderByDescending(v => v.ScheduledDate)
            .ToListAsync();
        return list.Select(Map);
    }

    public async Task<ViewingResponse> UpdateStatusAsync(Guid id, ViewingStatus status)
    {
        var viewing = await _db.Viewings.FindAsync(id)
            ?? throw new KeyNotFoundException("Viewing not found.");
        viewing.Status = status;
        viewing.UpdatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
        await _db.SaveChangesAsync();
        return await LoadResponse(id);
    }

    private async Task<ViewingResponse> LoadResponse(Guid id)
    {
        var v = await _db.Viewings
            .Include(x => x.Visitor)
            .Include(x => x.Property)
            .FirstAsync(x => x.Id == id);
        return Map(v);
    }

    private static ViewingResponse Map(Viewing v) => new()
    {
        Id = v.Id,
        UserId = v.VisitorId,                              // entity name → DTO name
        UserFullName = v.Visitor?.FullName ?? string.Empty,
        PropertyId = v.PropertyId,
        PropertyName = v.Property?.Name ?? string.Empty,
        ScheduledDateTime = v.ScheduledDate,               // entity name → DTO name
        Status = v.Status.ToString(),
        Notes = v.Notes,
        CreatedAt = v.CreatedAt
    };
}

{
    private readonly UniCribzDbContext _db;
    private readonly ILogger<PropertyService> _logger;

    public PropertyService(UniCribzDbContext db, ILogger<PropertyService> logger)
    {
        _db = db;
        _logger = logger;
    }

    public async Task<IEnumerable<PropertyResponse>> SearchAsync(
        string? city, Guid? universityId, string? genderType,
        decimal? minPrice, decimal? maxPrice)
    {
        var query = _db.Properties
            .Include(p => p.Images)
            .Include(p => p.Rooms)
            .Where(p => p.IsActive)
            .AsQueryable();

        if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(city))
            query = query.Where(p => p.City.ToLower() == city.ToLower());

        // universityId / genderType / minPrice filters are not supported by the
        // current Property entity — add fields later if needed.

        if (maxPrice.HasValue)
            query = query.Where(p => p.Rooms.Any(r => r.MonthlyRent <= maxPrice.Value));

        var properties = await query.OrderBy(p => p.Name).ToListAsync();
        return properties.Select(MapToResponse);
    }

    public async Task<PropertyResponse?> GetByIdAsync(Guid id)
    {
        var property = await _db.Properties
            .Include(p => p.Images)
            .Include(p => p.Rooms)
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync(p => p.Id == id);

        return property is null ? null : MapToResponse(property);
    }

    public async Task<PropertyResponse> CreateAsync(CreatePropertyRequest request)
    {
        var property = new Property
        {
            Name = request.Name.Trim(),
            Description = request.Description.Trim(),
            AddressLine1 = request.AddressLine1.Trim(),
            Suburb = request.Suburb.Trim(),
            City = request.City.Trim(),
            Province = request.Province.Trim(),
            PostalCode = request.PostalCode?.Trim() ?? string.Empty,
            Latitude = request.Latitude,
            Longitude = request.Longitude,
            PropertyType = request.PropertyType,
            AdminId = request.AdminId,
            IsActive = true,
            CreatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow
        };

        _db.Properties.Add(property);
        await _db.SaveChangesAsync();

        _logger.LogInformation("Property created: {Name} ({Id})", property.Name, property.Id);
        return await GetByIdAsync(property.Id)
               ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("Failed to reload property.");
    }

    public async Task<PropertyResponse> UpdateAsync(Guid id, CreatePropertyRequest request)
    {
        var property = await _db.Properties.FindAsync(id)
            ?? throw new KeyNotFoundException($"Property {id} not found.");

        property.Name = request.Name.Trim();
        property.Description = request.Description.Trim();
        property.AddressLine1 = request.AddressLine1.Trim();
        property.Suburb = request.Suburb.Trim();
        property.City = request.City.Trim();
        property.Province = request.Province.Trim();
        property.PostalCode = request.PostalCode?.Trim() ?? string.Empty;
        property.Latitude = request.Latitude;
        property.Longitude = request.Longitude;
        property.PropertyType = request.PropertyType;
        property.AdminId = request.AdminId;
        property.UpdatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;

        await _db.SaveChangesAsync();
        return await GetByIdAsync(id)
               ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("Failed to reload property.");
    }

    public async Task DeleteAsync(Guid id)
    {
        var property = await _db.Properties.FindAsync(id)
            ?? throw new KeyNotFoundException($"Property {id} not found.");

        _db.Properties.Remove(property);
        await _db.SaveChangesAsync();
        _logger.LogInformation("Property deleted: {Id}", id);
    }

    public async Task<IEnumerable<RoomResponse>> GetRoomsAsync(Guid propertyId)
    {
        var exists = await _db.Properties.AnyAsync(p => p.Id == propertyId);
        if (!exists) throw new KeyNotFoundException($"Property {propertyId} not found.");

        var rooms = await _db.Rooms
            .Where(r => r.PropertyId == propertyId)
            .OrderBy(r => r.RoomNumber)
            .ToListAsync();

        return rooms.Select(MapToRoomResponse);
    }

    public async Task<RoomResponse> AddRoomAsync(Guid propertyId, CreateRoomRequest request)
    {
        var property = await _db.Properties.FindAsync(propertyId)
            ?? throw new KeyNotFoundException($"Property {propertyId} not found.");

        var room = new Room
        {
            PropertyId = propertyId,
            RoomNumber = request.RoomNumber.Trim(),
            Floor = request.Floor,
            Type = request.Type,
            Capacity = request.Capacity,
            MonthlyRent = request.MonthlyRent,
            Status = RoomStatus.Available,
            CreatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow
        };

        _db.Rooms.Add(room);
        property.TotalRooms += 1;
        await _db.SaveChangesAsync();

        return MapToRoomResponse(room);
    }

    private static PropertyResponse MapToResponse(Property p) => new()
    {
        Id = p.Id,
        Name = p.Name,
        Description = p.Description,
        Address = $"{p.AddressLine1}, {p.Suburb}, {p.City}",
        City = p.City,
        Latitude = p.Latitude ?? 0,
        Longitude = p.Longitude ?? 0,
        TotalRooms = p.TotalRooms,
        AvailableRooms = p.Rooms.Count(r => r.Status == RoomStatus.Available),
        ImageUrls = p.Images.OrderBy(i => i.DisplayOrder).Select(i => i.ImageUrl).ToList(),
        CreatedAt = p.CreatedAt
    };

    private static RoomResponse MapToRoomResponse(Room r) => new()
    {
        Id = r.Id,
        PropertyId = r.PropertyId,
        RoomNumber = r.RoomNumber,
        Type = r.Type,
        Capacity = r.Capacity,
        MonthlyRent = r.MonthlyRent,
        Status = r.Status.ToString()
    };
}
3. src/UniCribz.Api/Services/ViewingService.cs
Replace the whole file.

Notice: your Viewing entity has ScheduledDate, but your DTOs use ScheduledDateTime. I've mapped between them in the service so you don't have to change the DTOs.

csharp
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using UniCribz.Api.DTOs.Requests;
using UniCribz.Api.DTOs.Responses;
using UniCribz.Api.Services.Interfaces;
using UniCribz.Data.Context;
using UniCribz.Data.Entities;
using UniCribz.Data.Enums;

namespace UniCribz.Api.Services;

public class ViewingService : IViewingService
{
    private readonly UniCribzDbContext _db;
    private readonly ILogger<ViewingService> _logger;

    public ViewingService(UniCribzDbContext db, ILogger<ViewingService> logger)
    {
        _db = db;
        _logger = logger;
    }

    public async Task<ViewingResponse> BookAsync(BookViewingRequest request, Guid userId)
    {
        var property = await _db.Properties.FindAsync(request.PropertyId)
            ?? throw new KeyNotFoundException("Property not found.");

        if (request.ScheduledDateTime < DateTime.UtcNow)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("Scheduled date must be in the future.");

        var visitor = await _db.Visitors.FirstOrDefaultAsync(v => v.Id == userId)
            ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("Only registered visitors can book viewings.");

        var viewing = new Viewing
        {
            VisitorId = userId,
            PropertyId = request.PropertyId,
            ScheduledDate = request.ScheduledDateTime,   // DTO name → entity name
            Notes = request.Notes,
            Status = ViewingStatus.Requested,
            CreatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow
        };

        _db.Viewings.Add(viewing);
        await _db.SaveChangesAsync();

        _logger.LogInformation("Viewing {Id} booked by visitor {VisitorId}", viewing.Id, userId);
        return await LoadResponse(viewing.Id);
    }

    public async Task<IEnumerable<ViewingResponse>> GetAllAsync()
    {
        var list = await _db.Viewings
            .Include(v => v.Visitor)
            .Include(v => v.Property)
            .OrderByDescending(v => v.ScheduledDate)
            .ToListAsync();
        return list.Select(Map);
    }

    public async Task<ViewingResponse> UpdateStatusAsync(Guid id, ViewingStatus status)
    {
        var viewing = await _db.Viewings.FindAsync(id)
            ?? throw new KeyNotFoundException("Viewing not found.");
        viewing.Status = status;
        viewing.UpdatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
        await _db.SaveChangesAsync();
        return await LoadResponse(id);
    }

    private async Task<ViewingResponse> LoadResponse(Guid id)
    {
        var v = await _db.Viewings
            .Include(x => x.Visitor)
            .Include(x => x.Property)
            .FirstAsync(x => x.Id == id);
        return Map(v);
    }

    private static ViewingResponse Map(Viewing v) => new()
    {
        Id = v.Id,
        UserId = v.VisitorId,                              // entity name → DTO name
        UserFullName = v.Visitor?.FullName ?? string.Empty,
        PropertyId = v.PropertyId,
        PropertyName = v.Property?.Name ?? string.Empty,
        ScheduledDateTime = v.ScheduledDate,               // entity name → DTO name
        Status = v.Status.ToString(),
        Notes = v.Notes,
        CreatedAt = v.CreatedAt
    };
}

🚨 Docker Can't Reach Docker Hub (DNS Issue)
The error is:

text
dial tcp: lookup registry-1.docker.io: no such host
Docker Desktop can't resolve the Docker Hub hostname. This is a DNS/networking issue inside Docker Desktop, not a problem with your code or compose file.

Let's fix it. Try these in order — stop at the first one that works.

Fix 1: Restart Docker Desktop (Try This First)
Right-click the Docker whale icon in the system tray → Quit Docker Desktop

Wait 10 seconds

Wait for the whale icon to stop animating

❌ If it still fails with no such host → go to Fix 2.

Fix 2: Configure DNS in Docker Desktop
Docker Desktop sometimes uses a broken DNS resolver on Windows.

Step 2.1: Open Docker Settings
Right-click the whale icon → Settings (or Dashboard → Settings).

Step 2.2: Set DNS servers
Go to Resources → Network

Under DNS Server, select Fixed

Enter: 8.8.8.8, 1.1.1.1

Click Apply & restart

Step 2.3: Test again
powershell

✅ Works → continue

❌ Still fails → go to Fix 3

Fix 3: Reset Docker Desktop's Network
Step 3.1: Restart WSL (Docker Desktop uses WSL2 on Windows)

Step 3.2: Restart Docker Desktop
Quit Docker Desktop

Open Docker Desktop again

Wait for it to be ready

Step 3.3: Test

Fix 4: Restart the Windows Host Network
Open PowerShell as Administrator:

# Restart Docker Desktop
Then reboot your PC (yes, really — Winsock changes need a reboot). After reboot, start Docker Desktop and retry.

Campus network → some universities block Docker Hub

Let me give a simple, direct answer.

🔧 Fix — BCrypt DLL Not Loaded at Runtime
The BCrypt.Net-Next package is installed in UniCribz.Shared (for PasswordHasher), but the seeder in UniCribz.Data calls BCrypt.Net.BCrypt.HashPassword(...) directly. At runtime, the API can't find the DLL.

Two fixes, do both for safety. They're both 1-line changes.

Fix 1: Use PasswordHasher in the Seeder (Recommended)
UniCribz.Data already references UniCribz.Shared, which has the PasswordHasher helper. Use it instead of calling BCrypt directly — this is what UserService already does.

Edit src/UniCribz.Data/Seed/DataSeeder.cs
Find this line (line ~25):

csharp
var hash = BCrypt.Net.BCrypt.HashPassword(DemoPassword);
Replace it with:

csharp
var hash = UniCribz.Shared.Helpers.PasswordHasher.Hash(DemoPassword);
Also, add this using at the top of the file (with the other usings):

csharp
using UniCribz.Shared.Helpers;
Then the line becomes just:

csharp
var hash = PasswordHasher.Hash(DemoPassword);
Save the file.

            EmailVerified = true,
            University = uj,
            StudentNumber = "ST10440807",

this is the swagger the appears on my screen
The user is seeing "Unable to render this definition" with "The provided definition does not specify a valid version field."

This is a common issue with Swashbuckle / Swagger UI when the OpenAPI spec doesn't have a valid openapi field. Looking at the error more carefully: "The provided definition does not specify a valid version field."

This is usually caused by one of:

The swagger.json is being returned but with wrong content

Version mismatch between Swashbuckle.AspNetCore and the Swagger UI

Missing OpenApiInfo in the SwaggerGen config

In .NET 8, Microsoft.AspNetCore.OpenApi is included and conflicts with Swashbuckle

Looking at the earlier Program.cs, we have:

csharp
builder.Services.AddSwaggerGen(c =>
{
    c.SwaggerDoc("v1", new OpenApiInfo
    {
        Title = "UniCribz API",
        Version = "v1",
        Description = "Student Accommodation Management System API"
    });
    ...
});
That looks fine. The issue is likely that the earlier build had both Microsoft.AspNetCore.OpenApi (from the .NET 8 webapi template) AND Swashbuckle.AspNetCore installed. In .NET 8, the webapi template adds Microsoft.AspNetCore.OpenApi which registers its OWN OpenAPI implementation. When both are present, there can be conflicts.

Also I see in the earlier restore output:

text
info : Installed Microsoft.AspNetCore.OpenApi 8.0.31
Yes! That's the problem. The Microsoft.AspNetCore.OpenApi package is included with the .NET 8 webapi template and it generates the OpenAPI document. But Swashbuckle ALSO generates one. And the endpoint names conflict.

The fix: Either

Remove Microsoft.AspNetCore.OpenApi from the csproj, OR

Make sure only Swashbuckle is used to generate /swagger/v1/swagger.json

Since the user is going to test in Swagger, I need to be practical. They'll need to copy the property ID and room ID from one response to use in the next request.

Let me organize this as a numbered test plan they can follow step by step.

🧪 Complete Test Suite — Follow Step-by-Step
This walks you through every endpoint with copy-paste payloads. Follow in order — later steps need IDs from earlier steps.

🎯 Part 1: Auth Flow (as Admin)
Test 1.1 — Login as Admin
POST /api/auth/login → Try it out

json
{
  "email": "admin@unicribz.co.za",
  "password": "Admin@123"
}
Expected: 200 OK

Copy the token value — you'll need it for the next steps.

Test 1.2 — Authorize Swagger
Click Authorize (top-right, padlock 🔒)

Paste: Bearer YOUR_TOKEN_HERE (with a space)

Authorize → Close

You're now authenticated as Admin for all endpoints marked 🔒.

Test 1.3 — Get Current User (Verify JWT)
GET /api/auth/me → Try it out → Execute

Expected: 200 OK

json
{
  "userId": "...",
  "fullName": "System Administrator",
  "email": "admin@unicribz.co.za",
  "role": "Admin"
}
🏢 Part 2: Property CRUD (as Admin)
Test 2.1 — Search All Properties
GET /api/properties → Try it out → Execute

Expected: 200 OK with the seeded Braamfontein property.

📌 Copy the property id (a UUID like b1a2c3d4-...). You'll need it in Test 2.2 and Part 3.

📋 Full Enum Reference (for PATCH requests)
When sending status updates, use the integer value:

Application Status
Value	Meaning
0	Submitted
1	UnderReview
2	Approved
3	Rejected
4	RoomAllocated
Viewing Status
Value	Meaning
0	Requested
1	Approved
2	Rejected
3	Rescheduled
4	Completed

🔑 The 401 Is a Swagger Auth Issue, Not a Backend Issue
Look at this critical line in the logs:

text
[12:15:56 INF] Authorization failed. These requirements were not met:
DenyAnonymousAuthorizationRequirement: Requires an authenticated user.
No JWT was attached to the request. Swagger didn't send the token because you logged in as sam.test but never re-authorized the Swagger UI with the new token.

Swagger keeps the last token you authorized with — when you switch users, you have to click Authorize again with the new token.

Fix — Re-Authorize Swagger After Every Login
Step 1: Get a Fresh Token
POST /api/auth/login with:

json
{
  "email": "sam.test@student.uj.ac.za",
  "password": "Test@1234"
}
Copy the token from the response (starts with eyJ...).

Step 2: Force Swagger to Forget the Old Token
Click Authorize (padlock 🔒, top-right)

In the popup, look for the section "Available authorizations"

Look for a small "Logout" button (below the Value field)

Click Logout — this clears the old token

Now click Authorize again

Step 3: Paste the New Token
In the Value field:

text
Bearer eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJzdWIiOi...
⚠️ Note the space after Bearer

Click Authorize → Close

Step 4: Retry the Application
POST /api/applications → Try it out → paste:

json
{
  "propertyId": "PASTE-BRAAMFONTEIN-ID",
  "roomId": "PASTE-ROOM-101-ID",
  "preferredMoveInDate": "2026-02-15T00:00:00Z",
  "notes": "Quiet student, no pets."
}
Expected: 201 Created

🎯 To Check if You're Authorized
Look at the padlock icon next to POST /api/applications:

Icon	Meaning
🔓 Unlocked padlock	No token — request will 401
🔒 Closed padlock	Token attached — request will authenticate
If you see the open padlock, you're not authorized.

This happens because Swagger UI is served from http://localhost:5125 but your CORS policy only allows https://localhost:7105 (the Web frontend). Swagger requests still succeed because they're same-origin. When Samkelsiwe's Web frontend calls the API, CORS will work because 7105 is allowed.

🎯 How to Run in Visual Studio
1. Start the API
Terminal 1:

powershell
cd src/UniCribz.Api
dotnet run
Wait for:

text
Now listening on: http://localhost:5125
2. Open the .http file
In Solution Explorer, double-click UniCribz.Api.http.

3. Run requests in order
Each request has a green ▶ arrow to its left. Click them top-to-bottom the first time.

Critical order for auth capture:

adminLogin first

Then tenantLogin

Then visitorLogin

After these, the tokens {{adminToken}}, {{tenantToken}}, {{visitorToken}} are populated and every subsequent request will use them automatically.

4. Manually paste IDs when needed
After running the property search, look at the response and copy:

The first property id → paste into @propertyId = ...

One of the room ids → paste into @roomId = ...

Do the same for @newPropId, @applicationId, @viewingId — though most are auto-captured from # @name blocks.

📖 Cheat Sheet — What Each Section Tests
Section	What It Verifies
Health	API is running + DB + Redis healthy
Auth Login	3 roles can log in, tokens captured
Auth Me	JWT validated correctly, role claim works
Auth Register	Public signup creates a Visitor
Property Search	Public filtering (city, price)
Property Details	Single property + rooms
Property Create/Update	Admin RBAC enforced
Application Submit	Visitor can apply, room becomes Reserved on approve
Viewing Book	Visitor schedules, Admin approves
Error Cases	Every failure path returns the correct status code
🚨 Expected Status Codes
Test	Expected
Health	200
Login (correct)	200
Login (wrong password)	401
Register (new)	201
Register (duplicate)	400
Register (mismatch)	400
GET /me (with token)	200
GET /me (no token)	401
Property search	200
Property create (Admin)	201
Property create (Visitor)	403
Application submit	201
Application approve	200
Viewing book	201
Viewing approve	200
Nonexistent resource	404
💡 Pro Tips
Skip the CORS noise
The .http file requests run server-side, so CORS never applies. You'll see clean logs — no more "CORS policy execution failed" warnings.

Chain across sections
The # @name X blocks let you reference {{X.response.body.$.token}} anywhere later in the file. Run them once, and every subsequent request uses the captured value until you re-run the login.

Test order matters
If you skip the logins at the top, every authenticated request will fail with 401.

Reset the DB (if you want a clean slate)
powershell
docker exec -it unicribz-postgres psql -U postgres -d UniCribzDb -c "DROP SCHEMA public CASCADE; CREATE SCHEMA public;"
cd src/UniCribz.Api
dotnet ef database update --project ../UniCribz.Data --startup-project .
Then restart the API to re-run the seeder.

🎯 The 404s — Plural vs Singular Routes
Your AuthController works because its route is api/Auth. But your .http file is calling /api/properties, /api/applications, /api/viewings (plural) — the controllers are registered as api/Property, api/Application, api/Viewing (singular, from [Route("api/[controller]")]).

Two ways to fix. Pick one:

✅ Option A (Recommended): Change Controllers to Plural Routes
Open each controller and change the route attribute:

src/UniCribz.Api/Controllers/PropertyController.cs
csharp
[ApiController]
[Route("api/properties")]     // ← was "api/[controller]"
public class PropertyController : ControllerBase
src/UniCribz.Api/Controllers/ApplicationController.cs
csharp
[ApiController]
[Route("api/applications")]   // ← was "api/[controller]"
public class ApplicationController : ControllerBase
src/UniCribz.Api/Controllers/ViewingController.cs
csharp
[ApiController]
[Route("api/viewings")]       // ← was "api/[controller]"
public class ViewingController : ControllerBase
src/UniCribz.Api/Controllers/RoomController.cs (if it exists)
csharp
[ApiController]
[Route("api/rooms")]          // ← was "api/[controller]"
src/UniCribz.Api/Controllers/AuthController.cs (optional but cleaner)
csharp
[ApiController]
[Route("api/auth")]           // ← was "api/[controller]"
public class AuthController : ControllerBase
Save all files.

🅱️ Option B: Just Change the .http File (quick workaround)
Change every plural endpoint to singular:

/api/properties → /api/Property

/api/applications → /api/Application

/api/viewings → /api/Viewing

Ugly, but it works. I recommend Option A — plural URLs are the standard convention.

Let me write this out cleanly.

For Maintenance, note that the current user needs to be identified to know who is the tenant. But tenants are stored as Users with UserType='Tenant'. The MaintenanceRequest.TenantId references the Tenant's Id which is the same as the User's Id (TPH inheritance).

Since we don't yet have a way to derive TenantId from UserId... actually, since TPH inheritance means Tenant inherits from User, and Tenant.Id == User.Id for that user, we can just use the JWT's userId directly as TenantId. Good.

Wait — actually looking at the Application entity it uses VisitorId, and the JWT userId maps to VisitorId because a Visitor's Id is the same as its User Id in TPH. So MaintenanceRequest.TenantId should be settable from the JWT userId directly. Same for Complaint.TenantId.

using UniCribz.Api.DTOs.Requests;
using UniCribz.Api.DTOs.Responses;
using UniCribz.Data.Enums;

namespace UniCribz.Api.Services.Interfaces;

public interface IMaintenanceService
{
    Task<MaintenanceResponse> CreateAsync(CreateMaintenanceRequest request, Guid tenantUserId);
    Task<IEnumerable<MaintenanceResponse>> GetAllAsync();
    Task<IEnumerable<MaintenanceResponse>> GetMineAsync(Guid tenantUserId);
    Task<MaintenanceResponse?> GetByIdAsync(Guid id, Guid requesterId, bool isAdmin);
    Task<MaintenanceResponse> AssignAsync(Guid id, Guid adminUserId);
    Task<MaintenanceResponse> UpdateStatusAsync(Guid id, MaintenanceStatus status, string? notes);
}
6. src/UniCribz.Api/Services/MaintenanceService.cs
csharp
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using UniCribz.Api.DTOs.Requests;
using UniCribz.Api.DTOs.Responses;
using UniCribz.Api.Services.Interfaces;
using UniCribz.Data.Context;
using UniCribz.Data.Entities;
using UniCribz.Data.Enums;

namespace UniCribz.Api.Services;

public class MaintenanceService : IMaintenanceService
{
    private readonly UniCribzDbContext _db;
    private readonly ILogger<MaintenanceService> _logger;

    public MaintenanceService(UniCribzDbContext db, ILogger<MaintenanceService> logger)
    {
        _db = db;
        _logger = logger;
    }

    public async Task<MaintenanceResponse> CreateAsync(CreateMaintenanceRequest request, Guid tenantUserId)
    {
        var tenant = await _db.Tenants.FirstOrDefaultAsync(t => t.Id == tenantUserId)
            ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("Only tenants can submit maintenance requests.");

        var room = await _db.Rooms.FindAsync(request.RoomId)
            ?? throw new KeyNotFoundException("Room not found.");

        var entity = new MaintenanceRequest
        {
            TenantId = tenantUserId,
            RoomId = request.RoomId,
            Title = request.Title.Trim(),
            Description = request.Description.Trim(),
            Category = request.Category,
            Priority = request.Priority,
            Status = MaintenanceStatus.Submitted,
            CreatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow
        };

        _db.MaintenanceRequests.Add(entity);
        await _db.SaveChangesAsync();

        _logger.LogInformation("Maintenance {Id} submitted by tenant {TenantId}", entity.Id, tenantUserId);
        return await LoadResponse(entity.Id);
    }

    public async Task<IEnumerable<MaintenanceResponse>> GetAllAsync()
    {
        var list = await Query().OrderByDescending(m => m.CreatedAt).ToListAsync();
        return list.Select(Map);
    }

    public async Task<IEnumerable<MaintenanceResponse>> GetMineAsync(Guid tenantUserId)
    {
        var list = await Query()
            .Where(m => m.TenantId == tenantUserId)
            .OrderByDescending(m => m.CreatedAt)
            .ToListAsync();
        return list.Select(Map);
    }

    public async Task<MaintenanceResponse?> GetByIdAsync(Guid id, Guid requesterId, bool isAdmin)
    {
        var m = await Query().FirstOrDefaultAsync(x => x.Id == id);
        if (m is null) return null;
        if (!isAdmin && m.TenantId != requesterId) return null;
        return Map(m);
    }

    public async Task<MaintenanceResponse> AssignAsync(Guid id, Guid adminUserId)
    {
        var m = await _db.MaintenanceRequests.FindAsync(id)
            ?? throw new KeyNotFoundException("Maintenance request not found.");

        m.AssignedToAdminId = adminUserId;
        m.Status = MaintenanceStatus.Assigned;
        m.UpdatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;

        await _db.SaveChangesAsync();
        _logger.LogInformation("Maintenance {Id} assigned to admin {AdminId}", id, adminUserId);
        return await LoadResponse(id);
    }

    public async Task<MaintenanceResponse> UpdateStatusAsync(Guid id, MaintenanceStatus status, string? notes)
    {
        var m = await _db.MaintenanceRequests.FindAsync(id)
            ?? throw new KeyNotFoundException("Maintenance request not found.");

        m.Status = status;
        m.UpdatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
        if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(notes)) m.ResolutionNotes = notes;
        if (status == MaintenanceStatus.Completed) m.ResolvedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;

        await _db.SaveChangesAsync();
        _logger.LogInformation("Maintenance {Id} status → {Status}", id, status);
        return await LoadResponse(id);
    }

    private IQueryable<MaintenanceRequest> Query() =>
        _db.MaintenanceRequests
           .Include(m => m.Tenant)
           .Include(m => m.Room)
           .ThenInclude(r => r!.Property);

    private async Task<MaintenanceResponse> LoadResponse(Guid id)
    {
        var m = await Query().FirstAsync(x => x.Id == id);
        return Map(m);
    }

    private static MaintenanceResponse Map(MaintenanceRequest m) => new()
    {
        Id = m.Id,
        TenantId = m.TenantId,
        TenantFullName = m.Tenant?.FullName ?? string.Empty,
        TenantEmail = m.Tenant?.Email ?? string.Empty,
        RoomId = m.RoomId,
        RoomNumber = m.Room?.RoomNumber ?? string.Empty,
        PropertyName = m.Room?.Property?.Name ?? string.Empty,
        Title = m.Title,
        Description = m.Description,
        Category = m.Category,
        Priority = m.Priority,
        Status = m.Status.ToString(),
        AssignedToAdminId = m.AssignedToAdminId,
        CreatedAt = m.CreatedAt,
        ResolvedAt = m.ResolvedAt,
        ResolutionNotes = m.ResolutionNotes
    };
}

using System.Security.Claims;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using UniCribz.Api.DTOs.Requests;
using UniCribz.Api.Services.Interfaces;
using UniCribz.Shared.Constants;

namespace UniCribz.Api.Controllers;

[ApiController]
[Route("api/maintenance")]
[Authorize]
public class MaintenanceController : ControllerBase
{
    private readonly IMaintenanceService _service;
    public MaintenanceController(IMaintenanceService service) => _service = service;

    private Guid CurrentUserId =>
        Guid.Parse(User.FindFirstValue(ClaimTypes.NameIdentifier) ?? User.FindFirstValue("sub")!);
    private bool IsAdmin => User.IsInRole(Roles.Admin);

    /// <summary>Tenant submits a maintenance request.</summary>
    [HttpPost]
    public async Task<IActionResult> Create([FromBody] CreateMaintenanceRequest request)
    {
        try
        {
            var result = await _service.CreateAsync(request, CurrentUserId);
            return CreatedAtAction(nameof(GetById), new { id = result.Id }, result);
        }
        catch (KeyNotFoundException ex) { return NotFound(new { error = ex.Message }); }
        catch (InvalidOperationException ex) { return BadRequest(new { error = ex.Message }); }
    }

    /// <summary>Admin lists all maintenance requests.</summary>
    [HttpGet]
    [Authorize(Roles = Roles.Admin)]
    public async Task<IActionResult> GetAll() => Ok(await _service.GetAllAsync());

    /// <summary>Tenant lists their own maintenance requests.</summary>
    [HttpGet("mine")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> GetMine() => Ok(await _service.GetMineAsync(CurrentUserId));

    /// <summary>Get one request (owner or admin).</summary>
    [HttpGet("{id:guid}")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> GetById(Guid id)
    {
        var result = await _service.GetByIdAsync(id, CurrentUserId, IsAdmin);
        return result is null ? NotFound() : Ok(result);
    }

    /// <summary>Admin assigns a request to themselves.</summary>
    [HttpPatch("{id:guid}/assign")]
    [Authorize(Roles = Roles.Admin)]
    public async Task<IActionResult> Assign(Guid id)
    {
        try { return Ok(await _service.AssignAsync(id, CurrentUserId)); }
        catch (KeyNotFoundException ex) { return NotFound(new { error = ex.Message }); }
    }

    /// <summary>Admin updates the status of a request.</summary>
    [HttpPatch("{id:guid}/status")]
    [Authorize(Roles = Roles.Admin)]
    public async Task<IActionResult> UpdateStatus(Guid id, [FromBody] UpdateMaintenanceStatusRequest request)
    {
        try { return Ok(await _service.UpdateStatusAsync(id, request.Status, request.ResolutionNotes)); }
        catch (KeyNotFoundException ex) { return NotFound(new { error = ex.Message }); }
    }

11. src/UniCribz.Api/Services/AnnouncementService.cs
csharp
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using UniCribz.Api.DTOs.Requests;
using UniCribz.Api.DTOs.Responses;
using UniCribz.Api.Services.Interfaces;
using UniCribz.Data.Context;
using UniCribz.Data.Entities;

namespace UniCribz.Api.Services;

public class AnnouncementService : IAnnouncementService
{
    private readonly UniCribzDbContext _db;
    private readonly ILogger<AnnouncementService> _logger;

    public AnnouncementService(UniCribzDbContext db, ILogger<AnnouncementService> logger)
    {
        _db = db;
        _logger = logger;
    }

    public async Task<IEnumerable<AnnouncementResponse>> GetAllActiveAsync()
    {
        var now = DateTime.UtcNow;
        var list = await Query()
            .Where(a => a.IsActive && (a.ExpiresAt == null || a.ExpiresAt > now))
            .OrderByDescending(a => a.PublishedAt)
            .ToListAsync();
        return list.Select(Map);
    }

    public async Task<IEnumerable<AnnouncementResponse>> GetAllAsync()
    {
        var list = await Query().OrderByDescending(a => a.PublishedAt).ToListAsync();
        return list.Select(Map);
    }

    public async Task<AnnouncementResponse> CreateAsync(CreateAnnouncementRequest request, Guid adminUserId)
    {
        if (request.PropertyId.HasValue)
        {
            var propExists = await _db.Properties.AnyAsync(p => p.Id == request.PropertyId);
            if (!propExists) throw new KeyNotFoundException("Property not found.");
        }

        var entity = new Announcement
        {
            PropertyId = request.PropertyId,
            AdminId = adminUserId,
            Title = request.Title.Trim(),
            Content = request.Content.Trim(),
            Category = request.Category,
            IsActive = request.IsActive,
            ExpiresAt = request.ExpiresAt,
            PublishedAt = DateTime.UtcNow
        };

        _db.Announcements.Add(entity);
        await _db.SaveChangesAsync();

        _logger.LogInformation("Announcement {Id} published by admin {AdminId}", entity.Id, adminUserId);
        return await LoadResponse(entity.Id);
    }

    public async Task DeleteAsync(Guid id)
    {
        var a = await _db.Announcements.FindAsync(id)
            ?? throw new KeyNotFoundException("Announcement not found.");
        _db.Announcements.Remove(a);
        await _db.SaveChangesAsync();
        _logger.LogInformation("Announcement {Id} deleted", id);
    }

    private IQueryable<Announcement> Query() =>
        _db.Announcements
           .Include(a => a.Property)
           .Include(a => a.Admin);

    private async Task<AnnouncementResponse> LoadResponse(Guid id)
    {
        var a = await Query().FirstAsync(x => x.Id == id);
        return Map(a);
    }

    private static AnnouncementResponse Map(Announcement a) => new()
    {
        Id = a.Id,
        PropertyId = a.PropertyId,
        PropertyName = a.Property?.Name,
        AdminId = a.AdminId,
        AdminName = a.Admin?.FullName ?? string.Empty,
        Title = a.Title,
        Content = a.Content,
        Category = a.Category,
        IsActive = a.IsActive,
        PublishedAt = a.PublishedAt,
        ExpiresAt = a.ExpiresAt
    };
}

public interface IReportService
{
    Task<OccupancyReportResponse> GetOccupancyAsync();
