18. src/UniCribz.Api/Services/ReportService.cs
csharp
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using UniCribz.Api.DTOs.Responses;
using UniCribz.Api.Services.Interfaces;
using UniCribz.Data.Context;
using UniCribz.Data.Enums;

namespace UniCribz.Api.Services;

public class ReportService : IReportService
{
    private readonly UniCribzDbContext _db;
    public ReportService(UniCribzDbContext db) => _db = db;

    public async Task<OccupancyReportResponse> GetOccupancyAsync()
    {
        var totalProperties = await _db.Properties.CountAsync(p => p.IsActive);
        var rooms = await _db.Rooms.ToListAsync();

        var total = rooms.Count;
        var available = rooms.Count(r => r.Status == RoomStatus.Available);
        var reserved  = rooms.Count(r => r.Status == RoomStatus.Reserved);
        var occupied  = rooms.Count(r => r.Status == RoomStatus.Occupied);
        var maintenance = rooms.Count(r => r.Status == RoomStatus.UnderMaintenance);

        return new OccupancyReportResponse
        {
            TotalProperties = totalProperties,
            TotalRooms = total,
            AvailableRooms = available,
            ReservedRooms = reserved,
            OccupiedRooms = occupied,
            UnderMaintenanceRooms = maintenance,
            OccupancyRate = total == 0 ? 0 : Math.Round((double)(occupied + reserved) / total * 100, 2)
        };
    }

    public async Task<PaymentReportResponse> GetPaymentsAsync()
    {
        var payments = await _db.Payments.ToListAsync();

        var expected = payments.Sum(p => p.Amount);
        var received = payments.Where(p => p.Status == PaymentStatus.Paid).Sum(p => p.Amount);
        var outstanding = expected - received;

        return new PaymentReportResponse
        {
            TotalPayments = payments.Count,
            PendingCount = payments.Count(p => p.Status == PaymentStatus.Pending),
            VerifiedCount = payments.Count(p => p.Status == PaymentStatus.Verified),
            PaidCount = payments.Count(p => p.Status == PaymentStatus.Paid),
            FailedCount = payments.Count(p => p.Status == PaymentStatus.Failed),
            TotalExpected = expected,
            TotalReceived = received,
            TotalOutstanding = outstanding < 0 ? 0 : outstanding
        };
    }

    public async Task<MaintenanceReportResponse> GetMaintenanceAsync()
    {
        var list = await _db.MaintenanceRequests.ToListAsync();

        var completed = list.Where(m => m.Status == MaintenanceStatus.Completed && m.ResolvedAt.HasValue).ToList();
        var avgDays = completed.Count == 0
            ? 0
            : Math.Round(completed.Average(m => (m.ResolvedAt!.Value - m.CreatedAt).TotalDays), 2);

        return new MaintenanceReportResponse
        {
            TotalRequests = list.Count,
            Submitted = list.Count(m => m.Status == MaintenanceStatus.Submitted),
            Assigned = list.Count(m => m.Status == MaintenanceStatus.Assigned),
            InProgress = list.Count(m => m.Status == MaintenanceStatus.InProgress),
            OnHold = list.Count(m => m.Status == MaintenanceStatus.OnHold),
            Completed = list.Count(m => m.Status == MaintenanceStatus.Completed),
            Reopened = list.Count(m => m.Status == MaintenanceStatus.Reopened),
            AverageResolutionDays = avgDays
        };
    }

    public async Task<DashboardReportResponse> GetDashboardAsync()
    {
        var activeApplications = await _db.Applications
            .CountAsync(a => a.Status == ApplicationStatus.Submitted
                          || a.Status == ApplicationStatus.UnderReview);

        var activeViewings = await _db.Viewings
            .CountAsync(v => v.Status == ViewingStatus.Requested
                          || v.Status == ViewingStatus.Approved);

        return new DashboardReportResponse
        {
            Occupancy = await GetOccupancyAsync(),
            Payments = await GetPaymentsAsync(),
            Maintenance = await GetMaintenanceAsync(),
            ActiveApplications = activeApplications,
            ActiveViewings = activeViewings,
            GeneratedAt = DateTime.UtcNow
        };
    }
}

Because it nests the other three inside it:

public class DashboardReportResponse
{
    public OccupancyReportResponse Occupancy { get; set; } = new();
    public PaymentReportResponse Payments { get; set; } = new();
    public MaintenanceReportResponse Maintenance { get; set; } = new();
    public int ActiveApplications { get; set; }
    public int ActiveViewings { get; set; }
    public DateTime GeneratedAt { get; set; }
}

File 3: src/UniCribz.Api/Services/MaintenanceService.cs
csharp
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using UniCribz.Api.DTOs.Requests;
using UniCribz.Api.DTOs.Responses;
using UniCribz.Api.Services.Interfaces;
using UniCribz.Data.Context;
using UniCribz.Data.Entities;
using UniCribz.Data.Enums;

namespace UniCribz.Api.Services;

public class MaintenanceService : IMaintenanceService
{
    private readonly UniCribzDbContext _db;
    private readonly ILogger<MaintenanceService> _logger;

    public MaintenanceService(UniCribzDbContext db, ILogger<MaintenanceService> logger)
    {
        _db = db;
        _logger = logger;
    }

    public async Task<MaintenanceResponse> CreateAsync(CreateMaintenanceRequest request, Guid tenantUserId)
    {
        var tenant = await _db.Tenants.FirstOrDefaultAsync(t => t.Id == tenantUserId)
            ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("Only tenants can submit maintenance requests.");

        var room = await _db.Rooms.FindAsync(request.RoomId)
            ?? throw new KeyNotFoundException("Room not found.");

        var entity = new MaintenanceRequest
        {
            TenantId = tenantUserId,
            RoomId = request.RoomId,
            Title = request.Title.Trim(),
            Description = request.Description.Trim(),
            Category = request.Category,
            Priority = request.Priority,
            Status = MaintenanceStatus.Submitted,
            CreatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow
        };

        _db.MaintenanceRequests.Add(entity);
        await _db.SaveChangesAsync();

        _logger.LogInformation("Maintenance {Id} submitted by tenant {TenantId}", entity.Id, tenantUserId);
        return await LoadResponse(entity.Id);
    }

    public async Task<IEnumerable<MaintenanceResponse>> GetAllAsync()
    {
        var list = await Query().OrderByDescending(m => m.CreatedAt).ToListAsync();
        return list.Select(Map);
    }

    public async Task<IEnumerable<MaintenanceResponse>> GetMineAsync(Guid tenantUserId)
    {
        var list = await Query()
            .Where(m => m.TenantId == tenantUserId)
            .OrderByDescending(m => m.CreatedAt)
            .ToListAsync();
        return list.Select(Map);
    }

    public async Task<MaintenanceResponse?> GetByIdAsync(Guid id, Guid requesterId, bool isAdmin)
    {
        var m = await Query().FirstOrDefaultAsync(x => x.Id == id);
        if (m is null) return null;
        if (!isAdmin && m.TenantId != requesterId) return null;
        return Map(m);
    }

    public async Task<MaintenanceResponse> AssignAsync(Guid id, Guid adminUserId)
    {
        var m = await _db.MaintenanceRequests.FindAsync(id)
            ?? throw new KeyNotFoundException("Maintenance request not found.");

        m.AssignedToAdminId = adminUserId;
        m.Status = MaintenanceStatus.Assigned;
        m.UpdatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;

        await _db.SaveChangesAsync();
        _logger.LogInformation("Maintenance {Id} assigned to admin {AdminId}", id, adminUserId);
        return await LoadResponse(id);
    }

    public async Task<MaintenanceResponse> UpdateStatusAsync(Guid id, MaintenanceStatus status, string? notes)
    {
        var m = await _db.MaintenanceRequests.FindAsync(id)
            ?? throw new KeyNotFoundException("Maintenance request not found.");

        m.Status = status;
        m.UpdatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
        if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(notes)) m.ResolutionNotes = notes;
        if (status == MaintenanceStatus.Completed) m.ResolvedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;

        await _db.SaveChangesAsync();
        _logger.LogInformation("Maintenance {Id} status to {Status}", id, status);
        return await LoadResponse(id);
    }

    private IQueryable<MaintenanceRequest> Query() =>
        _db.MaintenanceRequests
           .Include(m => m.Tenant)
           .Include(m => m.Room)
           .ThenInclude(r => r!.Property);

    private async Task<MaintenanceResponse> LoadResponse(Guid id)
    {
        var m = await Query().FirstAsync(x => x.Id == id);
        return Map(m);
    }

    private static MaintenanceResponse Map(MaintenanceRequest m) => new()
    {
        Id = m.Id,
        TenantId = m.TenantId,
        TenantFullName = m.Tenant?.FullName ?? string.Empty,
        TenantEmail = m.Tenant?.Email ?? string.Empty,
        RoomId = m.RoomId,
        RoomNumber = m.Room?.RoomNumber ?? string.Empty,
        PropertyName = m.Room?.Property?.Name ?? string.Empty,
        Title = m.Title,
        Description = m.Description,
        Category = m.Category,
        Priority = m.Priority,
        Status = m.Status.ToString(),
        AssignedToAdminId = m.AssignedToAdminId,
        CreatedAt = m.CreatedAt,
        ResolvedAt = m.ResolvedAt,
        ResolutionNotes = m.ResolutionNotes
    };
}
File 4: src/UniCribz.Api/Services/AnnouncementService.cs
csharp
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using UniCribz.Api.DTOs.Requests;
using UniCribz.Api.DTOs.Responses;
using UniCribz.Api.Services.Interfaces;
using UniCribz.Data.Context;
using UniCribz.Data.Entities;

namespace UniCribz.Api.Services;

public class AnnouncementService : IAnnouncementService
{
    private readonly UniCribzDbContext _db;
    private readonly ILogger<AnnouncementService> _logger;

    public AnnouncementService(UniCribzDbContext db, ILogger<AnnouncementService> logger)
    {
        _db = db;
        _logger = logger;
    }

    public async Task<IEnumerable<AnnouncementResponse>> GetAllActiveAsync()
    {
        var now = DateTime.UtcNow;
        var list = await Query()
            .Where(a => a.IsActive && (a.ExpiresAt == null || a.ExpiresAt > now))
            .OrderByDescending(a => a.PublishedAt)
            .ToListAsync();
        return list.Select(Map);
    }

    public async Task<IEnumerable<AnnouncementResponse>> GetAllAsync()
    {
        var list = await Query().OrderByDescending(a => a.PublishedAt).ToListAsync();
        return list.Select(Map);
    }

    public async Task<AnnouncementResponse> CreateAsync(CreateAnnouncementRequest request, Guid adminUserId)
    {
        if (request.PropertyId.HasValue)
        {
            var propExists = await _db.Properties.AnyAsync(p => p.Id == request.PropertyId);
            if (!propExists) throw new KeyNotFoundException("Property not found.");
        }

        var entity = new Announcement
        {
            PropertyId = request.PropertyId,
            AdminId = adminUserId,
            Title = request.Title.Trim(),
            Content = request.Content.Trim(),
            Category = request.Category,
            IsActive = request.IsActive,
            ExpiresAt = request.ExpiresAt,
            PublishedAt = DateTime.UtcNow
        };

        _db.Announcements.Add(entity);
        await _db.SaveChangesAsync();

        _logger.LogInformation("Announcement {Id} published by admin {AdminId}", entity.Id, adminUserId);
        return await LoadResponse(entity.Id);
    }

    public async Task DeleteAsync(Guid id)
    {
        var a = await _db.Announcements.FindAsync(id)
            ?? throw new KeyNotFoundException("Announcement not found.");
        _db.Announcements.Remove(a);
        await _db.SaveChangesAsync();
        _logger.LogInformation("Announcement {Id} deleted", id);
    }

    private IQueryable<Announcement> Query() =>
        _db.Announcements
           .Include(a => a.Property)
           .Include(a => a.Admin);

    private async Task<AnnouncementResponse> LoadResponse(Guid id)
    {
        var a = await Query().FirstAsync(x => x.Id == id);
        return Map(a);
    }

    private static AnnouncementResponse Map(Announcement a) => new()
    {
        Id = a.Id,
        PropertyId = a.PropertyId,
        PropertyName = a.Property?.Name,
        AdminId = a.AdminId,
        AdminName = a.Admin?.FullName ?? string.Empty,
        Title = a.Title,
        Content = a.Content,
        Category = a.Category,
        IsActive = a.IsActive,
        PublishedAt = a.PublishedAt,
        ExpiresAt = a.ExpiresAt
    };
}
File 5: src/UniCribz.Api/Services/ReportService.cs
csharp
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using UniCribz.Api.DTOs.Responses;
using UniCribz.Api.Services.Interfaces;
using UniCribz.Data.Context;
using UniCribz.Data.Enums;

namespace UniCribz.Api.Services;

public class ReportService : IReportService
{
    private readonly UniCribzDbContext _db;
    public ReportService(UniCribzDbContext db) => _db = db;

    public async Task<OccupancyReportResponse> GetOccupancyAsync()
    {
        var totalProperties = await _db.Properties.CountAsync(p => p.IsActive);
        var rooms = await _db.Rooms.ToListAsync();

        var total = rooms.Count;
        var available = rooms.Count(r => r.Status == RoomStatus.Available);
        var reserved = rooms.Count(r => r.Status == RoomStatus.Reserved);
        var occupied = rooms.Count(r => r.Status == RoomStatus.Occupied);
        var maintenance = rooms.Count(r => r.Status == RoomStatus.UnderMaintenance);

        return new OccupancyReportResponse
        {
            TotalProperties = totalProperties,
            TotalRooms = total,
            AvailableRooms = available,
            ReservedRooms = reserved,
            OccupiedRooms = occupied,
            UnderMaintenanceRooms = maintenance,
            OccupancyRate = total == 0 ? 0 : Math.Round((double)(occupied + reserved) / total * 100, 2)
        };
    }

    public async Task<PaymentReportResponse> GetPaymentsAsync()
    {
        var payments = await _db.Payments.ToListAsync();

        var expected = payments.Sum(p => p.Amount);
        var received = payments.Where(p => p.Status == PaymentStatus.Paid).Sum(p => p.Amount);
        var outstanding = expected - received;

        return new PaymentReportResponse
        {
            TotalPayments = payments.Count,
            PendingCount = payments.Count(p => p.Status == PaymentStatus.Pending),
            VerifiedCount = payments.Count(p => p.Status == PaymentStatus.Verified),
            PaidCount = payments.Count(p => p.Status == PaymentStatus.Paid),
            FailedCount = payments.Count(p => p.Status == PaymentStatus.Failed),
            TotalExpected = expected,
            TotalReceived = received,
            TotalOutstanding = outstanding < 0 ? 0 : outstanding
        };
    }

    public async Task<MaintenanceReportResponse> GetMaintenanceAsync()
    {
        var list = await _db.MaintenanceRequests.ToListAsync();

        var completed = list.Where(m => m.Status == MaintenanceStatus.Completed && m.ResolvedAt.HasValue).ToList();
        var avgDays = completed.Count == 0
            ? 0
            : Math.Round(completed.Average(m => (m.ResolvedAt!.Value - m.CreatedAt).TotalDays), 2);

        return new MaintenanceReportResponse
        {
            TotalRequests = list.Count,
            Submitted = list.Count(m => m.Status == MaintenanceStatus.Submitted),
            Assigned = list.Count(m => m.Status == MaintenanceStatus.Assigned),
            InProgress = list.Count(m => m.Status == MaintenanceStatus.InProgress),
            OnHold = list.Count(m => m.Status == MaintenanceStatus.OnHold),
            Completed = list.Count(m => m.Status == MaintenanceStatus.Completed),
            Reopened = list.Count(m => m.Status == MaintenanceStatus.Reopened),
            AverageResolutionDays = avgDays
        };
    }

    public async Task<DashboardReportResponse> GetDashboardAsync()
    {
        var activeApplications = await _db.Applications
            .CountAsync(a => a.Status == ApplicationStatus.Submitted
                          || a.Status == ApplicationStatus.UnderReview);

        var activeViewings = await _db.Viewings
            .CountAsync(v => v.Status == ViewingStatus.Requested
                          || v.Status == ViewingStatus.Approved);

        return new DashboardReportResponse
        {
            Occupancy = await GetOccupancyAsync(),
            Payments = await GetPaymentsAsync(),
            Maintenance = await GetMaintenanceAsync(),
            ActiveApplications = activeApplications,
            ActiveViewings = activeViewings,
            GeneratedAt = DateTime.UtcNow
        };
    }
}

1.4 src/UniCribz.Api/Services/LeaseService.cs
csharp
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using UniCribz.Api.DTOs.Requests;
using UniCribz.Api.DTOs.Responses;
using UniCribz.Api.Services.Interfaces;
using UniCribz.Data.Context;
using UniCribz.Data.Entities;
using UniCribz.Data.Enums;

namespace UniCribz.Api.Services;

public class LeaseService : ILeaseService
{
    private readonly UniCribzDbContext _db;
    private readonly ILogger<LeaseService> _logger;

    public LeaseService(UniCribzDbContext db, ILogger<LeaseService> logger)
    {
        _db = db;
        _logger = logger;
    }

    public async Task<IEnumerable<LeaseResponse>> GetAllAsync()
    {
        var list = await Query().OrderByDescending(l => l.CreatedAt).ToListAsync();
        return list.Select(Map);
    }

    public async Task<IEnumerable<LeaseResponse>> GetMineAsync(Guid tenantUserId)
    {
        var list = await Query()
            .Where(l => l.TenantId == tenantUserId)
            .OrderByDescending(l => l.CreatedAt)
            .ToListAsync();
        return list.Select(Map);
    }

    public async Task<LeaseResponse?> GetByIdAsync(Guid id, Guid requesterId, bool isAdmin)
    {
        var l = await Query().FirstOrDefaultAsync(x => x.Id == id);
        if (l is null) return null;
        if (!isAdmin && l.TenantId != requesterId) return null;
        return Map(l);
    }

    public async Task<LeaseResponse> CreateAsync(CreateLeaseRequest request)
    {
        var tenant = await _db.Tenants.FindAsync(request.TenantId)
            ?? throw new KeyNotFoundException("Tenant not found.");

        var room = await _db.Rooms.FindAsync(request.RoomId)
            ?? throw new KeyNotFoundException("Room not found.");

        if (request.EndDate <= request.StartDate)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("End date must be after start date.");

        var lease = new Lease
        {
            TenantId = request.TenantId,
            RoomId = request.RoomId,
            StartDate = request.StartDate,
            EndDate = request.EndDate,
            MonthlyRent = request.MonthlyRent,
            DepositAmount = request.DepositAmount,
            Status = LeaseStatus.PendingSignature,
            CreatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow
        };

        _db.Leases.Add(lease);
        room.Status = RoomStatus.Reserved;
        await _db.SaveChangesAsync();

        _logger.LogInformation("Lease {Id} created for tenant {TenantId}", lease.Id, request.TenantId);
        return await LoadResponse(lease.Id);
    }

    public async Task<LeaseResponse> SignAsync(Guid id, Guid tenantUserId)
    {
        var lease = await _db.Leases.FindAsync(id)
            ?? throw new KeyNotFoundException("Lease not found.");

        if (lease.TenantId != tenantUserId)
            throw new UnauthorizedAccessException("You can only sign your own lease.");

        if (lease.Status != LeaseStatus.PendingSignature)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("Only pending leases can be signed.");

        lease.Status = LeaseStatus.Active;
        lease.SignedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
        lease.UpdatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;

        // Also mark room as Occupied
        var room = await _db.Rooms.FindAsync(lease.RoomId);
        if (room is not null) room.Status = RoomStatus.Occupied;

        await _db.SaveChangesAsync();
        _logger.LogInformation("Lease {Id} signed by tenant {TenantId}", id, tenantUserId);
        return await LoadResponse(id);
    }

    public async Task<LeaseResponse> TerminateAsync(Guid id, string? reason)
    {
        var lease = await _db.Leases.FindAsync(id)
            ?? throw new KeyNotFoundException("Lease not found.");

        lease.Status = LeaseStatus.Terminated;
        lease.UpdatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;

        var room = await _db.Rooms.FindAsync(lease.RoomId);
        if (room is not null) room.Status = RoomStatus.Available;

        await _db.SaveChangesAsync();
        _logger.LogInformation("Lease {Id} terminated. Reason: {Reason}", id, reason);
        return await LoadResponse(id);
    }

    private IQueryable<Lease> Query() =>
        _db.Leases
           .Include(l => l.Tenant)
           .Include(l => l.Room)
           .ThenInclude(r => r!.Property);

    private async Task<LeaseResponse> LoadResponse(Guid id)
    {
        var l = await Query().FirstAsync(x => x.Id == id);
        return Map(l);
    }

    private static LeaseResponse Map(Lease l) => new()
    {
        Id = l.Id,
        TenantId = l.TenantId,
        TenantFullName = l.Tenant?.FullName ?? string.Empty,
        TenantEmail = l.Tenant?.Email ?? string.Empty,
        RoomId = l.RoomId,
        RoomNumber = l.Room?.RoomNumber ?? string.Empty,
        PropertyName = l.Room?.Property?.Name ?? string.Empty,
        StartDate = l.StartDate,
        EndDate = l.EndDate,
        MonthlyRent = l.MonthlyRent,
        DepositAmount = l.DepositAmount,
        Status = l.Status.ToString(),
        SignedAt = l.SignedAt,
        LeaseDocumentUrl = l.LeaseDocumentUrl,
        CreatedAt = l.CreatedAt
    };
}
1.5 src/UniCribz.Api/Controllers/LeaseController.cs
csharp
using System.Security.Claims;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using UniCribz.Api.DTOs.Requests;
using UniCribz.Api.Services.Interfaces;
using UniCribz.Shared.Constants;

namespace UniCribz.Api.Controllers;

[ApiController]
[Route("api/leases")]
[Authorize]
public class LeaseController : ControllerBase
{
    private readonly ILeaseService _service;
    public LeaseController(ILeaseService service) => _service = service;

    private Guid CurrentUserId =>
        Guid.Parse(User.FindFirstValue(ClaimTypes.NameIdentifier) ?? User.FindFirstValue("sub")!);
    private bool IsAdmin => User.IsInRole(Roles.Admin);

    /// <summary>Admin lists all leases.</summary>
    [HttpGet]
    [Authorize(Roles = Roles.Admin)]
    public async Task<IActionResult> GetAll() => Ok(await _service.GetAllAsync());

    /// <summary>Tenant lists their own leases.</summary>
    [HttpGet("mine")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> GetMine() => Ok(await _service.GetMineAsync(CurrentUserId));

    /// <summary>Get one lease (owner or admin).</summary>
    [HttpGet("{id:guid}")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> GetById(Guid id)
    {
        var result = await _service.GetByIdAsync(id, CurrentUserId, IsAdmin);
        return result is null ? NotFound() : Ok(result);
    }

    /// <summary>Admin creates a lease (typically after approving an application).</summary>
    [HttpPost]
    [Authorize(Roles = Roles.Admin)]
    public async Task<IActionResult> Create([FromBody] CreateLeaseRequest request)
    {
        try
        {
            var result = await _service.CreateAsync(request);
            return CreatedAtAction(nameof(GetById), new { id = result.Id }, result);
        }
        catch (KeyNotFoundException ex) { return NotFound(new { error = ex.Message }); }
        catch (InvalidOperationException ex) { return BadRequest(new { error = ex.Message }); }
    }

    /// <summary>Tenant signs their lease, activating it.</summary>
    [HttpPost("{id:guid}/sign")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> Sign(Guid id)
    {
        try { return Ok(await _service.SignAsync(id, CurrentUserId)); }
        catch (KeyNotFoundException ex) { return NotFound(new { error = ex.Message }); }
        catch (UnauthorizedAccessException ex) { return Forbid(ex.Message); }
        catch (InvalidOperationException ex) { return BadRequest(new { error = ex.Message }); }
    }

    /// <summary>Admin terminates a lease, releasing the room.</summary>
    [HttpPatch("{id:guid}/terminate")]
    [Authorize(Roles = Roles.Admin)]
    public async Task<IActionResult> Terminate(Guid id, [FromBody] TerminateLeaseRequest request)
    {
        try { return Ok(await _service.TerminateAsync(id, request.Reason)); }
        catch (KeyNotFoundException ex) { return NotFound(new { error = ex.Message }); }
    }
}

public class TerminateLeaseRequest
{
    public string? Reason { get; set; }
}

2.6 src/UniCribz.Api/Services/PaymentService.cs
csharp
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using UniCribz.Api.DTOs.Requests;
using UniCribz.Api.DTOs.Responses;
using UniCribz.Api.Services.Interfaces;
using UniCribz.Data.Context;
using UniCribz.Data.Entities;
using UniCribz.Data.Enums;

namespace UniCribz.Api.Services;

public class PaymentService : IPaymentService
{
    private readonly UniCribzDbContext _db;
    private readonly ILogger<PaymentService> _logger;

    public PaymentService(UniCribzDbContext db, ILogger<PaymentService> logger)
    {
        _db = db;
        _logger = logger;
    }

    public async Task<IEnumerable<PaymentResponse>> GetAllAsync()
    {
        var list = await Query().OrderByDescending(p => p.CreatedAt).ToListAsync();
        return list.Select(Map);
    }

    public async Task<IEnumerable<PaymentResponse>> GetMineAsync(Guid tenantUserId)
    {
        var list = await Query()
            .Where(p => p.TenantId == tenantUserId)
            .OrderByDescending(p => p.CreatedAt)
            .ToListAsync();
        return list.Select(Map);
    }

    public async Task<PaymentResponse?> GetByIdAsync(Guid id, Guid requesterId, bool isAdmin)
    {
        var p = await Query().FirstOrDefaultAsync(x => x.Id == id);
        if (p is null) return null;
        if (!isAdmin && p.TenantId != requesterId) return null;
        return Map(p);
    }

    public async Task<PaymentResponse> InitiateAsync(InitiatePaymentRequest request, Guid tenantUserId)
    {
        var lease = await _db.Leases.FindAsync(request.LeaseId)
            ?? throw new KeyNotFoundException("Lease not found.");

        if (lease.TenantId != tenantUserId)
            throw new UnauthorizedAccessException("You can only pay for your own lease.");

        var payment = new Payment
        {
            LeaseId = request.LeaseId,
            TenantId = tenantUserId,
            Amount = request.Amount,
            PaymentType = request.PaymentType,
            DueDate = request.DueDate,
            Method = request.Method,
            Status = PaymentStatus.Pending,
            ReferenceNumber = $"UNI-{DateTime.UtcNow:yyyyMMdd}-{Guid.NewGuid().ToString()[..6].ToUpper()}",
            CreatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow
        };

        _db.Payments.Add(payment);
        await _db.SaveChangesAsync();

        _logger.LogInformation("Payment {Id} initiated for lease {LeaseId}", payment.Id, request.LeaseId);
        return await LoadResponse(payment.Id);
    }

    public async Task<PaymentResponse> UploadProofAsync(Guid id, UploadProofOfPaymentRequest request, Guid tenantUserId)
    {
        var payment = await _db.Payments.FindAsync(id)
            ?? throw new KeyNotFoundException("Payment not found.");

        if (payment.TenantId != tenantUserId)
            throw new UnauthorizedAccessException("You can only update your own payments.");

        payment.ProofOfPaymentUrl = request.ProofOfPaymentUrl;
        payment.ReferenceNumber = request.ReferenceNumber;
        payment.Status = PaymentStatus.Verified;
        payment.PaymentDate = DateTime.UtcNow;

        await _db.SaveChangesAsync();
        _logger.LogInformation("Proof uploaded for payment {Id}", id);
        return await LoadResponse(id);
    }

    public async Task<PaymentResponse> VerifyAsync(Guid id, VerifyPaymentRequest request, Guid adminUserId)
    {
        var payment = await _db.Payments.FindAsync(id)
            ?? throw new KeyNotFoundException("Payment not found.");

        payment.Status = request.Status;
        payment.VerifiedByAdminId = adminUserId;
        payment.VerifiedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
        if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(request.Notes)) payment.Notes = request.Notes;

        await _db.SaveChangesAsync();
        _logger.LogInformation("Payment {Id} verified as {Status} by admin {AdminId}", id, request.Status, adminUserId);
        return await LoadResponse(id);
    }

    public async Task<PaymentResponse> GetReceiptAsync(Guid id, Guid requesterId, bool isAdmin)
    {
        var p = await Query().FirstOrDefaultAsync(x => x.Id == id)
            ?? throw new KeyNotFoundException("Payment not found.");

        if (!isAdmin && p.TenantId != requesterId)
            throw new UnauthorizedAccessException("You can only view your own receipts.");

        return Map(p);
    }

    private IQueryable<Payment> Query() =>
        _db.Payments
           .Include(p => p.Tenant)
           .Include(p => p.Lease);

    private async Task<PaymentResponse> LoadResponse(Guid id)
    {
        var p = await Query().FirstAsync(x => x.Id == id);
        return Map(p);
    }

    private static PaymentResponse Map(Payment p) => new()
    {
        Id = p.Id,
        LeaseId = p.LeaseId,
        TenantId = p.TenantId,
        TenantFullName = p.Tenant?.FullName ?? string.Empty,
        Amount = p.Amount,
        PaymentType = p.PaymentType,
        DueDate = p.DueDate,
        PaymentDate = p.PaymentDate,
        Status = p.Status.ToString(),
        Method = p.Method,
        ReferenceNumber = p.ReferenceNumber,
        ProofOfPaymentUrl = p.ProofOfPaymentUrl,
        VerifiedAt = p.VerifiedAt,
        Notes = p.Notes,
        CreatedAt = p.CreatedAt
    };
}

3.5 src/UniCribz.Api/Services/ComplaintService.cs + Controller
ComplaintService.cs:

csharp
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using UniCribz.Api.DTOs.Requests;
using UniCribz.Api.DTOs.Responses;
using UniCribz.Api.Services.Interfaces;
using UniCribz.Data.Context;
using UniCribz.Data.Entities;
using UniCribz.Data.Enums;

namespace UniCribz.Api.Services;

public class ComplaintService : IComplaintService
{
    private readonly UniCribzDbContext _db;
    private readonly ILogger<ComplaintService> _logger;

    public ComplaintService(UniCribzDbContext db, ILogger<ComplaintService> logger)
    {
        _db = db;
        _logger = logger;
    }

    public async Task<ComplaintResponse> CreateAsync(CreateComplaintRequest request, Guid tenantUserId)
    {
        var tenant = await _db.Tenants.FindAsync(tenantUserId)
            ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("Only tenants can submit complaints.");

        var entity = new Complaint
        {
            TenantId = tenantUserId,
            Subject = request.Subject.Trim(),
            Description = request.Description.Trim(),
            Category = request.Category,
            IsConfidential = request.IsConfidential,
            Status = ComplaintStatus.Submitted,
            CreatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow
        };

        _db.Complaints.Add(entity);
        await _db.SaveChangesAsync();

        _logger.LogInformation("Complaint {Id} submitted by tenant {TenantId}", entity.Id, tenantUserId);
        return await LoadResponse(entity.Id);
    }

    public async Task<IEnumerable<ComplaintResponse>> GetAllAsync()
    {
        var list = await Query().OrderByDescending(c => c.CreatedAt).ToListAsync();
        return list.Select(Map);
    }

    public async Task<IEnumerable<ComplaintResponse>> GetMineAsync(Guid tenantUserId)
    {
        var list = await Query().Where(c => c.TenantId == tenantUserId)
                                .OrderByDescending(c => c.CreatedAt).ToListAsync();
        return list.Select(Map);
    }

    public async Task<ComplaintResponse> UpdateStatusAsync(Guid id, ComplaintStatus status, string? notes, Guid adminUserId)
    {
        var c = await _db.Complaints.FindAsync(id)
            ?? throw new KeyNotFoundException("Complaint not found.");

        c.Status = status;
        c.HandledByAdminId = adminUserId;
        c.UpdatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
        if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(notes)) c.ResolutionNotes = notes;
        if (status == ComplaintStatus.Resolved) c.ResolvedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;

        await _db.SaveChangesAsync();
        _logger.LogInformation("Complaint {Id} status to {Status} by admin {AdminId}", id, status, adminUserId);
        return await LoadResponse(id);
    }

    private IQueryable<Complaint> Query() =>
        _db.Complaints.Include(c => c.Tenant).Include(c => c.HandledByAdmin);

    private async Task<ComplaintResponse> LoadResponse(Guid id)
    {
        var c = await Query().FirstAsync(x => x.Id == id);
        return Map(c);
    }

    private static ComplaintResponse Map(Complaint c) => new()
    {
        Id = c.Id,
        TenantId = c.TenantId,
        TenantFullName = c.Tenant?.FullName ?? string.Empty,
        Subject = c.Subject,
        Description = c.Description,
        Category = c.Category,
        Status = c.Status.ToString(),
        IsConfidential = c.IsConfidential,
        HandledByAdminId = c.HandledByAdminId,
        HandledByAdminName = c.HandledByAdmin?.FullName,
        CreatedAt = c.CreatedAt,
        ResolvedAt = c.ResolvedAt,
        ResolutionNotes = c.ResolutionNotes
    };
}

4.3 src/UniCribz.Api/Services/NotificationService.cs
csharp
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using UniCribz.Api.DTOs.Responses;
using UniCribz.Api.Services.Interfaces;
using UniCribz.Data.Context;

namespace UniCribz.Api.Services;

public class NotificationService : INotificationService
{
    private readonly UniCribzDbContext _db;
    public NotificationService(UniCribzDbContext db) => _db = db;

    public async Task<IEnumerable<NotificationResponse>> GetMineAsync(Guid userId)
    {
        var list = await _db.Notifications
            .Where(n => n.UserId == userId)
            .OrderByDescending(n => n.CreatedAt)
            .ToListAsync();

        return list.Select(Map);
    }

    public async Task<NotificationResponse> MarkAsReadAsync(Guid id, Guid userId)
    {
        var n = await _db.Notifications.FindAsync(id)
            ?? throw new KeyNotFoundException("Notification not found.");

        if (n.UserId != userId)
            throw new UnauthorizedAccessException("You can only read your own notifications.");

        n.IsRead = true;
        n.ReadAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
        await _db.SaveChangesAsync();
        return Map(n);
    }

    public Task<int> GetUnreadCountAsync(Guid userId) =>
        _db.Notifications.CountAsync(n => n.UserId == userId && !n.IsRead);

    private static NotificationResponse Map(Data.Entities.Notification n) => new()
    {
        Id = n.Id,
        Title = n.Title,
        Message = n.Message,
        Channel = n.Channel,
        Severity = n.Severity,
        IsRead = n.IsRead,
        ReadAt = n.ReadAt,
        RelatedEntityType = n.RelatedEntityType,
        RelatedEntityId = n.RelatedEntityId,
        CreatedAt = n.CreatedAt
    };
}

csharp
    /// <summary>Issue a fresh JWT for an authenticated user (simplified refresh).</summary>
    [HttpPost("refresh")]
    [Authorize]
    public async Task<IActionResult> Refresh()
    {
        var userIdClaim = User.FindFirstValue(ClaimTypes.NameIdentifier);
        if (!Guid.TryParse(userIdClaim, out var userId)) return Unauthorized();

        var user = await _userService.GetCurrentUserAsync(userId);
        return user is null ? Unauthorized() : Ok(user);
    }

    /// <summary>Client-side logout — server is stateless, so this just confirms.</summary>
    [HttpPost("logout")]
    [Authorize]
    public IActionResult Logout() => Ok(new { message = "Logged out." });

8.3 Add to ViewingService.cs
csharp
public async Task<IEnumerable<SlotResponse>> GetAvailableSlotsAsync(Guid propertyId, DateTime date)
{
    var exists = await _db.Properties.AnyAsync(p => p.Id == propertyId);
    if (!exists) throw new KeyNotFoundException("Property not found.");

    var bookedSlots = await _db.Viewings
        .Where(v => v.PropertyId == propertyId
                 && v.ScheduledDate.Date == date.Date
                 && (v.Status == ViewingStatus.Requested || v.Status == ViewingStatus.Approved))
        .Select(v => v.ScheduledDate)
        .ToListAsync();

    // 9am to 5pm, 1-hour slots
    var slots = new List<SlotResponse>();
    for (int hour = 9; hour < 17; hour++)
    {
        var start = date.Date.AddHours(hour);
        slots.Add(new SlotResponse
        {
            StartTime = start,
            EndTime = start.AddHours(1),
            IsAvailable = !bookedSlots.Any(b => b.Hour == hour)
        });
    }
    return slots;
}

📂 Section 9 — RateLimitingMiddleware
9.1 src/UniCribz.Api/Middleware/RateLimitingMiddleware.cs
csharp
using System.Collections.Concurrent;
using System.Net;

namespace UniCribz.Api.Middleware;

/// <summary>
/// Simple in-memory rate limiter: max N requests per IP per minute.
/// For production, use Azure API Management or AspNetCoreRateLimit.
/// </summary>
public class RateLimitingMiddleware
{
    private const int MaxRequestsPerMinute = 60;

    private static readonly ConcurrentDictionary<string, List<DateTime>> Requests = new();
    private readonly RequestDelegate _next;
    private readonly ILogger<RateLimitingMiddleware> _logger;

    public RateLimitingMiddleware(RequestDelegate next, ILogger<RateLimitingMiddleware> logger)
    {
        _next = next;
        _logger = logger;
    }

    public async Task InvokeAsync(HttpContext context)
    {
        var ip = context.Connection.RemoteIpAddress?.ToString() ?? "unknown";
        var now = DateTime.UtcNow;

        var timestamps = Requests.GetOrAdd(ip, _ => new List<DateTime>());

        lock (timestamps)
        {
            timestamps.RemoveAll(t => (now - t).TotalMinutes > 1);
            if (timestamps.Count >= MaxRequestsPerMinute)
            {
                _logger.LogWarning("Rate limit exceeded for {Ip}", ip);
                context.Response.StatusCode = (int)HttpStatusCode.TooManyRequests;
                context.Response.Headers["Retry-After"] = "60";
                return;
            }
            timestamps.Add(now);
        }

        await _next(context);
    }
}

i tested it the exact order everything works fine except viewing available slots, i thing the date formatting is wrong: {
  "error": "Cannot write DateTime with Kind=Unspecified to PostgreSQL type 'timestamp with time zone', only UTC is supported. Note that it's not possible to mix DateTimes with different Kinds in an array, range, or multirange. (Parameter 'value')",
  "statusCode": 400,
  "timestamp": "2026-10-01T14:35:59.0353337Z"
}
The issue is in GetAvailableSlotsAsync. The date comes in with Kind=Unspecified from the query string, and when it's used in a Where clause against a timestamp with time zone column, PostgreSQL rejects it.

The fix is to convert the DateTime to UTC before passing to the query. Let me look at the code:

csharp
public async Task<IEnumerable<SlotResponse>> GetAvailableSlotsAsync(Guid propertyId, DateTime date)
{
    var exists = await _db.Properties.AnyAsync(p => p.Id == propertyId);
    if (!exists) throw new KeyNotFoundException("Property not found.");

    var bookedSlots = await _db.Viewings
        .Where(v => v.PropertyId == propertyId
                 && v.ScheduledDate.Date == date.Date
                 && (v.Status == ViewingStatus.Requested || v.Status == ViewingStatus.Approved))
        .Select(v => v.ScheduledDate)
        .ToListAsync();
    ...
}
The issue is date.Date — DateTime.Date returns a DateTime with Kind=Unspecified. When EF tries to translate this to a parameter, it fails because PostgreSQL only accepts UTC for timestamptz.

Also, date_trunc('day', v."ScheduledDate", 'UTC') = @__date_Date_1 — this comparison uses the parameter directly.

Fix: Force Kind=Utc on the date before using it in the query.

csharp
var utcDate = DateTime.SpecifyKind(date.Date, DateTimeKind.Utc);
Or better: accept the date and normalize:

csharp
var startOfDay = DateTime.SpecifyKind(date.Date, DateTimeKind.Utc);
var endOfDay = startOfDay.AddDays(1);

var bookedSlots = await _db.Viewings
    .Where(v => v.PropertyId == propertyId
             && v.ScheduledDate >= startOfDay
             && v.ScheduledDate < endOfDay
             && (v.Status == ViewingStatus.Requested || v.Status == ViewingStatus.Approved))
    .Select(v => v.ScheduledDate)
    .ToListAsync();
That's cleaner and avoids the date_trunc issue entirely. Also avoids the .Date property which triggers the date_trunc in SQL.

🔧 Fix — DateTime Kind Issue in GetAvailableSlotsAsync
The problem: date.Date returns a DateTime with Kind=Unspecified. When EF Core translates it into a query parameter for PostgreSQL's timestamptz column, Npgsql rejects it because it can only accept UTC.

Also, the .Date property forces EF to emit date_trunc('day', ...) which is inefficient. Let's replace both problems with a range comparison.

Replace GetAvailableSlotsAsync in src/UniCribz.Api/Services/ViewingService.cs

csharp
public async Task<IEnumerable<SlotResponse>> GetAvailableSlotsAsync(Guid propertyId, DateTime date)
{
    var exists = await _db.Properties.AnyAsync(p => p.Id == propertyId);
    if (!exists) throw new KeyNotFoundException("Property not found.");

    // ✅ Force UTC — PostgreSQL timestamptz rejects Kind=Unspecified
    var startOfDay = DateTime.SpecifyKind(date.Date, DateTimeKind.Utc);
    var endOfDay = startOfDay.AddDays(1);

    // ✅ Range comparison instead of .Date / date_trunc
    var bookedSlots = await _db.Viewings
        .Where(v => v.PropertyId == propertyId
                 && v.ScheduledDate >= startOfDay
                 && v.ScheduledDate < endOfDay
                 && (v.Status == ViewingStatus.Requested || v.Status == ViewingStatus.Approved))
        .Select(v => v.ScheduledDate)
        .ToListAsync();

    var slots = new List<SlotResponse>();
    for (int hour = 9; hour < 17; hour++)
    {
        var start = startOfDay.AddHours(hour);   // UTC
        slots.Add(new SlotResponse
        {
            StartTime = start,
            EndTime = start.AddHours(1),
            IsAvailable = !bookedSlots.Any(b => b.Hour == hour)
        });
    }
    return slots;
}
What Changed
Before	After
date.Date (Kind=Unspecified → Npgsql rejects)	DateTime.SpecifyKind(date.Date, DateTimeKind.Utc)
v.ScheduledDate.Date == date.Date (forces date_trunc in SQL)	v.ScheduledDate >= startOfDay && v.ScheduledDate < endOfDay (indexable range)
No Kind=Utc on output slots	Output slots built from UTC baseline
The range comparison is also faster because PostgreSQL can use an index on ScheduledDate instead of applying a function to every row.

🎯 Note on the null Token Error
Looking at your log, one other thing happened:

text
[16:33:34 ERR] Unhandled exception for GET /api/leases/mine
System.ArgumentNullException: Value cannot be null. (Parameter 'input')
   at System.Guid.Parse(String input)
That's the intentional "401 No token" test — the request didn't include an Authorization header so User.FindFirstValue(ClaimTypes.NameIdentifier) returned null. The Guid.Parse(null) threw before the [Authorize] attribute could kick in.

Not a bug in your code, but you can improve the error response by guarding against the null:

csharp
private Guid CurrentUserId
{
    get
    {
        var claim = User.FindFirstValue(ClaimTypes.NameIdentifier)
                    ?? User.FindFirstValue("sub");
        return Guid.TryParse(claim, out var id) ? id : Guid.Empty;
    }
}
That returns Guid.Empty instead of throwing, so the request returns 200 [] (empty) or the service throws a clean UnauthorizedAccessException. Only apply this if you want the cleaner error — the current behaviour is functionally fine (still rejects with 400 instead of 401, but [Authorize] already handles the proper case).

For now, focus on the viewing slot fix — that's the actual bug.

What the Observer Pattern Does (From Project Doc)
Purpose: Auto-update dependent modules when state changes occur — specifically when a tenant moves out.

text
LeaseService (Subject)                    IStatusObserver (Observer)
    ├── registerObserver(obs)              ├── RoomStatusUpdater    → sets room to Available
    ├── unregisterObserver(obs)            ├── ReportServiceObserver → recalculates occupancy
    └── moveOutTenant(tenantId)            └── AdminDashboardObserver → refreshes metrics
        └── notifies all observers
The trigger flow:

Admin terminates a lease → LeaseService.TerminateAsync(id, reason)

Service fires notify(tenantId, "MOVE_OUT")

Every registered observer updates:

RoomStatusUpdater → marks the room Available

ReportServiceObserver → recalculates occupancy report

AdminDashboardObserver → refreshes dashboard metrics

Now let me write the code.

For RoomStatusUpdater:

csharp
public class RoomStatusUpdater : IStatusObserver
{
    private readonly UniCribzDbContext _db;
    private readonly ILogger<RoomStatusUpdater> _logger;

    public RoomStatusUpdater(UniCribzDbContext db, ILogger<RoomStatusUpdater> logger)
    {
        _db = db;
        _logger = logger;
    }

    public async Task UpdateAsync(StatusChangeEvent change)
    {
        if (change.EventType != "MOVE_OUT") return;

        var room = await _db.Rooms.FindAsync(change.RoomId);
        if (room is null)
        {
            _logger.LogWarning("Room {RoomId} not found for MOVE_OUT of tenant {TenantId}", change.RoomId, change.TenantId);
            return;
        }

        room.Status = RoomStatus.Available;
        room.UpdatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
        await _db.SaveChangesAsync();

        _logger.LogInformation("Room {RoomNumber} marked Available after tenant {TenantId} moved out",
            room.RoomNumber, change.TenantId);
    }
}

Now LeaseService modification — inject observers and fire them:

csharp
public class LeaseService : ILeaseService
{
    private readonly UniCribzDbContext _db;
    private readonly ILogger<LeaseService> _logger;
    private readonly IEnumerable<IStatusObserver> _observers;

    public LeaseService(
        UniCribzDbContext db,
        ILogger<LeaseService> logger,
        IEnumerable<IStatusObserver> observers)
    {
        _db = db;
        _logger = logger;
        _observers = observers;
    }

    // ... other methods ...

    public async Task<LeaseResponse> TerminateAsync(Guid id, string? reason)
    {
        var lease = await _db.Leases.FindAsync(id)
            ?? throw new KeyNotFoundException("Lease not found.");

        lease.Status = LeaseStatus.Terminated;
        lease.UpdatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
        await _db.SaveChangesAsync();

        _logger.LogInformation("Lease {Id} terminated. Reason: {Reason}", id, reason);

        // Fire observers
        var change = new StatusChangeEvent(
            TenantId: lease.TenantId,
            RoomId: lease.RoomId,
            EventType: "MOVE_OUT",
            OccurredAt: DateTime.UtcNow);

        foreach (var observer in _observers)
        {
            try
            {
                await observer.UpdateAsync(change);
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                _logger.LogError(ex, "Observer {Observer} failed for MOVE_OUT of tenant {TenantId}",
                    observer.GetType().Name, lease.TenantId);
                // don't rethrow — one observer failing shouldn't break the whole request
            }
        }

        return await LoadResponse(id);
    }
}

🎯 Observer Pattern — Full Implementation
This adds the missing design pattern from the project doc (page 48). It's 5 new/modified files in the API project.

The pattern fires when an admin terminates a lease → all observers react (room freed, reports invalidated, dashboard refreshed).

📄 File 1 — src/UniCribz.Api/Observers/IStatusObserver.cs
csharp
namespace UniCribz.Api.Observers;

/// <summary>
/// Event payload passed to every observer when a meaningful status change occurs.
/// </summary>
public record StatusChangeEvent(
    Guid TenantId,
    Guid RoomId,
    string EventType,
    DateTime OccurredAt);

/// <summary>
/// Observer contract — implemented by any module that needs to react to
/// status changes elsewhere in the system (move-out, move-in, room-maintenance, etc.).
/// </summary>
public interface IStatusObserver
{
    Task UpdateAsync(StatusChangeEvent change);
}
📄 File 2 — src/UniCribz.Api/Observers/RoomStatusUpdater.cs
csharp
using UniCribz.Data.Context;
using UniCribz.Data.Enums;

namespace UniCribz.Api.Observers;

/// <summary>
/// Observer that frees the room when a tenant moves out.
/// On MOVE_OUT: room status → Available, timestamped.
/// </summary>
public class RoomStatusUpdater : IStatusObserver
{
    private readonly UniCribzDbContext _db;
    private readonly ILogger<RoomStatusUpdater> _logger;

    public RoomStatusUpdater(UniCribzDbContext db, ILogger<RoomStatusUpdater> logger)
    {
        _db = db;
        _logger = logger;
    }

    public async Task UpdateAsync(StatusChangeEvent change)
    {
        if (change.EventType != "MOVE_OUT")
            return;

        var room = await _db.Rooms.FindAsync(change.RoomId);
        if (room is null)
        {
            _logger.LogWarning(
                "[RoomStatusUpdater] Room {RoomId} not found for MOVE_OUT of tenant {TenantId}",
                change.RoomId, change.TenantId);
            return;
        }

        room.Status = RoomStatus.Available;
        room.UpdatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
        await _db.SaveChangesAsync();

        _logger.LogInformation(
            "[RoomStatusUpdater] Room {RoomNumber} marked Available after tenant {TenantId} moved out",
            room.RoomNumber, change.TenantId);
    }
}

1.2 Replace TerminateAsync
Find this method:

csharp
public async Task<LeaseResponse> TerminateAsync(Guid id, string? reason)
{
    var lease = await _db.Leases.FindAsync(id)
        ?? throw new KeyNotFoundException("Lease not found.");

    lease.Status = LeaseStatus.Terminated;
    lease.UpdatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;

    var room = await _db.Rooms.FindAsync(lease.RoomId);
    if (room is not null) room.Status = RoomStatus.Available;

    await _db.SaveChangesAsync();
    _logger.LogInformation("Lease {Id} terminated. Reason: {Reason}", id, reason);
    return await LoadResponse(id);
}
Replace with:

csharp
public async Task<LeaseResponse> TerminateAsync(Guid id, string? reason)
{
    var lease = await _db.Leases.FindAsync(id)
        ?? throw new KeyNotFoundException("Lease not found.");

    lease.Status = LeaseStatus.Terminated;
    lease.UpdatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
    await _db.SaveChangesAsync();

    _logger.LogInformation("Lease {Id} terminated. Reason: {Reason}", id, reason);

    // ✅ Observer pattern: notify every registered observer of the move-out.
    // Each observer reacts independently — one failure doesn't break the others.
    var change = new StatusChangeEvent(
        TenantId: lease.TenantId,
        RoomId: lease.RoomId,
        EventType: "MOVE_OUT",
        OccurredAt: DateTime.UtcNow);

    foreach (var observer in _observers)
    {
        try
        {
            await observer.UpdateAsync(change);
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            _logger.LogError(ex,
                "[LeaseService] Observer {Observer} failed for MOVE_OUT of tenant {TenantId}",
                observer.GetType().Name, lease.TenantId);
            // swallow — a failed observer must not roll back the termination
        }
    }

    return await LoadResponse(id);
}

🎯 What Just Changed
Before	After
LeaseService.TerminateAsync inline-updated the room	LeaseService just terminates the lease and fires an event
Every side-effect needed to be added to LeaseService	New observers can be registered without touching LeaseService
No clear audit trail of who reacted	Each observer logs its own reaction
The Observer pattern is now the source of truth for all reactions to lease termination. Adding a new observer (e.g., "send SMS to tenant" or "create a cleaning task") is now 1 file + 1 DI line — no changes to LeaseService.

csharp
namespace UniCribz.Api.Observers;

public class AuditLogObserver : IStatusObserver
{
    private readonly ILogger<AuditLogObserver> _logger;
    public AuditLogObserver(ILogger<AuditLogObserver> logger) => _logger = logger;

    public Task UpdateAsync(StatusChangeEvent change)
    {
        _logger.LogInformation(
            "[AuditLogObserver] {EventType} at {OccurredAt:u} for tenant {TenantId}",
            change.EventType, change.OccurredAt, change.TenantId);
        return Task.CompletedTask;
    }
}
Register in ServiceCollectionExtensions.cs:

csharp
services.AddScoped<IStatusObserver, AuditLogObserver>();
Now terminating a lease produces 4 log lines — proving the pattern scales.

Step 1: Strategy Pattern — Notifications (START HERE)
Project doc requirement — page 47.

Files to implement in order:

INotificationStrategy.cs

csharp
public interface INotificationStrategy
{
    Task SendAsync(string recipient, string message);
}
EmailNotificationStrategy.cs — SendGrid

Inject IConfiguration, ILogger<EmailNotificationStrategy>

Read SendGrid:ApiKey and SendGrid:FromEmail

SendAsync → SendGridClient.SendEmailAsync(msg)

SMSNotificationStrategy.cs — Twilio

Read Twilio:AccountSid, AuthToken, FromNumber

MessageResource.CreateAsync(to, from, body)

InAppNotificationStrategy.cs — Save to DB

Inject UniCribzDbContext

Create Notification entity, SaveChangesAsync

NotificationManager.cs

csharp
public class NotificationManager : INotificationManager
{
    private readonly IEnumerable<INotificationStrategy> _strategies;
    public NotificationManager(IEnumerable<INotificationStrategy> strategies) => _strategies = strategies;

    public async Task NotifyAsync(string recipient, string message)
    {
        foreach (var strategy in _strategies)
            await strategy.SendAsync(recipient, message);
    }
}
Register in ServiceCollectionExtensions.cs

csharp
services.AddScoped<INotificationStrategy, EmailNotificationStrategy>();
services.AddScoped<INotificationStrategy, SMSNotificationStrategy>();
services.AddScoped<INotificationStrategy, InAppNotificationStrategy>();
services.AddScoped<INotificationManager, NotificationManager>();

csharp
public async Task<GeocodeResponse?> GeocodeAsync(string address)
{
    var client = new RestClient("https://maps.googleapis.com/maps/api/geocode/json");
    var request = new RestRequest();
    request.AddQueryParameter("address", address);
    request.AddQueryParameter("key", _config["GoogleMaps:ApiKey"]);

    var response = await client.GetAsync<GeocodeResponse>(request);
    // parse lat/lng, return
}
Register: services.AddScoped<IGoogleMapsService, GoogleMapsService>();

# UniCribz — Student Accommodation Management System

> **Module:** INSY7315 | **Assessment:** Task 1 | **Group:** MOTIVATION | **Programme:** BCAD3
> **Submission:** 17 August 2026

A cloud-native student accommodation platform for South Africa that eliminates fragmented manual processes (spreadsheets, paper, WhatsApp) and provides a unified digital experience for visitors, tenants, and admins.

---

## 🚀 Quick Start

```bash
# 1. Clone
git clone https://github.com/YOUR-USERNAME/INSY7315-2026-MOTIVATION.git
cd INSY7315-2026-MOTIVATION

# 2. Verify .NET 8
dotnet --list-sdks     # Should show 8.0.x

# 3. Run setup (first time only)
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File setup/00-run-all.ps1

# 4. Start local dependencies
docker-compose up -d

# 5. Build & run
dotnet build
cd src/UniCribz.Api && dotnet run
# (New terminal)
cd src/UniCribz.Web && dotnet run

For the security headers middleware:

csharp
public class SecurityHeadersMiddleware
{
    private readonly RequestDelegate _next;

    public SecurityHeadersMiddleware(RequestDelegate next) => _next = next;

    public async Task InvokeAsync(HttpContext context)
    {
        var headers = context.Response.Headers;

        headers["X-Content-Type-Options"] = "nosniff";
        headers["X-Frame-Options"] = "DENY";
        headers["X-XSS-Protection"] = "1; mode=block";
        headers["Referrer-Policy"] = "strict-origin-when-cross-origin";
        headers["Permissions-Policy"] = "geolocation=(), microphone=(), camera=()";
        headers["Content-Security-Policy"] = "default-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data: https:; script-src 'self' https://maps.googleapis.com; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; font-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self' https://maps.googleapis.com";
        headers.Remove("X-Powered-By");
        headers.Remove("Server");

        await _next(context);
    }
}

For correlation ID:

csharp
public class CorrelationIdMiddleware
{
    private const string HeaderName = "X-Correlation-Id";
    private readonly RequestDelegate _next;
    private readonly ILogger<CorrelationIdMiddleware> _logger;

    public CorrelationIdMiddleware(RequestDelegate next, ILogger<CorrelationIdMiddleware> logger)
    {
        _next = next;
        _logger = logger;
    }

    public async Task InvokeAsync(HttpContext context)
    {
        var correlationId = context.Request.Headers[HeaderName].FirstOrDefault()
                            ?? Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N");

        context.Response.Headers[HeaderName] = correlationId;
        context.Items[HeaderName] = correlationId;

        using (_logger.BeginScope(new Dictionary<string, object> { ["CorrelationId"] = correlationId }))
        {
            await _next(context);
        }
    }
}

For configuration validation extension:

csharp
public static class ConfigurationExtensions
{
    public static IServiceCollection AddValidatedOptions(this IServiceCollection services, IConfiguration config)
    {
        services.AddOptions<JwtOptions>()
            .Bind(config.GetSection(JwtOptions.SectionName))
            .Validate(o => !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(o.Key) && o.Key.Length >= 32,
                "Jwt:Key must be at least 32 characters")
            .Validate(o => o.ExpiryMinutes > 0, "Jwt:ExpiryMinutes must be positive")
            .ValidateOnStart();

        services.AddOptions<AppOptions>()
            .Bind(config.GetSection(AppOptions.SectionName))
            .Validate(o => !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(o.WebBaseUrl), "App:WebBaseUrl is required")
            .ValidateOnStart();

        return services;
    }
}
For migration helper:

csharp
public static class DatabaseExtensions
{
    public static async Task MigrateDatabaseAsync(this WebApplication app)
    {
        using var scope = app.Services.CreateScope();
        var db = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<UniCribzDbContext>();
        var logger = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<ILogger<Program>>();

        try
        {
            logger.LogInformation("Applying database migrations...");
            await db.Database.MigrateAsync();
            logger.LogInformation("Database migrations applied successfully.");
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            logger.LogError(ex, "Failed to apply database migrations.");
            throw;
        }
    }

    public static async Task SeedDatabaseAsync(this WebApplication app)
    {
        using var scope = app.Services.CreateScope();
        var db = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<UniCribzDbContext>();
        await DataSeeder.SeedAsync(db);
    }
}

{
    options.GlobalLimiter = PartitionedRateLimiter.Create<HttpContext, string>(context =>

📦 Step 3 — Add Security Headers Middleware
📄 src/UniCribz.Api/Middleware/SecurityHeadersMiddleware.cs
csharp
namespace UniCribz.Api.Middleware;

/// <summary>
/// Adds hardened security response headers.
/// Strict CSP is only applied in non-development environments to keep Swagger usable.
/// </summary>
public class SecurityHeadersMiddleware
{
    private readonly RequestDelegate _next;
    private readonly IWebHostEnvironment _env;

    public SecurityHeadersMiddleware(RequestDelegate next, IWebHostEnvironment env)
    {
        _next = next;
        _env = env;
    }

    public async Task InvokeAsync(HttpContext context)
    {
        var headers = context.Response.Headers;

        headers["X-Content-Type-Options"] = "nosniff";
        headers["X-Frame-Options"] = "DENY";
        headers["X-XSS-Protection"] = "1; mode=block";
        headers["Referrer-Policy"] = "strict-origin-when-cross-origin";
        headers["Permissions-Policy"] = "geolocation=(), microphone=(), camera=()";

        // HSTS is set by ASP.NET Core when UseHsts() is enabled; only add in prod
        if (!_env.IsDevelopment())
        {
            headers["Content-Security-Policy"] =
                "default-src 'self'; " +
                "img-src 'self' data: https:; " +
                "script-src 'self' https://maps.googleapis.com; " +
                "style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; " +
                "font-src 'self' data:; " +
                "connect-src 'self' https://maps.googleapis.com; " +
                "frame-ancestors 'none'";
        }

        // Remove server-identifying headers
        headers.Remove("X-Powered-By");
        headers.Remove("Server");

        await _next(context);
    }
}
📦 Step 4 — Add Correlation ID Middleware
Every request gets a traceable ID. Essential for debugging prod issues.

📄 src/UniCribz.Api/Middleware/CorrelationIdMiddleware.cs
csharp
namespace UniCribz.Api.Middleware;

/// <summary>
/// Assigns or propagates an X-Correlation-Id on every request.
/// The ID is added to the log scope so every log line for a request is traceable.
/// </summary>
public class CorrelationIdMiddleware
{
    private const string HeaderName = "X-Correlation-Id";
    private readonly RequestDelegate _next;
    private readonly ILogger<CorrelationIdMiddleware> _logger;

    public CorrelationIdMiddleware(RequestDelegate next, ILogger<CorrelationIdMiddleware> logger)
    {
        _next = next;
        _logger = logger;
    }

    public async Task InvokeAsync(HttpContext context)
    {
        var correlationId = context.Request.Headers[HeaderName].FirstOrDefault();

        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(correlationId))
            correlationId = Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N");

        context.Items[HeaderName] = correlationId;
        context.Response.Headers[HeaderName] = correlationId;
        context.TraceIdentifier = correlationId;

        using (_logger.BeginScope(new Dictionary<string, object>
        {
            ["CorrelationId"] = correlationId
        }))
        {
            await _next(context);
        }
    }
}
📦 Step 5 — Create Extension Methods
📄 src/UniCribz.Api/Extensions/ConfigurationExtensions.cs
csharp
using UniCribz.Api.Options;

namespace UniCribz.Api.Extensions;

public static class ConfigurationExtensions
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Registers strongly-typed, startup-validated configuration options.
    /// The app will refuse to start if any option is invalid.
    /// </summary>
    public static IServiceCollection AddValidatedOptions(
        this IServiceCollection services,
        IConfiguration config)
    {
        services.AddOptions<JwtOptions>()
            .Bind(config.GetSection(JwtOptions.SectionName))
            .Validate(o => !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(o.Key) && o.Key.Length >= 32,
                "Jwt:Key must be at least 32 characters.")
            .Validate(o => o.ExpiryMinutes > 0, "Jwt:ExpiryMinutes must be positive.")
            .ValidateOnStart();

        services.AddOptions<AppOptions>()
            .Bind(config.GetSection(AppOptions.SectionName))
            .Validate(o => !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(o.WebBaseUrl),
                "App:WebBaseUrl is required.")
            .ValidateOnStart();

        services.AddOptions<DatabaseOptions>()
            .Bind(config.GetSection(DatabaseOptions.SectionName))
            .ValidateOnStart();

        return services;
    }
}
📄 src/UniCribz.Api/Extensions/WebApplicationExtensions.cs
csharp
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using UniCribz.Data.Context;
using UniCribz.Data.Seed;

namespace UniCribz.Api.Extensions;

public static class WebApplicationExtensions
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Applies pending EF Core migrations if Database:MigrateOnStartup = true.
    /// </summary>
    public static async Task ApplyMigrationsAsync(this WebApplication app)
    {
        using var scope = app.Services.CreateScope();
        var db = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<UniCribzDbContext>();
        var logger = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<ILogger<Program>>();

        try
        {
            logger.LogInformation("Applying database migrations...");
            await db.Database.MigrateAsync();
            logger.LogInformation("Database migrations applied successfully.");
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            logger.LogCritical(ex, "Failed to apply database migrations.");
            throw;
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Runs the data seeder if Database:SeedOnStartup = true.
    /// </summary>
    public static async Task SeedDatabaseAsync(this WebApplication app)
    {
        using var scope = app.Services.CreateScope();
        var db = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<UniCribzDbContext>();
        await DataSeeder.SeedAsync(db);
    }
}

📦 Step 8 — Rewrite Program.cs
Replace src/UniCribz.Api/Program.cs entirely with this:

csharp
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authentication.JwtBearer;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Diagnostics.HealthChecks;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.HttpOverrides;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.ResponseCompression;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Diagnostics.HealthChecks;
using Microsoft.IdentityModel.Tokens;
using Microsoft.OpenApi.Models;
using Serilog;
using Serilog.Events;
using System.Text;
using System.Threading.RateLimiting;
using UniCribz.Api.Extensions;
using UniCribz.Api.Middleware;
using UniCribz.Api.Options;
using UniCribz.Data.Context;

var builder = WebApplication.CreateBuilder(args);

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// 1. LOGGING — Serilog (console + rolling file)
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
Log.Logger = new LoggerConfiguration()
    .ReadFrom.Configuration(builder.Configuration)
    .Enrich.FromLogContext()
    .Enrich.WithMachineName()
    .Enrich.WithEnvironmentName()
    .Enrich.WithProperty("Application", "UniCribz.Api")
    .WriteTo.Console()
    .WriteTo.File(
        path: "logs/unicribz-.log",
        rollingInterval: RollingInterval.Day,
        retainedFileCountLimit: 30,
        restrictedToMinimumLevel: LogEventLevel.Information)
    .CreateLogger();

builder.Host.UseSerilog();

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// 2. CONFIGURATION — env-specific + validated options
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
builder.Services.AddValidatedOptions(builder.Configuration);

var jwtOptions = builder.Configuration.GetSection(JwtOptions.SectionName).Get<JwtOptions>()
                 ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("Jwt configuration missing.");

var appOptions = builder.Configuration.GetSection(AppOptions.SectionName).Get<AppOptions>()
                 ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("App configuration missing.");

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// 3. DATABASE — with resilience (retry on transient failures)
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
builder.Services.AddDbContext<UniCribzDbContext>(options =>
    options.UseNpgsql(
        builder.Configuration.GetConnectionString("DefaultConnection"),
        npgsql =>
        {
            npgsql.EnableRetryOnFailure(
                maxRetryCount: 3,
                maxRetryDelay: TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5),
                errorCodesToAdd: null);
            npgsql.UseQuerySplittingBehavior(QuerySplittingBehavior.SplitQuery);
            npgsql.CommandTimeout(30);
        }));

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// 4. CACHE — Redis
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
builder.Services.AddStackExchangeRedisCache(options =>
{
    options.Configuration = builder.Configuration.GetConnectionString("Redis");
    options.InstanceName = "UniCribz_";
});

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// 5. AUTHENTICATION — JWT
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
builder.Services.AddAuthentication(JwtBearerDefaults.AuthenticationScheme)
    .AddJwtBearer(options =>
    {
        options.TokenValidationParameters = new TokenValidationParameters
        {
            ValidateIssuer = true,
            ValidateAudience = true,
            ValidateLifetime = true,
            ValidateIssuerSigningKey = true,
            ValidIssuer = jwtOptions.Issuer,
            ValidAudience = jwtOptions.Audience,
            IssuerSigningKey = new SymmetricSecurityKey(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(jwtOptions.Key)),
            ClockSkew = TimeSpan.FromMinutes(1)
        };
    });

builder.Services.AddAuthorization(options =>
{
    options.AddPolicy("AdminOnly", policy => policy.RequireRole("Admin"));
    options.AddPolicy("TenantOnly", policy => policy.RequireRole("Tenant"));
    options.AddPolicy("TenantOrAdmin", policy => policy.RequireRole("Tenant", "Admin"));
});

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// 6. CORS — allow only configured origins
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
builder.Services.AddCors(options =>
{
    options.AddPolicy("AllowWebApp", policy =>
    {
        var origins = appOptions.AllowedOrigins.Length > 0
            ? appOptions.AllowedOrigins
            : new[] { appOptions.WebBaseUrl };

        policy.WithOrigins(origins)
              .AllowAnyHeader()
              .AllowAnyMethod()
              .AllowCredentials();
    });
});

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// 7. RATE LIMITING — built-in (per-IP, 100 req/min)
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
builder.Services.AddRateLimiter(options =>
{
    options.GlobalLimiter = PartitionedRateLimiter.Create<HttpContext, string>(context =>
    {
        var ip = context.Connection.RemoteIpAddress?.ToString() ?? "unknown";
        return RateLimitPartition.GetFixedWindowLimiter(
            partitionKey: ip,
            factory: _ => new FixedWindowRateLimiterOptions
            {
                PermitLimit = 100,
                Window = TimeSpan.FromMinutes(1),
                QueueProcessingOrder = QueueProcessingOrder.OldestFirst,
                QueueLimit = 0
            });
    });
    options.RejectionStatusCode = StatusCodes.Status429TooManyRequests;
    options.OnRejected = async (context, token) =>
    {
        context.HttpContext.Response.Headers["Retry-After"] = "60";
        context.HttpContext.Response.ContentType = "application/json";
        await context.HttpContext.Response.WriteAsync(
            """{"error":"Rate limit exceeded. Try again later.","statusCode":429}""", token);
    };
});

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// 8. RESPONSE COMPRESSION — gzip/brotli
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
builder.Services.AddResponseCompression(options =>
{
    options.EnableForHttps = true;
    options.Providers.Add<BrotliCompressionProvider>();
    options.Providers.Add<GzipCompressionProvider>();
});

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// 9. FORWARDED HEADERS — behind Azure App Gateway / reverse proxy
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
builder.Services.Configure<ForwardedHeadersOptions>(options =>
{
    options.ForwardedHeaders = ForwardedHeaders.XForwardedFor | ForwardedHeaders.XForwardedProto;
    options.KnownNetworks.Clear();
    options.KnownProxies.Clear();
});

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// 10. APPLICATION SERVICES + CONTROLLERS + SWAGGER
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
builder.Services.AddApplicationServices();
builder.Services.AddControllers();
builder.Services.AddEndpointsApiExplorer();

builder.Services.AddSwaggerGen(c =>
{
    c.SwaggerDoc("v1", new OpenApiInfo
    {
        Title = "UniCribz API",
        Version = "v1",
        Description = "Student Accommodation Management System API"
    });
    c.AddSecurityDefinition("Bearer", new OpenApiSecurityScheme
    {
        Description = "JWT Authorization header using the Bearer scheme.",
        Name = "Authorization",
        In = ParameterLocation.Header,
        Type = SecuritySchemeType.ApiKey,
        Scheme = "Bearer"
    });
    c.AddSecurityRequirement(new OpenApiSecurityRequirement
    {
        {
            new OpenApiSecurityScheme
            {
                Reference = new OpenApiReference { Type = ReferenceType.SecurityScheme, Id = "Bearer" }
            },
            Array.Empty<string>()
        }
    });
});

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// 11. HEALTH CHECKS — tagged (db, cache)
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
builder.Services.AddHealthChecks()
    .AddNpgSql(
        builder.Configuration.GetConnectionString("DefaultConnection")!,
        name: "postgresql",
        tags: new[] { "db", "ready" })
    .AddRedis(
        builder.Configuration.GetConnectionString("Redis")!,
        name: "redis",
        tags: new[] { "cache", "ready" })
    .AddCheck("self", () => HealthCheckResult.Healthy(), tags: new[] { "live" });

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// 12. AUTOMAPPER
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
builder.Services.AddAutoMapper(typeof(UniCribz.Api.Mappings.MappingProfile));

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// BUILD
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
var app = builder.Build();

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// STARTUP TASKS — migrations + seed (configurable)
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
if (app.Configuration.GetValue<bool>("Database:MigrateOnStartup"))
    await app.ApplyMigrationsAsync();

if (app.Configuration.GetValue<bool>("Database:SeedOnStartup"))
    await app.SeedDatabaseAsync();

// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// PIPELINE ORDER MATTERS — do not reorder without understanding
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
app.UseForwardedHeaders();

// Swagger: dev and staging only (never in prod)
if (app.Environment.IsDevelopment() || app.Environment.IsStaging())
{
    app.UseSwagger();
    app.UseSwaggerUI();
}

if (!app.Environment.IsDevelopment())
{
    app.UseHsts();
    app.UseExceptionHandler("/error");
}

app.UseHttpsRedirection();
app.UseMiddleware<SecurityHeadersMiddleware>();
app.UseMiddleware<CorrelationIdMiddleware>();
app.UseMiddleware<ErrorHandlingMiddleware>();
app.UseMiddleware<RequestLoggingMiddleware>();
app.UseResponseCompression();
app.UseCors("AllowWebApp");
app.UseRateLimiter();
app.UseAuthentication();
app.UseAuthorization();
app.MapControllers();

// Health checks — split endpoints
app.MapHealthChecks("/health");                                                   // all checks
app.MapHealthChecks("/health/live", new HealthCheckOptions
{
    Predicate = c => c.Tags.Contains("live"),
    ResponseWriter = async (context, report) =>
    {
        context.Response.ContentType = "application/json";
        await context.Response.WriteAsync($$"""{"status":"{{report.Status}}"}""");
    }
});
app.MapHealthChecks("/health/ready", new HealthCheckOptions
{
    Predicate = c => c.Tags.Contains("ready"),
    ResponseWriter = async (context, report) =>
    {
        context.Response.ContentType = "application/json";
        var checks = report.Entries.Select(e => new { name = e.Key, status = e.Value.Status.ToString() });
        await context.Response.WriteAsync(
            System.Text.Json.JsonSerializer.Serialize(new { status = report.Status.ToString(), checks }));
    }
});

app.Run();
